zh: 这个问题比较复杂，我们得把它从不同角度分析一下。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí bǐjiào fùzá, wǒmen děi bǎ tā cóng búdǒng jiǎodù fēnxī yīxià.
en: This issue is pretty complicated, so we need to analyze it from different perspectives.

zh: 妈妈让我吃饭。
pinyin: Māma ràng wǒ chīfàn.
en: Mom is making me eat.

zh: 老师让我们今天写汉字。
pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen jīntiān xiě hànzì.
en: The teacher wants us to write Chinese characters today.

zh: 因为下雨,爸爸让我不要出去玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, bàba ràng wǒ búyào chūqu wán.
en: Because it's raining, Dad won't let me go out to play.

zh: 公司让我负责这个项目,虽然我有点紧张。
pinyin: Gōngsī ràng wǒ fùzé zhège xiàngmù, suīrán wǒ yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng.
en: The company put me in charge of this project, even though I'm a bit nervous about it.

zh: 他的建议让我重新思考了这个问题的本质。
pinyin: Tā de jiànyì ràng wǒ chóngxīn sīkǎo le zhège wèntí de běnzhì.
en: His suggestion made me reconsider the fundamental nature of this problem.

zh: 我做饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zuò fàn.
en: I'm cooking.

zh: 她每天做作业两小时。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān zuò zuòyè liǎng xiǎoshí.
en: She does her homework for two hours every day.

zh: 虽然很累，但他还是坚持做完了工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì tā háishi jiānchí zuòwán le gōngzuò.
en: Even though he was exhausted, he still insisted on finishing the work.

zh: 他决定做一个改变，因为现在的生活让他不满意。
pinyin: Tā juéding zuò yī ge gǎibiàn, yīnwèi xiànzài de shēnghuó ràng tā búmǎnyì.
en: He decided to make a change because he was unsatisfied with his current life.

zh: 与其抱怨，不如主动做出调整来适应新环境。
pinyin: Yǔqī bàoyuàn, búrú zhǔdòng zuòchū tiáozhěng lái shìyìng xīn huánjìng.
en: Rather than complaining, it's better to actively make adjustments to adapt to the new environment.

zh: 请给我一杯水。
pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yī bēi shuǐ.
en: Please give me a glass of water.

zh: 妈妈每天都给我做早饭。
pinyin: Māma měi tiān dōu gěi wǒ zuò zǎofàn.
en: My mom makes breakfast for me every day.

zh: 因为天气很热，我给植物浇了水。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, wǒ gěi zhíwù jiāole shuǐ.
en: Because it was so hot, I watered the plants.

zh: 老师给我们讲解了这个语法问题的重要性。
pinyin: Lǎoshī gěi wǒmen jiǎngjiě le zhège yǔfǎ wèntí de zhòngyàoxìng.
en: The teacher explained to us why this grammar point is important.

zh: 这部电影给了我很多启发，让我重新思考人生的意义。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng gěile wǒ hěnduō qǐfā, ràng wǒ chóngxīn sīkǎo rénshēng de yìyì.
en: This film gave me a lot of insights and made me reconsider what life is all about.

zh: 我有一个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī gè píngguǒ.
en: I have an apple.

zh: 昨天我买了一个新书包。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎile yī gè xīn shūbāo.
en: Yesterday I bought a new school bag.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我们待在一个咖啡馆里。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒmen dāi zài yī gè kāfēiguǎn lǐ.
en: Because it was raining, we stayed in a café.

zh: 虽然他只工作了一个月，但是已经学到了很多东西。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐ gōngzuòle yī gè yuè, dànshi yǐjīng xuéedàole hěnduō dōngxi.
en: Although he's only been working for a month, he's already learned a lot.

zh: 与其花一个小时在会议上讨论，不如直接发邮件解决这个问题。
pinyin: Yǔqī huā yī gè xiǎoshí zài huìyì shang tǎolùn, búrú zhíjiē fā yóujiàn jiějué zhège wèntí.
en: Rather than spend an hour discussing this in a meeting, it's better to just send an email and settle it.

zh: 我上学了。
pinyin: Wǒ shàng xué le.
en: I went to school.

zh: 昨天我在公车上看到了你。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài gōngchē shang kàndàole nǐ.
en: I saw you on the bus yesterday.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我们上不了山。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒmen shang búliǎo shān.
en: Because it rained, we couldn't go up the mountain.

zh: 虽然他工作很忙，但他上周还是抽出时间陪家人。
pinyin: Suīrán tā gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì tā shàng zhōu háishi chōuchū shíjiān péi jiārén.
en: Although he's been swamped with work, he still made time to spend with his family last week.

zh: 自从他上了管理岗位以后，就开始意识到沟通有多重要。
pinyin: Zìcóng tā shàngle guǎnlǐ gǎngwèi yǐhòu, jiù kāishǐ yìshi dào gōutōng yǒuduō zhòngyào.
en: Ever since he moved into a management position, he's realized just how crucial communication really is.

zh: 你们好！
pinyin: Nǐmen hǎo!
en: Hello, everyone!

zh: 你们今天吃什么？
pinyin: Nǐmen jīntiān chī shénme?
en: What are you all eating today?

zh: 因为你们都很忙，所以我们明天再开会。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐmen dōu hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒmen míngtiān zài kāihuì.
en: Because you're all busy, we'll have the meeting again tomorrow.

zh: 虽然你们已经完成了任务，但还需要检查一遍。
pinyin: Suīrán nǐmen yǐjīng wánchéngle rènwu, dàn háishi xūyào jiǎnchá yī biàn.
en: Although you've already finished the task, it still needs to be checked over once.

zh: 你们要是想在这个行业里成功，就得持之以恒地学习。
pinyin: Nǐmen yàoshi xiǎng zài zhège hángyè lǐ chénggōng, jiù děi chízhī yǐ héng de xuéxí.
en: If you want to succeed in this industry, you've got to keep learning with unwavering commitment.

zh: 我吃过米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ chīguo mǐfàn.
en: I have eaten rice before.

zh: 昨天我过了一个很好的生日。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ guòle yīgè hěn hǎo de shēngrì.
en: I had a really great birthday yesterday.

zh: 虽然我没过过春节，但是我听说很有意思。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ méi guòguo Chūnjié, dànshi wǒ tīngshuō hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Although I've never celebrated Spring Festival, I've heard it's really interesting.

zh: 他开车经过我家的时候，我们互相挥手打招呼。
pinyin: Tā kāichē jīngguò wǒ jiā de shíhou, wǒmen hùxiāng huīshǒu dǎ zhāohu.
en: When he drove past my house, we waved and said hello to each other.

zh: 通过这次项目的合作，我们发现彼此有很多共同的想法。
pinyin: Tōngguò zhè cì xiàngmù de hézuò, wǒmen fāxiàn bǐcǐ yǒu hěnduō gòngtóng de xiǎngfǎ.
en: Through collaborating on this project, we discovered we had a lot of ideas in common.

zh: 我没有苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu píngguǒ.
en: I don't have an apple.

zh: 昨天我没有去学校。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ méiyǒu qù xuéxiào.
en: I didn't go to school yesterday.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但是没有好好学习。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, dànshì méiyǒu hǎohāo xuéxí.
en: Although he's clever, he didn't study hard.

zh: 因为没有提前准备，所以会议推迟了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu tíqián zhǔnbèi, suǒyǐ huìyì tuīchíle.
en: Because there was no advance preparation, the meeting got postponed.

zh: 他说没有钱，但我知道那只是借口而已。
pinyin: Tā shuō méiyǒu qián, dàn wǒ zhīdào nà zhǐshì jièkǒu éryǐ.
en: He says he has no money, but I know that's just an excuse.

zh: 我得到一个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ dédào yī gè píngguǒ.
en: I got an apple.

zh: 昨天我得到了一份很好的工作。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ dédàole yī fèn hěn hǎo de gōngzuò.
en: I got a really good job yesterday.

zh: 因为他学习很努力，所以他得到了老师的表扬。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā xuéxí hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ tā dédàole lǎoshī de biǎoyáng.
en: Because he studied hard, he received praise from his teacher.

zh: 虽然这个项目很困难，但是团队最后还是得到了很好的结果。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège xiàngmù hěn kùnnan, dànshì tuánduì zuìhòu háishi dédàole hěn hǎo de jiéguǒ.
en: Although the project was difficult, the team still managed to achieve excellent results in the end.

zh: 他通过多年的坚持和努力，终于得到了行业内的认可和尊重。
pinyin: Tā tōngguò duōnián de jiānchí hé nǔlì, zh终于 dédàole hángyè nèi de rènkě hé zūnzhòng.
en: Through years of persistence and hard work, he finally earned recognition and respect within the industry.

zh: 我看电视。
pinyin: Wǒ kàn diànshì.
en: I'm watching TV.

zh: 昨天我看了一部好电影。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kànle yī bù hǎo diànyǐng.
en: I watched a great movie yesterday.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但我还是看到了彩虹。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dànshì wǒ háishi kàndàole cǎihóng.
en: Even though the weather was bad, I still managed to see a rainbow.

zh: 医生仔细地看了我的检查结果后，说一切都很正常。
pinyin: Yīshēng zǐxì de kànle wǒ de jiǎnchá jiéguǒ hòu, shuō yīqiè dōu hěn zhèngcháng.
en: After carefully reviewing my test results, the doctor said everything was normal.

zh: 从这个角度看，他们的建议其实很有道理，值得我们认真考虑。
pinyin: Cóng zhège jiǎodù kàn, tāmen de jiànyì qíshí hěn yǒu dàolǐ, zhídé wǒmen rènzhēn kǎolǜ.
en: Looking at it from this perspective, their suggestion actually makes a lot of sense and deserves serious consideration.

zh: 这个苹果真红。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ zhēn hóng.
en: This apple is really red.

zh: 今天天气真好，我们去公园吧。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì zhēn hǎo, wǒmen qù gōngyuán ba.
en: The weather is really nice today—let's go to the park.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但他对工作真认真。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn tā duì gōngzuò zhēn rènzhēn.
en: Even though he's busy, he's genuinely serious about his work.

zh: 我以前不相信，直到自己经历了才知道是真的。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián búxiāngxìn, zhídào zìjǐ jīnglìle cái zhīdào shì zhēnde.
en: I didn't believe it before, but only after experiencing it myself did I realize it was actually true.

zh: 与其纸上谈兵，不如真正动手去解决问题。
pinyin: Yǔqī zhǐshang tánbīng, búrú zhēnzhèng dòngshǒu qù jiějué wèntí.
en: Rather than just talking about it in theory, it's better to actually roll up your sleeves and solve the problem.

zh: 我穿着红色的衣服。
pinyin: Wǒ chuānzhe hóngsè de yīfu.
en: I'm wearing a red shirt.

zh: 他昨天看着电视吃晚饭。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān kànzhe diànshì chī wǎnfàn.
en: Yesterday he watched TV while eating dinner.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但是孩子们还在外面玩着。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì háizimen háizài wàimiàn wánzhe.
en: Even though the weather is cold, the kids are still playing outside.

zh: 经理拿着文件走进了会议室，开始介绍新项目。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ názhe wénjiàn zǒujìnle huìyìshì, kāishǐ jièshào xīn xiàngmù.
en: The manager entered the conference room holding documents and began presenting the new project.

zh: 尽管工作压力很大，他还是坚持着每天早上跑步的习惯。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn gōngzuò yālì hěn dà, tā háishi jiānchízhe měi tiān zǎoshang pǎobù de xíguàn.
en: Despite the high work pressure, he still maintains his habit of running every morning.

zh: 这是什么事？
pinyin: Zhè shì shénme shì?
en: What is this about?

zh: 昨天发生了一件有趣的事。
pinyin: Zuótiān fāshēngle yī jiàn yǒuqù de shì.
en: Something funny happened yesterday.

zh: 因为这件事很重要，所以我们得好好讨论。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ wǒmen děi hǎohāo tǎolùn.
en: Since this matter is important, we need to discuss it properly.

zh: 虽然这事儿不是你的责任，但你还是应该帮一下。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè shìr búshì nǐ de zérèn, dàn nǐ háishi yīnggāi bāng yīxià.
en: Even though this isn't really your responsibility, you should still lend a hand.

zh: 他处理这件事的方式让我印象深刻，看来他经验丰富。
pinyin: Tā chǔlǐ zhè jiàn shì de fāngshì ràng wǒ yìnxiàng shēnkè, kànlái tā jīngyàn fēngfù.
en: The way he handled this matter really impressed me—clearly he's quite experienced.

zh: 这个苹果很好吃。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ hěn hǎochī.
en: This apple is delicious.

zh: 我昨天买的这个书包很便宜。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān mǎi de zhège shūbāo hěn piányi.
en: This backpack I bought yesterday was really cheap.

zh: 虽然这个工作很忙，但是薪水很好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì xīnshui hěn hǎo.
en: Although this job is demanding, the salary is really good.

zh: 这个办法虽然简单，但解决了很多问题。
pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ suīrán jiǎndān, dàn jiějuéle hěnduō wèntí.
en: This approach, while simple, actually solved a lot of problems.

zh: 这个计划乍一看不太现实，可实际执行起来效果出奇地好。
pinyin: Zhège jìhuà zhàyīkàn búliǎo xiànshí, kě shíjì zhíxíng qǐlai xiàoguǒ chūqī de hǎo.
en: This plan seems unrealistic at first glance, but it's turned out to work surprisingly well in practice.

zh: 你怎么了？
pinyin: Nǐ zěnme le?
en: What's wrong with you?

zh: 这个东西怎么用？
pinyin: Zhège dōngxi zěnme yòng?
en: How do you use this thing?

zh: 虽然很难，但我们怎么也要试试。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dàn wǒmen zěnme yě yào shìshi.
en: Even though it's difficult, we should at least try no matter what.

zh: 他怎么能在这么短的时间完成这个项目？
pinyin: Tā zěnme néng zài zhème duǎn de shíjiān wánchéng zhège xiàngmù?
en: How is he able to complete this project in such a short time?

zh: 无论怎么努力，有些人就是想不开。
pinyin: Wúlùn zěnme nǔlì, yǒuxiē rén jiùshi xiǎng bu kāi.
en: No matter how hard you try, some people just won't see reason.

zh: 现在我吃饭。
pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ chīfàn.
en: I'm eating now.

zh: 现在是下午三点钟。
pinyin: Xiànzài shì xiàwǔ sān diǎn zhōng.
en: It's three o'clock in the afternoon right now.

zh: 虽然现在很冷，但是我们还是要去公园。
pinyin: Suīrán xiànzài hěn lěng, búshì wǒmen háishi yào qù gōngyuán.
en: Even though it's cold now, we still need to go to the park.

zh: 现在很多年轻人喜欢用手机看新闻。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō niánqīng rén xǐhuān yòng shǒujī kàn xīnwén.
en: Nowadays a lot of young people like to read news on their phones.

zh: 与其等待机会，不如现在就开始努力改变自己。
pinyin: Yǔqī děngdài jīhuì, búrú xiànzài jiù kāishǐ nǔlì gǎibiàn zìjǐ.
en: Rather than waiting for opportunity to come, why not start working hard to change yourself right now?

zh: 我可以吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ chī mǐfàn.
en: I can eat rice.

zh: 今天你可以不来上班。
pinyin: Jīntiān nǐ kěyǐ búlái shàngbān.
en: You don't have to come to work today.

zh: 虽然很贵，但是质量很好，所以值得可以买。
pinyin: Suīránhěn guì, dànshì zhìliàng hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhídé kěyǐ mǎi.
en: Even though it's expensive, the quality is really good, so it's worth buying.

zh: 因为你有驾照，所以这辆车你可以开。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐ yǒu jiàzhào, suǒyǐ zhè liàng chē nǐ kěyǐ kāi.
en: Since you have a driver's license, you're allowed to drive this car.

zh: 虽然这个方案看起来简单，但实际操作中还是可以出现很多问题。
pinyin: Suīránzhège fāng'àn kàn qǐlai jiǎndān, dàn shíjì cāozuò zhōng háishi kěyǐ chūxiàn hěnduō wèntí.
en: Although this plan looks straightforward, in actual practice quite a few problems can still come up.

zh: 我要点一杯茶。
pinyin: Wǒ yào diǎn yī bēi chá.
en: I'd like to order a cup of tea.

zh: 昨天晚上我点了红烧肉。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ diǎnle hóngshāo ròu.
en: Last night I ordered braised pork.

zh: 因为今天很忙，所以我只点了一点米饭。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒ zhǐ diǎnle yīdiǎn mǐfàn.
en: Because I'm busy today, I only ordered a little rice.

zh: 去餐厅吃饭的时候，我点了几个特色菜。
pinyin: Qù cāntīng chīfàn de shíhou, wǒ diǎnle jǐ ge tèsè cài.
en: When I went to the restaurant, I ordered several house specialties.

zh: 虽然菜单上有很多选择，但我还是习惯点那几道家常菜。
pinyin: Suīrán càidān shang yǒu hěnduō xuǎnzé, dàn wǒ háishi xíguàn diǎn nà jǐ dào jiācháng cài.
en: Although the menu has plenty of options, I'm still in the habit of ordering those same home-style dishes.

zh: 你的书呢？
pinyin: Nǐ de shū ne?
en: Where's your book?

zh: 昨天你去哪里了呢？
pinyin: Zuótiān nǐ qù nǎlǐ le ne?
en: Where did you go yesterday?

zh: 虽然很累，但他还是坚持工作呢。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn léi, dàn tā háishi jiānchí gōngzuò ne.
en: Even though he was tired, he kept on working anyway.

zh: 既然你不想去，那我们就在家看电影呢。
pinyin: Jìrán nǐ búxiǎng qù, nà wǒmen jiù zàijiā kàn diànyǐng ne.
en: Since you don't want to go out, let's just watch a movie at home then.

zh: 关于这个问题的看法，不同的人有不同的想法呢。
pinyin: Guānyú zhège wèntí de kànfǎ, búzhtóng de rén yǒu búzhtóng de xiǎngfǎ ne.
en: When it comes to this issue, different people have different opinions about it.

zh: 如果你饿了，吃米饭。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ è le, chī mǐfàn.
en: If you're hungry, eat rice.

zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去公园。
pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān xiàyǔ, wǒmen jiù búqù gōngyuán.
en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go to the park.

zh: 如果你的时候有空，可以来我家吃晚饭。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ de shíhou yǒu kòng, kěyǐ lái wǒ jiā chī wǎnfàn.
en: If you have free time, you can come to my place for dinner.

zh: 如果你想学好中文，就需要每天练习说和听。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng xuéhǎo zhōngwén, jiù xūyào měitiān liànxí shuō hé tīng.
en: If you want to learn Chinese well, you need to practice speaking and listening every day.

zh: 如果没有充分的准备，即使再努力也很难成功。
pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu chōngfèn de zhǔnbèi, jíshǐ zài nǔlì yě hěn nán chénggōng.
en: Without adequate preparation, even with great effort, success is hard to come by.

zh: 我只喝水。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ hē shuǐ.
en: I only drink water.

zh: 她今天只吃了一个苹果。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān zhǐ chīle yī ge píngguǒ.
en: She only ate one apple today.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但他只用了十分钟完成作业。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn tā zhǐ yòngle shí fēnzhōng wánchéng zuòyè.
en: Although he's very busy, he only took ten minutes to finish his homework.

zh: 因为预算有限，公司这次只能招聘三个新员工。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yùsuàn yǒuxiàn, gōngsī zhè cì zhǐnéng zhāopìn sān ge xīn yuángōng.
en: Because the budget is limited, the company can only hire three new employees this time.

zh: 与其纠结过去，不如只专注于当下的机会和挑战。
pinyin: Yǔqī jiūjié guòqù, búrú zhǐ zhuānzhù yú dāngxià de jīhuì hé tiǎozhàn.
en: Rather than dwelling on the past, it's better to focus solely on the opportunities and challenges at hand.

zh: 别吃那个。
pinyin: Bié chī nàge.
en: Don't eat that.

zh: 明天别来了，我很忙。
pinyin: Míngtiān bié lái le, wǒ hěn máng.
en: Don't come tomorrow—I'm really busy.

zh: 虽然很晚了，但别睡觉，我们继续玩。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn wǎn le, dàn bié shuìjiào, wǒmen jìxù wán.
en: Even though it's late, don't go to sleep—let's keep playing.

zh: 别在工作的时候玩手机，这样效率会下降。
pinyin: Bié zài gōngzuò de shíhou wán shǒujī, zhèyàng xiàolǜ huì xiàjiàng.
en: Don't fool around with your phone while working—it'll make you less productive.

zh: 我们别总是依赖别人的帮助，应该学会独立解决问题。
pinyin: Wǒmen bié zǒngshì yīlài biérén de bāngzhù, yīnggāi xuéhuì dúlì jiějué wèntí.
en: We shouldn't always rely on other people's help—we need to learn to solve problems independently.

zh: 哦,我喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Ó, wǒ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: Oh, I like eating rice.

zh: 哦,你明天要去学校啊。
pinyin: Ó, nǐ míngtiān yào qù xuéxiào a.
en: Oh, so you're going to school tomorrow.

zh: 哦,因为下雨了,所以他今天没来。
pinyin: Ó, yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ tā jīntiān méi lái.
en: Oh, I see — he didn't come today because of the rain.

zh: 哦,你是说那个新来的同事啊,我听说过他的名字。
pinyin: Ó, nǐ shì shuō nàge xīn lái de tóngshì a, wǒ tīngshuō guo tā de míngzi.
en: Oh, you mean that new colleague? Yeah, I've heard his name before.

zh: 哦,原来如此,难怪你对这个项目这么有热情呢。
pinyin: Ó, yuánlái rúcǐ, nánguài nǐ duì zhège xiàngmù zhème yǒu règíng ne.
en: Ah, so that's how it is — no wonder you're so passionate about this project.

zh: 我喜欢苹果,但不喜欢香蕉。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ, dàn búxǐhuān xiāngjiāo.
en: I like apples, but I don't like bananas.

zh: 他今天很累,但还是去上班了。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān hěn lèi, dàn háishi qù shàngbān le.
en: He was very tired today, but he still went to work.

zh: 虽然天气不好,但我们还是决定出去玩了。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dàn wǒmen háishi juédinì chūqù wán le.
en: Although the weather wasn't great, we decided to go out and have fun anyway.

zh: 这个工作很困难,但他通过努力最后还是完成了。
pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò hěn kùnnan, dàn tā tōngguò nǔlì zuìhòu háishi wánchéng le.
en: This job was very difficult, but through hard work he managed to finish it in the end.

zh: 公司的薪水不算高,但福利待遇和发展机会都不错,所以大家都很满意。
pinyin: Gōngsī de xīnshui búsuàn gāo, dàn fúlì dàiyù hé fāzhǎn jīhuì dōu búcuò, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu hěn mǎnyì.
en: The company's salary isn't particularly high, but the benefits and career opportunities are pretty good, so everyone is quite satisfied.

zh: 我的书被狗吃了。
pinyin: Wǒ de shū bèi gǒu chī le.
en: My book was eaten by the dog.

zh: 昨天她的自行车被偷了。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā de zìxíngchē bèi tōu le.
en: Her bicycle was stolen yesterday.

zh: 虽然窗户被打破了，但是他没有道歉。
pinyin: Suīrán chuānghu bèi dǎpò le, dànshì tā méiyǒu dàoqiàn.
en: Even though the window was broken, he didn't apologize.

zh: 这个项目被公司高层否决以后，团队士气受到了打击。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù bèi gōngsī gāocéng fǒujué yǐhòu, tuánduì shìqì shòudào le dǎjī.
en: After the project was rejected by senior management, the team's morale took a hit.

zh: 他的提案虽然一开始被否定，但最后还是被采纳了，算是因祸得福。
pinyin: Tā de tíàn suīrán yī kāishǐ bèi fǒudìng, dàn zuìhòu háishi bèi cǎinà le, suàn shì yīnhuò défú.
en: His proposal was rejected at first, but in the end it got adopted—you could say he turned a setback into an opportunity.

zh: 我走回家。
pinyin: Wǒ zǒu huí jiā.
en: I'm walking home.

zh: 她每天走路去上班。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǒu lù qù shàng bān.
en: She walks to work every day.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我们走快一点。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xià yǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒmen zǒu kuài yīdiǎn.
en: Because it's raining, we're walking faster.

zh: 虽然很累，但是他还是坚持走完了全程。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì tā háishi jiānchí zǒu wán le quán chéng.
en: Although he was exhausted, he still insisted on finishing the whole route.

zh: 在这个城市生活了十年，我对每条街道都走得很熟悉。
pinyin: Zài zhège chéngshì shēnghuó le shí nián, wǒ duì měi tiáo jiēdào dōu zǒu de hěn shúxī.
en: After living in this city for ten years, I know every street like the back of my hand.

zh: 这个苹果太甜了。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ tài tián le.
en: This apple is too sweet.

zh: 今天天气太热,我不想出门。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì tài rè, wǒ búxiǎng chūmén.
en: The weather is too hot today, so I don't want to go out.

zh: 虽然这件衣服很漂亮,但是太贵了,我买不起。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiàn yīfu hěn piàoliang, dànshi tài guì le, wǒ mǎi búqǐ.
en: Although this dress is beautiful, it's too expensive and I can't afford it.

zh: 他工作太忙,几乎没有时间陪家人,这样长期下去不太健康。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò tài máng, jīhū méiyǒu shíjiān péi jiārén, zhèyàng chángqī xiàqù búTài jiànkāng.
en: He's too busy with work and barely has time for his family; continuing like this long-term isn't very healthy.

zh: 这个项目的预算太紧张了,我们需要重新评估成本,否则很难按时完成。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de yùsuàn tài jǐnzhāng le, wǒmen xūyào chóngxīn píngēstimate chéngběn, fǒuzé hěn nán ànshí wánchéng.
en: The budget for this project is way too tight; we need to reassess the costs, or it'll be really hard to finish on schedule.

zh: 我喜欢这样吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhèyàng chīfàn.
en: I like eating this way.

zh: 每天早上我都这样刷牙。
pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang wǒ dōu zhèyàng shuāyá.
en: I brush my teeth like this every morning.

zh: 虽然天气冷，但他还是这样穿衣服去上班。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì lěng, dànshì tā háishi zhèyàng chuānyīfu qù shàngbān.
en: Although it's cold, he still dresses like this to go to work.

zh: 如果你一直这样做事，肯定会遇到很多问题。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yīzhí zhèyàng zuòshì, kěndìng huì yùdào hěnduō wèntí.
en: If you keep handling things this way, you'll definitely run into a lot of problems.

zh: 与其抱怨现状，不如像他那样积极改变，这样才能真正进步。
pinyin: Yǔqī bàoyuàn xiànzhuàng, búrú xiàng tā nàyàng jījí gǎibiàn, zhèyàng cáinéng zhēnzhèng jìnbù.
en: Rather than complaining about how things are, it's better to change actively like he does—that's the only way to truly make progress.

zh: 我家里有一只猫。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā lǐ yǒu yī zhī māo.
en: I have a cat at home.

zh: 昨天我在书里找到了答案。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài shū lǐ zhǎodào le dáàn.
en: Yesterday I found the answer in the book.

zh: 虽然房间里很小，但是很舒服。
pinyin: Suīrán fángjiān lǐ hěn xiǎo, dànshì hěn shūfu.
en: Even though the room is small, it's very comfortable.

zh: 因为时间紧张，我只在公司里工作到了晚上八点。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíjiān jǐnzhāng, wǒ zhǐ zài gōngsī lǐ gōngzuò dàole wǎnshang bā diǎn.
en: Because time was tight, I only managed to work at the office until 8 PM.

zh: 这家公司虽然在竞争激烈的市场里，但凭借创新的产品获得了不少客户的信任。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán zài jìngzhēng jīliè de shìchǎng lǐ, dàn píngjiè chuàngxīn de chǎnpǐn huòdéle búshǎo kèhù de xìnrèn.
en: Although this company operates in a fiercely competitive market, it has earned considerable customer trust through innovative products.

zh: 我跟妈妈去买菜。
pinyin: Wǒ gēn māmā qù mǎi cài.
en: I'm going to buy groceries with my mom.

zh: 昨天我跟朋友一起去了公园。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ gēn péngyou yìqǐ qùle gōngyuán.
en: Yesterday I went to the park together with a friend.

zh: 因为他跟我的想法不一样，所以我们讨论了很久。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā gēn wǒ de xiǎngfǎ búyīyàng, suǒyǐ wǒmen tǎolùnle hěnjiǔ.
en: Because his opinion differed from mine, we discussed it for a long time.

zh: 在工作中，我发现跟同事沟通很重要，虽然有时候有分歧。
pinyin: Zài gōngzuò zhōng, wǒ fāxiàn gēn tóngshì gōutōng hěn zhòngyào, suīrán yǒushíhou yǒu fēnqī.
en: At work, I've found that communicating with colleagues is really important, even though we sometimes disagree.

zh: 与其跟那些消极的人往来，不如多花时间跟有目标的人交往。
pinyin: Yǔqī gēn nàxiē xiāojí de rén wǎnglái, búrú duō huā shíjiān gēn yǒu mùbiāo de rén jiāowǎng.
en: Rather than spending time with negative people, it's better to build relationships with people who have ambition.

zh: 妈妈告诉我吃饭。
pinyin: Māma gàosu wǒ chīfàn.
en: Mom told me to eat.

zh: 老师今天告诉我们一个新的故事。
pinyin: Lǎoshī jīntiān gàosu wǒmen yī ge xīn de gùshi.
en: The teacher told us a new story today.

zh: 因为他迟到了，所以朋友告诉他会议的时间。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā chídào le, suǒyǐ péngyou gàosu tā huìyì de shíjiān.
en: Because he was late, his friend told him when the meeting was.

zh: 医生详细地告诉患者应该怎样调理身体。
pinyin: Yīshēng xiáng细 de gàosu huànzhě yīnggāi zěnyàng tiáolǐ shēntǐ.
en: The doctor explained in detail to the patient how they should take care of their health.

zh: 同事们私底下告诉我这个项目风险很大，我得谨慎对待。
pinyin: Tóngshìmen sī dǐxia gàosu wǒ zhège xiàngmù fēngxiǎn hěn dà, wǒ děi jǐnshèn duìdài.
en: My colleagues told me off the record that this project has serious risks, so I need to handle it carefully.

zh: 因为下雨，我不去。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒ búqù.
en: I'm not going because it's raining.

zh: 因为没有钱，他买不了新车。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu qián, tā mǎi búliǎo xīn chē.
en: He can't buy a new car because he doesn't have money.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但是因为想运动，我还是去跑步了。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì yīnwèi xiǎng yùndòng, wǒ háishi qù pǎobù le.
en: Even though the weather was cold, I still went for a run because I wanted to exercise.

zh: 因为他经常迟到，老板决定给他减薪。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā jīngcháng chídào, lǎobǎn juédìng gěi tā jiǎn xīn.
en: Because he's always late, the boss decided to cut his salary.

zh: 因为缺乏有效沟通，两个部门之间产生了不少误会。
pinyin: Yīnwèi quēfá yǒuxiào gōutōng, liǎng ge bùmén zhījiān chǎnshēng le búshǎo wùhuì.
en: Due to a lack of effective communication, quite a few misunderstandings arose between the two departments.

zh: 我自己喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zìjǐ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: I myself like eating rice.

zh: 他每天自己做早饭。
pinyin: Tā měitiān zìjǐ zuò zǎofàn.
en: He makes his own breakfast every day.

zh: 虽然很累，但她还是自己收拾房间。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì tā háishi zìjǐ shōushī fángjiān.
en: Although she was exhausted, she tidied up the room herself anyway.

zh: 因为工作太忙，他没有时间照顾自己的健康。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, tā méiyǒu shíjiān zhàogu zìjǐ de jiànkāng.
en: Because work is so busy, he doesn't have time to look after his own health.

zh: 与其总是依赖别人，不如学会自己解决问题。
pinyin: Yǔqī zǒngshi yīlài biérén, búrú xuéhuì zìjǐ jiějué wèntí.
en: Rather than always depending on others, it's better to learn to solve problems on your own.

zh: 我再吃一个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ zài chī yī ge píngguǒ.
en: I'm going to eat another apple.

zh: 你先休息，我再来找你。
pinyin: Nǐ xiān xiūxi, wǒ zài lái zhǎo nǐ.
en: You rest first, and I'll come find you later.

zh: 因为今天很累，所以我再睡一会儿。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān hěn lèi, suǒyǐ wǒ zài shuì yī huǐr.
en: Because I'm tired today, I'm going to sleep a bit longer.

zh: 虽然很晚了，但他再看了一遍那个文件。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn wǎn le, dàn tā zài kàn le yī biàn nàge wénjiàn.
en: Even though it was late, he looked over that document one more time.

zh: 与其担心，不如再次检查数据能否解决问题。
pinyin: Yǔqī dānxin, búrú zài cì jiǎnchá shùjù néngfǒu jiějué wèntí.
en: Rather than worry, it's better to check the data once more and see if that solves the problem.

zh: 我喜欢听音乐。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān tīng yīnyuè.
en: I like listening to music.

zh: 昨天我听了一个有趣的故事。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ tīngle yīgè yǒuqù de gùshì.
en: Yesterday I heard an interesting story.

zh: 虽然我听不懂他说的话，但是我很认真地听。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ tīng bu dǒng tā shuō de huà, dànshì wǒ hěn rènzhēn de tīng.
en: Although I don't understand what he's saying, I'm listening very carefully.

zh: 在会议上我们都认真听了经理的意见和建议。
pinyin: Zài huìyì shang wǒmen dōu rènzhēn tīngle jīnglǐ de yìjiàn hé jiànyì.
en: In the meeting, we all listened carefully to the manager's views and suggestions.

zh: 他说得再好听，我也不会相信没有证据的承诺。
pinyin: Tā shuō de zài hǎotīng, wǒ yě bu huì xiāngxìn méiyǒu zhèngjù de chéngnuò.
en: No matter how sweet his words sound, I won't trust a promise without evidence.

zh: 这里有苹果。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu píngguǒ.
en: There are apples here.

zh: 早上我在这里吃早饭。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ zài zhèlǐ chī zǎofàn.
en: In the morning, I eat breakfast here.

zh: 因为这里很安静，所以我喜欢在这里工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhèlǐ hěn ānjìng, suǒyǐ wǒ xǐhuān zài zhèlǐ gōngzuò.
en: Because it's quiet here, I like to work in this place.

zh: 虽然这里的价格有点贵，但是服务质量很不错。
pinyin: Suīrán zhèlǐ de jiàgé yǒudiǎn guì, dànshì fúwù zhìliàng hěn búcuò.
en: Although the prices here are a bit high, the service quality is quite good.

zh: 这里聚集了许多创意人才，他们正在改变这个行业。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ jùjíle xǔduō chuàngyì réncái, tāmen zhèngzài gǎibiàn zhège hángyè.
en: This place has drawn together many creative talents who are transforming the industry.

zh: 我吃饭很快。
pinyin: Wǒ chīfàn hěn kuài.
en: I eat very quickly.

zh: 早上我走路很快去上班。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ zǒulù hěn kuài qù shàngbān.
en: In the morning I walk fast to get to work.

zh: 因为天气很热，所以他跑得很快。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, suǒyǐ tā pǎo de hěn kuài.
en: Because it was so hot, he ran very fast.

zh: 虽然他学中文的时间不长，但是进步很快。
pinyin: Suīrán tā xué zhōngwén de shíjiān búcháng, dànshì jìnbù hěn kuài.
en: Although he hasn't been studying Chinese for very long, his progress is rapid.

zh: 现在社交媒体传播信息的速度太快了，很难分辨真假。
pinyin: Xiànzài shèjiāo méitǐ chuánbō xìnxī de sùdù tài kuài le, hěn nán fēnbiàn zhēnjiǎ.
en: Nowadays social media spreads information so fast that it's hard to tell what's real and what's fake.

zh: 谁吃了我的苹果？
pinyin: Shéi chīle wǒ de píngguǒ?
en: Who ate my apple?

zh: 昨天谁来你家玩了？
pinyin: Zuótiān shéi lái nǐ jiā wánle?
en: Who came to your place yesterday to hang out?

zh: 虽然我不知道谁说的，但是这个主意真的很好。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ búzhīdào shéi shuō de, dànshì zhège zhǔyì zhēnde hěn hǎo.
en: Although I don't know who said it, this idea is genuinely really good.

zh: 如果你不确定谁负责这个项目，可以问一下你的经理。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ búquèdìng shéi fùzé zhège xiàngmù, kěyǐ wèn yíxià nǐ de jīnglǐ.
en: If you're not sure who's responsible for this project, you can ask your manager.

zh: 在这个公司里，谁说了算往往取决于你的资历和人脉，而不仅仅是职位。
pinyin: Zài zhège gōngsī lǐ, shéi shuōle suàn wǎngwǎng qǔjuéyú nǐ de zīlì he rénmài, érbújǐnjǐng shì zhíwèi.
en: In this company, who has the final say often depends on your experience and connections, not just your job title.

zh: 我喜欢苹果,但是不喜欢香蕉。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ, dànshì búxǐhuān xiāngjiāo.
en: I like apples, but I don't like bananas.

zh: 今天天气很好,但是有点冷。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, dànshì yǒudiǎn lěng.
en: The weather is nice today, but it's a bit cold.

zh: 虽然她很累,但是她还是去公司工作了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dànshì tā háishi qù gōngsī gōngzuò le.
en: Although she was tired, she still went to work at the company anyway.

zh: 这家餐厅的菜很好吃,但是服务员的态度不太好。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài hěn hǎochī, dànshì fúwùyuán de tàidù búhuà hǎo.
en: The food at this restaurant is delicious, but the waiters' attitude isn't very good.

zh: 他的英文水平确实不错,但是口音还是比较明显。
pinyin: Tā de yīngwén shuǐpíng quèshí búcuò, dànshì kǒuyīn háishi bǐjiào míngxiǎn.
en: His English is actually pretty good, but his accent is still quite noticeable.

zh: 我吃了很多米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ chīle hěnduō mǐfàn.
en: I ate a lot of rice.

zh: 今天天气很多云，可能会下雨。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěnduō yún, kěnéng huì xiàyǔ.
en: It's very cloudy today, so it might rain.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但是他还是抽出了很多时间陪家人。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi chōuchūle hěnduō shíjiān péi jiārén.
en: Even though he's very busy, he still makes a lot of time to spend with his family.

zh: 因为这个项目需要多个部门合作，所以沟通变得特别重要。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhège xiàngmù xūyào duōge bùmén hézuò, suǒyǐ gōutōng biànde tèbié zhòngyào.
en: Since this project requires cooperation from multiple departments, communication becomes especially important.

zh: 她的经验多得很，在行业里早就是个小有名气的专家了。
pinyin: Tā de jīngyàn duō de hěn, zài hángyè lǐ zǎojiù shì ge xiǎoyǒu míngqì de zhuānjiā le.
en: She has vast experience and has long been a somewhat well-known expert in the industry.

zh: 我用筷子吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yòng kuàizi chīfàn.
en: I eat with chopsticks.

zh: 早上我用牙刷刷牙。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ yòng yáshuā shuāyá.
en: In the morning, I brush my teeth with a toothbrush.

zh: 因为没有钥匙，我用卡打开了门。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu yàoshi, wǒ yòng kǎ dǎkāile mén.
en: Because I didn't have a key, I used a card to open the door.

zh: 虽然这个方法不完美，但很多人还是用它来解决问题。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège fāngfǎ búwánměi, dàn hěnduō rén háishi yòngtā lái jiějué wèntí.
en: Although this method isn't perfect, a lot of people still use it to solve the problem.

zh: 他用了三年时间学习编程，现在已经能独立完成项目。
pinyin: Tā yòngle sān nián shíjiān xuéxí biānchéng, xiànzài yǐjīng néng dúlì wánchéng xiàngmù.
en: He spent three years learning to code, and now he can independently complete projects.

zh: 我小时候喜欢吃糖。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎo shíhou xǐhuān chī táng.
en: When I was little, I liked eating candy.

zh: 你什么时候来我家吃饭？
pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhou lái wǒ jiā chīfàn?
en: When are you coming to my house to eat?

zh: 因为天气很热的时候，我们都喜欢喝冰水。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè de shíhou, wǒmen dōu xǐhuān hē bīng shuǐ.
en: When the weather is very hot, we all like to drink ice water.

zh: 那个时候我们还没有智能手机，生活很不一样。
pinyin: Nàge shíhou wǒmen háishi méiyǒu zhìnéng shǒujī, shēnghuó hěn búyīyàng.
en: Back then we didn't have smartphones yet, and life was quite different.

zh: 每当工作压力大的时候，我就想起家乡的美食能让我放松。
pinyin: Měi dāng gōngzuò yālì dà de shíhou, wǒ jiù xiǎng qǐ jiāxiāng de měishí néng ràng wǒ fàngsōng.
en: Whenever work stress gets heavy, I remember how my hometown's food helps me unwind.

zh: 我在树下吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zài shù xià chīfàn.
en: I'm eating under the tree.

zh: 下雨的时候，我不想出去。
pinyin: Xiàyǔ de shíhou, wǒ búxiǎng chūqu.
en: When it rains, I don't want to go out.

zh: 虽然今天下雪，但是孩子们还是在楼下玩。
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān xiàxuě, dànshi háizi men háishi zài lóu xià wán.
en: Even though it's snowing today, the kids are still playing downstairs.

zh: 因为工作太忙，他这个月一直没有下来过。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, tā zhège yuè yìzhí méiyǒu xiàlaiguò.
en: Because work has been so busy, he hasn't come down once this whole month.

zh: 老板决定降低价格，这个举动下来对销售很有帮助。
pinyin: Lǎobǎn juédìng jiàngdī jiàgé, zhège jǔdòng xiàlaì duì xiāoshòu hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
en: The boss decided to lower prices, and this move turned out to really help sales.

zh: 我已经吃饭了。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng chīfàn le.
en: I've already eaten.

zh: 他已经去学校了，现在在教室。
pinyin: Tā yǐjīng qù xuéxiào le, xiànzài zài jiàoshì.
en: He's already gone to school and is in the classroom now.

zh: 虽然很晚了，但他已经完成了作业。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn wǎn le, dàn tā yǐjīng wánchéng le zuòyè.
en: Although it's very late, he's already finished his homework.

zh: 因为交通堵塞，会议已经推迟到下午三点。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jiāotōng dǔsè, huìyì yǐjīng tuīchíh dào xiàwǔ sān diǎn.
en: Because of traffic congestion, the meeting has already been postponed until three in the afternoon.

zh: 这个项目的预算已经超支了，我们需要重新评估成本。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de yùsuàn yǐjīng chāozhī le, wǒmen xūyào chóngxīn píngguǐ chéngběn.
en: This project's budget has already overrun, so we need to reassess the costs.

zh: 谢谢你的苹果。
pinyin: Xièxie nǐ de píngguǒ.
en: Thank you for the apple.

zh: 昨天你帮我，我很谢谢你。
pinyin: Zuótiān nǐ bāng wǒ, wǒ hěn xièxie nǐ.
en: You helped me yesterday, and I really appreciate it.

zh: 因为你教我中文，所以我很谢谢你。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐ jiāo wǒ zhōngwén, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn xièxie nǐ.
en: Because you taught me Chinese, I'm really grateful to you.

zh: 虽然这个工作很困难，但是你的支持让我坚持下去，谢谢你。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò hěn kùnnan, dànshi nǐ de zhīchí ràng wǒ jiānchí xiàqù, xièxie nǐ.
en: Even though this job is difficult, your support helped me push through—thank you.

zh: 你在我最需要帮助的时候挺身而出，这份恩情我真的无法用言语表达，只能说谢谢你。
pinyin: Nǐ zài wǒ zuì xūyào bāngzhù de shíhou tǐngshēn érchū, zhè fèn ēnqíng wǒ zhēnde wúfǎ yòng yányǔ biǎodá, zhǐnéng shuō xièxie nǐ.
en: You stood up for me when I needed it most—I can't really express this debt of gratitude in words, so I'll just say thank you.

zh: 你为什么不吃饭？
pinyin: Nǐ wèishényàng bù chīfàn?
en: Why aren't you eating?

zh: 他今天为什么没有来上课？
pinyin: Tā jīntiān wèishényàng méiyǒu lái shàngkè?
en: Why didn't he come to class today?

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但是我还想知道你为什么穿这么少。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshi wǒ háishi xiǎng zhīdào nǐ wèishényàng chuān zhème shǎo.
en: Even though the weather is cold, I still want to know why you're wearing so little.

zh: 既然你已经决定辞职了，为什么还要继续犹豫呢？
pinyin: Jìrán nǐ yǐjīng juédìng cízhí le, wèishényàng háiyào jìxù yóuyù ne?
en: Since you've already decided to quit, why are you still hesitating?

zh: 我真不明白为什么有些人宁可吃亏也不愿意去改变自己的想法。
pinyin: Wǒ zhēn búmíngbai wèishényàng yǒuxiē rén níngkě chīkuī yě búyuànyì qù gǎibiàn zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
en: I really can't understand why some people would rather suffer losses than change their own minds.

zh: 我觉得这个苹果很好吃。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhège píngguǒ hěn hǎochī.
en: I think this apple tastes really good.

zh: 昨天我觉得有点累，所以早点睡觉了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ juéde yǒudiǎn lèi, suǒyǐ zǎodiǎn shuìjiào le.
en: I felt a bit tired yesterday, so I went to bed early.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但我觉得今天的公园很漂亮。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dàn wǒ juéde jīntiān de gōngyuán hěn piàoliang.
en: Even though it's cold out, I think the park looks really beautiful today.

zh: 我觉得他的想法虽然有意思，但不太现实。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde tā de xiǎngfǎ suīrán yǒu yìsi, dàn búzhào xiànshí.
en: I think his ideas are interesting, but they're not very realistic.

zh: 经过这次经历，我觉得人生需要有点冒险精神才能有意义。
pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì jīnglì, wǒ juéde rénshēng xūyào yǒudiǎn màoxiǎn jīngshén cái néng yǒu yìyì.
en: After going through this experience, I feel like life needs some adventurous spirit to be meaningful.

zh: 今天天气很好。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.
en: The weather is really nice today.

zh: 昨天我整天都在家里。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zhěngtiān dōu zài jiālǐ.
en: Yesterday I stayed home all day.

zh: 因为天下雨,所以我们没有去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiān xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen méiyǒu qù gōngyuán.
en: Because it rained, we didn't go to the park.

zh: 工作了一整天以后,他累得很想立刻休息。
pinyin: Gōngzuò le yī zhěngtiān yǐhòu, tā lèi de hěn xiǎng lìkè xiūxi.
en: After working a full day, he was so tired he just wanted to rest right away.

zh: 这几天他一直在忙项目的事,天天都得加班到很晚。
pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān tā yīzhí zài máng xiàngmù de shì, tiāntiān dōu děi jiābān dào hěn wǎn.
en: These past few days he's been swamped with the project, working late every single day.

zh: 她像妈妈。
pinyin: Tā xiàng māma.
en: She looks like her mom.

zh: 这个苹果像一个红球。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ xiàng yī ge hóng qiú.
en: This apple is like a red ball.

zh: 虽然他很小，但他像个大人一样懂事。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn xiǎo, dàn tā xiàng ge dàrén yīyàng dǒngshì.
en: Although he's young, he's sensible like an adult.

zh: 因为他的性格像父亲，所以别人经常把他们搞混。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā de xìnggé xiàng fùqin, suǒyǐ biérén jīngcháng bǎ tāmen gǎohùn.
en: Because his personality is like his father's, people often confuse them.

zh: 她的想法像个哲学家，总是能看穿人心。
pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ xiàng ge zhéxuéjiā, zǒngshì néng kànch穿 rénxīn.
en: Her way of thinking is like a philosopher's—she can always see through people.

zh: 这么冷吗？
pinyin: Zhème lěng ma?
en: Is it really this cold?

zh: 你怎么这么快就吃完了？
pinyin: Nǐ zěnme zhème kuài jiù chīwán le?
en: How did you finish eating so quickly?

zh: 因为下雨，所以路这么堵，我迟到了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ lù zhème dǔ, wǒ chídào le.
en: Because of the rain, traffic was so bad that I ended up late.

zh: 他这么努力工作，是想为家人提供更好的生活。
pinyin: Tā zhème nǔlì gōngzuò, shì xiǎng wèi jiārén tígōng gèng hǎo de shēnghuó.
en: He works so hard because he wants to give his family a better life.

zh: 这么多年过去了，他依然这么执着于自己的梦想。
pinyin: Zhème duō nián guòqù le, tā yīránrán zhème zhízhào yú zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
en: After all these years, he's still just as devoted to his dream as ever.

zh: 这是我的猫，它很可爱。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de māo, tā hěn kě'ài.
en: This is my cat, and it's very cute.

zh: 那个苹果很红，我想吃它。
pinyin: Nàge píngguǒ hěn hóng, wǒ xiǎng chī tā.
en: That apple is so red—I want to eat it.

zh: 虽然这本书很厚，但是它很有趣。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè běn shū hěn hòu, dànshì tā hěn yǒu qùqu.
en: Even though this book is thick, it's actually really interesting.

zh: 我的手机坏了，我需要修理它才能继续用。
pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī huài le, wǒ xūyào xiūlǐ tā cáinéng jìxù yòng.
en: My phone broke, so I need to get it fixed before I can use it again.

zh: 这个项目看起来简单，但实际上它涉及很多复杂的技术问题。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù kàn qǐlai jiǎndān, dàn shíjì shang tā shèjí hěnduō fùzá de jìshù wèntí.
en: This project looks straightforward on the surface, but it actually involves a lot of complicated technical issues.

zh: 我从家去学校。
pinyin: Wǒ cóng jiā qù xuéxiào.
en: I go to school from home.

zh: 她从早上八点开始工作。
pinyin: Tā cóng zǎoshang bā diǎn kāishǐ gōngzuò.
en: She starts working from eight in the morning.

zh: 因为下雨，他从办公室直接回家了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, tā cóng bàngōngshì zhíjiē huíjiā le.
en: Because it was raining, he went straight home from the office.

zh: 从去年开始，我每个月都从工资里存一些钱。
pinyin: Cóng qùnián kāishǐ, wǒ měi ge yuè dōu cóng gōngzī lǐ cún yīxiē qián.
en: Since last year, I've been saving some money from my salary every month.

zh: 从他的反应来看，他对这个计划并不感兴趣。
pinyin: Cóng tā de fǎnyìng lái kàn, tā duì zhège jìhuà bìngbù gǎn xìngqù.
en: Judging by his reaction, he doesn't seem interested in this plan.

zh: 这是我的先生。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de xiānsheng.
en: This is my husband.

zh: 王先生每天早上喝咖啡。
pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng měi tiān zǎoshang hē kāfēi.
en: Mr. Wang drinks coffee every morning.

zh: 虽然先生很忙，但是他还是帮我做饭。
pinyin: Suīrán xiānsheng hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi bāng wǒ zuòfàn.
en: Although my husband is very busy, he still helps me cook.

zh: 那位先生是我的英语老师，他教了我很多年。
pinyin: Nà wèi xiānsheng shì wǒ de yīngyǔ lǎoshī, tā jiāo le wǒ hěn duō nián.
en: That gentleman is my English teacher, and he has taught me for many years.

zh: 李先生对工作认真负责的态度给我留下了深刻印象。
pinyin: Lǐ xiānsheng duì gōngzuò rènzhēn fùzé de tàidù gěi wǒ liúxià le shēnkè yìnxiàng.
en: Mr. Li's conscientious and responsible attitude toward his work made a deep impression on me.

zh: 我找不到钥匙。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo bu dào yàoshí.
en: I can't find my keys.

zh: 早上我找了半小时的手机。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ zhǎole bàn xiǎoshí de shǒujī.
en: This morning I spent half an hour looking for my phone.

zh: 因为钱包丢了，我去警察局找警察帮忙。
pinyin: Yīnwèi qiánbāo diūle, wǒ qù jǐngchájú zhǎo jǐngchá bāngmang.
en: Because I lost my wallet, I went to the police station to find an officer to help.

zh: 虽然我找了很多资料，但还是找不到这个问题的答案。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ zhǎole hěnduō zīliào, dàn háishi zhǎo bu dào zhège wèntí de dáàn.
en: Although I've looked through a lot of material, I still can't find the answer to this question.

zh: 与其抱怨，不如主动找公司管理部门沟通解决问题。
pinyin: Yǔqī bàoyuàn, búrú zhǔdòng zhǎo gōngsī guǎnlǐ bùmén gōutōng jiějué wèntí.
en: Rather than complain, it's better to proactively reach out to the company's management department to discuss and resolve the issue.

zh: 我最喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: I like rice the most.

zh: 今天天气最冷，我们都穿了厚衣服。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì zuì lěng, wǒmen dōu chuānle厚 yīfu.
en: Today is the coldest, so we all wore thick clothes.

zh: 虽然这家餐厅最贵，但是食物味道最好，所以很受欢迎。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā cāntīng zuì guì, dànshì shíwù wèidào zuì hǎo, suǒyǐ hěn shòu huānyíng.
en: Although this restaurant is the most expensive, the food tastes the best, which is why it's very popular.

zh: 在所有学生中，他的成绩最稳定，这也是他最值得骄傲的地方。
pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu xuésheng zhōng, tā de chéngjī zuì wěndìng, zhè yě shì tā zuì zhídeqǐ jiāoào de dìfang.
en: Among all students, his grades are the most consistent, which is also what he's most proud of.

zh: 随着生活水平提高，人们对健康饮食的关注越来越多，这也是现在最热门的话题之一。
pinyin: Suízhe shēnghuó shuǐpíng tígāo, rénmen duì jiànkāng yǐnshí de guānzhù yuèláiyuè duō, zhè yě shì xiànzài zuì règùn de huàtí zhī yī.
en: As living standards improve, people are paying more and more attention to healthy eating, which is also one of the hottest topics right now.

zh: 我喜欢吃苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān chī píngguǒ.
en: I like eating apples.

zh: 他很喜欢玩足球。
pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān wán zúqiú.
en: He really likes playing soccer.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以我喜欢在公园里散步。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ xǐhuān zài gōngyuán lǐ sǎnbù.
en: Because the weather is nice, I enjoy taking walks in the park.

zh: 虽然这部电影很长，但我特别喜欢它的故事。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè bù diànyǐng hěn cháng, dàn wǒ tèbié xǐhuān tā de gùshì.
en: Even though this movie is long, I really love its story.

zh: 我越来越喜欢这份工作，因为同事们都很友好。
pinyin: Wǒ yuèláiyuè xǐhuān zhè fèn gōngzuò, yīnwèi tóngshìmen dōu hěn yǒuhǎo.
en: I'm liking this job more and more because my colleagues are all really friendly.

zh: 这个苹果很可口。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ hěn kěkǒu.
en: This apple is delicious.

zh: 明天天气可能会下雨。
pinyin: Míngtiān tiānqì kěnéng huì xiàyǔ.
en: It might rain tomorrow.

zh: 虽然这个工作很累，但是工资可以接受。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì gōngzī kěyǐ jiēshòu.
en: Although the job is tiring, the salary is acceptable.

zh: 他的想法虽然不完美，但还是可以借鉴一下。
pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ suīrán bù wánměi, dànshì háishi kěyǐ jièjiàn yīxià.
en: His ideas aren't perfect, but they're still worth learning from.

zh: 这个方案看似可行，但实际操作中可能会遇到不少问题。
pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn kànsi kěxíng, dàn shíjì cāozuò zhōng kěnéng huì yùdào búshǎo wèntí.
en: This plan seems feasible, but we'll likely run into quite a few problems when we actually implement it.

zh: 我为你买了苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ wèi nǐ mǎi le píngguǒ.
en: I bought an apple for you.

zh: 她每天都为家人做饭。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu wèi jiārén zuò fàn.
en: She cooks for her family every day.

zh: 因为天气不好，我们为比赛推迟了时间。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, wǒmen wèi bǐsài tuīchíle shíjiān.
en: Because the weather was bad, we postponed the competition.

zh: 他放弃了高薪工作，为了能陪伴年迈的父母。
pinyin: Tā fàngqì le gāoxīn gōngzuò, wèile néng péibàn niánmài de fùmǔ.
en: He gave up a high-paying job in order to spend time with his aging parents.

zh: 这项改革虽然为短期利益付出了代价，但为长远发展打下了基础。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé suīrán wèi duǎnqī lìyì fùchūle dàijià, dàn wèi chángyuǎn fāzhǎn dǎxiàle jīchǔ.
en: Although this reform came at a cost in the short term, it laid a foundation for long-term growth.

zh: 这个苹果很大。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ hěn dà.
en: This apple is very big.

zh: 昨天我去了一家大超市。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ qù le yī jiā dà chāoshì.
en: Yesterday I went to a large supermarket.

zh: 因为天气很大，所以我们没有出去。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn dà, suǒyǐ wǒmen méiyǒu chūqù.
en: Because the weather was really bad, we didn't go out.

zh: 虽然这家公司规模很大，但员工们的工作压力也不小。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā gōngsī guīmó hěn dà, dàn yuángōngmen de gōngzuò yālì yě búxiǎo.
en: Although this company is large in scale, the employees still experience considerable work stress.

zh: 他在大城市里创业成功，但并未忘记自己的初心。
pinyin: Tā zài dà chéngshì lǐ chuàngyè chénggōng, dàn bìngwèi wàngjì zìjǐ de chūxīn.
en: He succeeded in starting a business in a major city, yet never forgot his original purpose.

zh: 明天可能下雨。
pinyin: Míngtiān kěnéng xiàyǔ.
en: It might rain tomorrow.

zh: 他今天可能不来上班。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān kěnéng búlái shàngbān.
en: He might not come to work today.

zh: 因为堵车，我们可能会迟到。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dǔchē, wǒmen kěnéng huì chídào.
en: Because of traffic, we might be late.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但可能需要更多时间才能理解。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, dàn kěnéng xūyào gèngduō shíjiān cáinéng lǐjiě.
en: Even though he's smart, he might need more time to understand.

zh: 这个项目的成功可能取决于我们能否找到合适的投资者。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chéngōng kěnéng qǔjuéyú wǒmen néngfǒu zhǎodào héshìde tóuzīzhě.
en: Whether this project succeeds may well depend on whether we can find the right investors.

zh: 我需要水。
pinyin: Wǒ xūyào shuǐ.
en: I need water.

zh: 明天我需要买新鞋子。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ xūyào mǎi xīn xiézi.
en: Tomorrow I need to buy new shoes.

zh: 因为天气冷，所以我需要穿厚衣服。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ xūyào chuān hòu yīfu.
en: Because it's cold, I need to wear thick clothes.

zh: 如果想学好中文，就需要每天练习说话。
pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng xuéhǎo Zhōngwén, jiù xūyào měitiān liànxí shuōhuà.
en: If you want to learn Chinese well, you need to practice speaking every day.

zh: 这个项目的成功需要团队每个成员的努力和配合。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chéngōng xūyào tuánduì měi ge chéngyuán de nǔlì hé pèihé.
en: The success of this project requires every team member's effort and cooperation.

zh: 是的，我喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Shì de, wǒ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: Yes, I like eating rice.

zh: 是的，昨天我在家里看书了。
pinyin: Shì de, zuótiān wǒ zài jiālǐ kànshū le.
en: Yes, I was reading at home yesterday.

zh: 是的，虽然天气很冷，但是我还是想去公园。
pinyin: Shì de, suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì wǒ háishi xiǎng qù gōngyuán.
en: Yes, even though it's cold, I still want to go to the park.

zh: 是的，因为工作比较忙，所以我最近没有时间运动。
pinyin: Shì de, yīnwèi gōngzuò bǐjiào máng, suǒyǐ wǒ zuìjìn méiyǒu shíjiān yùndòng.
en: That's right—work has been pretty busy lately, so I haven't had time to exercise.

zh: 是的，虽然机会不多，但我觉得只要坚持就能慢慢改变现状。
pinyin: Shì de, suīrán jīhuì búduō, dàn wǒ juéde zhǐyào jiānchí jiù néng mànman gǎibiàn xiànzhuàng.
en: Yes, opportunities are limited, but I believe that as long as we persist, we can gradually turn things around.

zh: 鱼死了。
pinyin: Yú sǐ le.
en: The fish died.

zh: 昨天我的狗死了，我很难过。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ de gǒu sǐ le, wǒ hěn nánguò.
en: My dog died yesterday, and I'm really sad about it.

zh: 因为没有水，所以那些花都死了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu shuǐ, suǒyǐ nàxiē huā dōu sǐ le.
en: Because there was no water, all those flowers died.

zh: 他工作太累，有时候感觉累死了，想立刻休息。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò tài lèi, yǒushíhou gǎnjuéde lèi sǐ le, xiǎng lìkè xiūxi.
en: His job is so tiring that sometimes he feels exhausted and just wants to rest immediately.

zh: 他这个人特别固执，朋友们都说他是死脑筋，很难改变主意。
pinyin: Tā zhège rén tèbié gùzhí, péngyoumen dōu shuō tā shì sǐ nǎojīn, hěn nán gǎibiàn zhǔyì.
en: He's really stubborn—his friends all say he's pigheaded and it's nearly impossible to change his mind.

zh: 我每次吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ měi cì chī mǐfàn.
en: I eat rice every time.

zh: 上次我去了公园两次。
pinyin: Shàng cì wǒ qùle gōngyuán liǎng cì.
en: Last time I went to the park twice.

zh: 虽然我去过三次，但每次都很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ qùguò sān cì, dàn měi cì dōu hěn kāixīn.
en: Although I've been three times, each time was really fun.

zh: 因为工作很忙，我这次没能按时完成任务。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò hěn máng, wǒ zhè cì méi néng ànshí wánchéng rènwu.
en: Because work has been so busy, I wasn't able to finish the task on time this round.

zh: 他多次强调这个项目的重要性，可惜这次总算得到了重视。
pinyin: Tā duō cì qiángdiào zhège xiàngmù de zhòngyàoxìng, kěxī zhè cì zǒngsuàn dé到le zhòngshì.
en: He's emphasized this project's importance many times, and finally this time it's getting the attention it deserves.

zh: 我出去了。
pinyin: Wǒ chūqù le.
en: I'm going out.

zh: 昨天我出去买了一件新衣服。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ chūqù mǎi le yī jiàn xīn yīfu.
en: Yesterday I went out and bought a new piece of clothing.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以我们决定出去公园玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen juéding chūqù gōngyuán wán.
en: Because the weather was nice, we decided to go out and play in the park.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但是他还是抽时间出来陪我们。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi chōu shíjiān chūlái péi wǒmen.
en: Although he was busy, he still made time to come out and spend time with us.

zh: 这个产品的设计非常出色，已经在市场上脱颖而出。
pinyin: Zhège chǎnpǐn de shèjì fēicháng chūsè, yǐjīng zài shìchǎng shang tuōyǐng érchū.
en: This product's design is exceptional and has really stood out in the market.

zh: 你喜欢吃米饭,那么我也吃。
pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn, nàme wǒ yě chī.
en: You like eating rice, so I'll eat it too.

zh: 明天你不来学校,那么我们怎么见面?
pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ búlái xuéxiào, nàme wǒmen zěnyàng jiànmiàn?
en: If you're not coming to school tomorrow, how will we meet up?

zh: 虽然今天很累,但是我们还要继续,那么大家休息十分钟吧。
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān hěn lèi, dànshi wǒmen háiyào jìxù, nàme dàjiā xiūxi shí fēnzhōng ba.
en: Even though everyone's tired today and we need to keep going, let's take a ten-minute break then.

zh: 既然你已经决定出国工作了,那么你应该提前准备好语言考试。
pinyin: Jìrán nǐ yǐjīng juéding chūguó gōngzuò le, nàme nǐ yīnggāi tíqián zhǔnbèi hǎo yǔyán kǎoshì.
en: Since you've already decided to work abroad, you should prepare for the language exam in advance.

zh: 与其整天抱怨工作压力大,那么不如主动调整心态,找到更合适的解决办法。
pinyin: Yǔqī zhěngtiān bàoyuàn gōngzuò yālì dà, nàme búrú zhǔdòng tiáozhěng xīntài, zhǎodào gèng héshìde jiějué bànfǎ.
en: Rather than complaining all day about work stress, why not take the initiative to adjust your mindset and find a better solution?

zh: 你在干什么？
pinyin: Nǐ zài gàn shénme?
en: What are you doing?

zh: 昨天我干了很多家务。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ gānle hěnduō jiāwù.
en: Yesterday I did a lot of housework.

zh: 因为明天要考试，所以今晚我要干复习。
pinyin: Yīnwèi míngtiān yào kǎoshì, suǒyǐ jīnwǎn wǒ yào gàn fùxí.
en: Because there's an exam tomorrow, I need to study tonight.

zh: 虽然工作很累，但他每天还是坚持干了八小时。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dàn tā měitiān háishi jiānchí gānle bā xiǎoshí.
en: Although the work is tiring, he still managed to do eight hours every day.

zh: 要想成功，光说不干肯定不行，必须付诸行动才可能实现目标。
pinyin: Yào xiǎng chénggōng, guāng shuō bu gàn kěndìng bu xíng, bìxū fùzhū xíngdòng cái kěnéng shíxiàn mùbiāo.
en: To succeed, just talking without taking action definitely won't work—you have to actually do things if you want to achieve your goals.

zh: 那个苹果很红。
pinyin: Nàge píngguǒ hěn hóng.
en: That apple is very red.

zh: 昨天我买的那个书很好看。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎi de nàge shū hěn hǎokàn.
en: The book I bought yesterday is really good.

zh: 虽然那个公司很小，但是工作很有意思。
pinyin: Suīrán nàge gōngsī hěn xiǎo, dànshì gōngzuò hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Even though that company is small, the work is really interesting.

zh: 那个方案看起来可行，不过需要再讨论一下细节。
pinyin: Nàge fāng'àn kàn qǐlái kěxíng, búguò xūyào zài tǎolùn yīxià xì節.
en: That plan seems feasible, but we should discuss the details a bit more.

zh: 那个项目前期投入很大，如果没有充足的资金支持可能会半途而废。
pinyin: Nàge xiàngmù qiánqī tóurù hěn dà, rúguǒ méiyǒu chōngzú de zījīn zhīchí kěnéng huì bàntú ér fèi.
en: That project requires significant upfront investment, and without adequate funding it could easily fall by the wayside.

zh: 嘿，你好！
pinyin: Hēi, nǐ hǎo!
en: Hey, hello!

zh: 嘿，你昨天去哪里了？
pinyin: Hēi, nǐ zuótiān qù nǎlǐ le?
en: Hey, where did you go yesterday?

zh: 嘿，虽然下雨了，但是我们还是去公园玩。
pinyin: Hēi, suīrán xiàyǔ le, dànshì wǒmen háishi qù gōngyuán wán.
en: Hey, even though it rained, we still went to the park anyway.

zh: 嘿，你别老想着手机，应该多做一些户外活动。
pinyin: Hēi, nǐ bié lǎo xiǎngzhe shǒujī, yīnggāi duō zuò yīxiē hùwài huódòng.
en: Hey, stop being glued to your phone all the time—you should do more outdoor activities.

zh: 嘿，你这样临时抱佛脚根本不行，早该提前准备才对。
pinyin: Hēi, nǐ zhèyàng línshí báo Fó jiǎo gēnběn búxíng, zǎo gāi tíqián zhǔnbèi cái duì.
en: Hey, cramming at the last minute like that won't cut it—you should've prepared way ahead of time.

zh: 我们吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒmen chīfàn.
en: We're eating.

zh: 他们昨天去了公园。
pinyin: Tāmen zuótiān qùle gōngyuán.
en: They went to the park yesterday.

zh: 虽然她们很累，但是她们还在工作。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen hěn léi, dànshì tāmen háizài gōngzuò.
en: Even though they're exhausted, they're still working.

zh: 因为他们没有经验，所以我们决定帮助他们。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tāmen méiyǒu jīngyàn, suǒyǐ wǒmen juéding bāngzhù tāmen.
en: Since they lack experience, we decided to help them out.

zh: 那些员工们对新政策的反应不一，有些人支持，有些人反对。
pinyin: Nàxiē yuángōng men duì xīn zhèngcè de fǎnyìng búyī, yǒuxiē rén zhīchí, yǒuxiē rén fǎnduì.
en: The employees' reactions to the new policy were mixed—some supported it, others opposed it.

zh: 我想和你说话。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ shuōhuà.
en: I want to talk to you.

zh: 昨天老师说了很多话。
pinyin: Zuótiān lǎoshī shuōle hěnduō huà.
en: The teacher said a lot yesterday.

zh: 虽然他话不多，但是他的建议很好。
pinyin: Suīrán tā huà búduō, dànshì tāde jiànyì hěn hǎo.
en: Although he doesn't say much, his advice is really good.

zh: 她在会议上说的话引起了大家的关注。
pinyin: Tā zài huìyì shang shuōde huà yǐnqǐle dàjiā de guānzhù.
en: What she said at the meeting caught everyone's attention.

zh: 与其空说大话，不如脚踏实地去做实事。
pinyin: Yǔqī kōng shuō dàhuà, búrú jiǎo tà shíz地 qù zuò shíshì.
en: Rather than just talk big, it's better to work hard and get things done.

zh: 我喜欢苹果而不喜欢梨。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ ér búxǐhuān lí.
en: I like apples but not pears.

zh: 妹妹很聪明而且很勤快。
pinyin: Mèimei hěn聪明 érqiě hěn qínkuài.
en: My younger sister is smart and hardworking.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但我们还是坚持而去登山。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì wǒmen háishi jiānchí ér qù dēngshān.
en: Although the weather was very cold, we still went hiking anyway.

zh: 他选择了出国留学而放弃了稳定的工作。
pinyin: Tā xuǎnzé le chūguó liúxué ér fàngqì le wěndìng de gōngzuò.
en: He chose to study abroad and gave up his stable job.

zh: 这个政策有利有弊，既能促进发展而又可能带来风险。
pinyin: Zhège zhèngcè yǒulì yǒubì, jìnéng cùjìn fāzhǎn ér yòu kěnéng dàilái fēngxiǎn.
en: This policy has both advantages and disadvantages—it can drive development but may also create risks.

zh: 你叫什么名字？
pinyin: Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
en: What's your name?

zh: 今天天气怎么样？有点冷。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì zěnyàng? Yǒudiǎn lěng.
en: How's the weather today? It's a bit cold.

zh: 他虽然很忙，但是还是帮我解决了问题。
pinyin: Tā suīrán hěn máng, dànshi háishi bāng助 wǒ jiějué le wèntí.
en: Even though he's busy, he still helped me solve the problem.

zh: 我不明白你为什么总是拒绝我的建议。
pinyin: Wǒ búmíngbai nǐ wèi shénme zǒngshi jùjué wǒ de jiànyì.
en: I don't understand why you keep rejecting my suggestions.

zh: 与其整天抱怨，不如想想怎么才能改变现状。
pinyin: Yǔqī zhěngtiān bàoyuàn, búrú xiǎngxiang zěnme cáinéng gǎibiàn xiànzhuàng.
en: Rather than complaining all day, you'd better figure out how to actually change things.

zh: 这是什么东西？
pinyin: Zhè shì shénme dōngxi?
en: What is this thing?

zh: 我买了很多东西在超市。
pinyin: Wǒ mǎile hěnduō dōngxi zài chāoshì.
en: I bought a lot of things at the supermarket.

zh: 虽然这些东西很便宜，但是质量不太好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhèxiē dōngxi hěn piányí, dànshì zhìliàng bútiài hǎo.
en: Although these items are cheap, the quality isn't very good.

zh: 他不喜欢整理房间，经常把东西乱放。
pinyin: Tā búxǐhuān zhěnglǐ fángjiān, jīngcháng bǎ dōngxi luàn fàng.
en: He doesn't like tidying up, and he often throws his stuff around carelessly.

zh: 与其纠结过去的事，不如专注眼前的东西。
pinyin: Yǔqī jiūjié guòqù de shì, búrú zhuānzhù yǎnqián de dōngxi.
en: Rather than dwelling on the past, it's better to focus on what's right in front of you.

zh: 你应该吃饭。
pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi chīfàn.
en: You should eat.

zh: 明天你应该早点去学校。
pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ yīnggāi zǎodiǎn qù xuéxiào.
en: Tomorrow you should go to school earlier.

zh: 因为天气很冷，你应该穿厚衣服。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn lěng, nǐ yīnggāi chuān hòu yīfu.
en: Because it's very cold, you should wear thick clothes.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但你还是应该照顾好自己的身体。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn nǐ háishi yīnggāi zhàogu hǎo zìjǐ de shēntǐ.
en: Even though work is busy, you should still take care of your health.

zh: 既然你想成功，就应该比别人付出更多的努力和时间。
pinyin: Jìrán nǐ xiǎng chénggōng, jiù yīnggāi bǐ biérén fùchū gèngduō de nǔlì hé shíjiān.
en: If you want to succeed, you should put in more effort and time than others.

zh: 孩子喜欢吃糖。
pinyin: Háizi xǐhuān chī táng.
en: Children like to eat candy.

zh: 这个孩子每天早上去上学。
pinyin: Zhège háizi měitiān zǎoshang qù shàngxué.
en: This child goes to school every morning.

zh: 虽然孩子很小，但是他已经会说话了。
pinyin: Suīrán háizi hěn xiǎo, dànshì tā yǐjīng huì shuōhuà le.
en: Although the child is very young, he can already talk.

zh: 父母应该花时间陪孩子，而不是只给他们钱。
pinyin: Fùmǔ yīnggāi huā shíjiān péi háizi, érbúshì zhǐ gěi tāmen qián.
en: Parents should spend time with their children instead of just giving them money.

zh: 现在很多孩子沉迷于手机，这让很多教育工作者感到担忧。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō háizi chénmí yú shǒujī, zhè ràng hěnduō jiàoyù gōngzuòzhě gǎndào dānyōu.
en: Nowadays many children are absorbed in their phones, which worries many educators.

zh: 太阳起来了。
pinyin: Tàiyáng qǐlái le.
en: The sun has come up.

zh: 早上我起来吃早饭。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ qǐlái chī zǎofàn.
en: I get up in the morning to eat breakfast.

zh: 虽然很困，但我还是起来了，因为要上班。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn kùn, dàn wǒ háishi qǐlái le, yīnwèi yào shàngbān.
en: Even though I was really tired, I still got up because I had to go to work.

zh: 听到闹钟响，他马上起来洗漱准备出门。
pinyin: Tīngdào nàozhōng xiǎng, tā mashang qǐlái xǐshù zhǔnbèi chūmén.
en: As soon as he heard the alarm clock, he got up right away, washed up, and got ready to leave.

zh: 这个项目一开始看起来很困难，但团队坚持下去，最后还是做起来了。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yī kāishǐ kàn qǐlái hěn kùnnan, dàn tuánduì jiānchí xiàqù, zuìhòu háishi zuò qǐlái le.
en: This project looked really difficult at first, but the team persisted, and in the end they managed to pull it off.

zh: 我很累，所以我要睡觉。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn lèi, suǒyǐ wǒ yào shuìjiào.
en: I'm very tired, so I need to sleep.

zh: 今天下雨了，所以我们不去公园。
pinyin: Jīntiān xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒmen búqù gōngyuán.
en: It rained today, so we didn't go to the park.

zh: 虽然这个菜很贵，但是很好吃，所以我经常买。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège cài hěn guì, dànshi hěn hǎochī, suǒyǐ wǒ jīngcháng mǎi.
en: Although this dish is expensive, it tastes really good, so I buy it often.

zh: 因为他昨天没有完成工作，所以今天必须加班到很晚。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā zuótiān méiyǒu wánchéng gōngzuò, suǒyǐ jīntiān bìxū jiābān dào hěn wǎn.
en: Because he didn't finish his work yesterday, he had to work late today.

zh: 他对这个项目投入了很多时间和精力，所以最后取得了令人满意的结果。
pinyin: Tā duì zhège xiàngmù tóurù le hěnduō shíjiān hé jīnglì, suǒyǐ zuìhòu qǔdé le lìngrénmǎnyì de jiéguǒ.
en: He invested a lot of time and energy into this project, so in the end he achieved satisfying results.

zh: 这些苹果很好吃。
pinyin: Zhèxiē píngguǒ hěn hǎochī.
en: These apples are really tasty.

zh: 我喜欢这些红色的花。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhèxiē hóngsè de huā.
en: I like these red flowers.

zh: 因为天气冷，所以这些学生都穿了厚衣服。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì lěng, suǒyǐ zhèxiē xuésheng dōu chuānle hòu yīfu.
en: Since it's cold out, all these students wore thick jackets.

zh: 虽然这些问题看起来很难，但我们可以一起解决它们。
pinyin: Suīrán zhèxiē wèntí kàn qǐlái hěn nán, dàn wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ jiějué tāmen.
en: Although these problems seem complicated, we can solve them together.

zh: 这些年轻人对社交媒体的依赖程度令人担忧，不过也有人在积极改变这个现象。
pinyin: Zhèxiē niánqīngrén duì shèjiāo méitǐ de yīlài chéngdù lìngrén dānnyōu, búguò yě yǒurén zài jījí gǎibiàn zhège xiànxiàng.
en: The dependence these young people have on social media is concerning, but some people are actively working to change that.

zh: 我才吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ cái chīfàn.
en: I'm just eating now.

zh: 他昨天才来我家。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān cái lái wǒ jiā.
en: He only came to my place yesterday.

zh: 虽然很难，但是我才能做好。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshì wǒ cái néng zuòhǎo.
en: Even though it's difficult, only then can I do it well.

zh: 因为没有经验，新员工才需要更多的培训。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu jīngyàn, xīn yuángōng cái xūyào gèngduō de péixùn.
en: Because they lack experience, new employees need more training to succeed.

zh: 他工作了十年以后，才真正明白什么叫责任。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuòle shí nián yǐhòu, cái zhēnzhèng míngbai shénme jiào zérèn.
en: Only after working for ten years did he truly understand what responsibility really means.

zh: 我有两个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng ge píngguǒ.
en: I have two apples.

zh: 他每天喝两杯咖啡。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān hē liǎng bēi kāfēi.
en: He drinks two cups of coffee every day.

zh: 虽然这两家店都不错，但是我更喜欢左边那家。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè liǎng jiā diàn dōu búcuò, dànshì wǒ gèng xǐhuān zuǒbiān nà jiā.
en: Although both of these shops are good, I prefer the one on the left.

zh: 这两个方案各有优缺点，我们需要仔细比较一下。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge fāng'àn gè yǒu yōu quēdiǎn, wǒmen xūyào zǐxì bǐjiào yīxià.
en: These two plans each have their strengths and weaknesses, so we need to compare them carefully.

zh: 在过去两年里，公司的销售增长了三倍，这说明我们的策略是对的。
pinyin: Zài guòqù liǎng nián lǐ, gōngsī de xiāoshòu zēngzhǎng le sān bèi, zhè shuōmíng wǒmen de cèlüè shì duì de.
en: Over the past two years, the company's sales have tripled, which shows our strategy is working.

zh: 我写错了。
pinyin: Wǒ xiě cuò le.
en: I wrote it wrong.

zh: 昨天我说错了一个词。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ shuōcuò le yī ge cí.
en: Yesterday I said a word incorrectly.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但是这次考试他错了很多题。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, dànshì zhè cì kǎoshì tā cuò le hěnduō tí.
en: Although he's smart, he got a lot of questions wrong on this test.

zh: 因为没有仔细检查，他把重要的数据都错输入了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu zǐxì jiǎnchá, tā bǎ zhòngyào de shùjù dōu cuò shūrù le.
en: Because he didn't check carefully, he entered all the important data incorrectly.

zh: 这份合同的条款我们理解错了，现在得重新协商。
pinyin: Zhè fèn héitóng de tiáokuǎn wǒmen lǐjiě cuò le, xiànzài děi chóngxīn xiéshāng.
en: We misunderstood the terms in this contract, so we need to renegotiate now.

zh: 我有苹果，还有橙子。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu píngguǒ, háiyǒu chéngzi.
en: I have apples, and I also have oranges.

zh: 今天我吃了米饭，还有一个鸡蛋。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ chīle mǐfàn, háiyǒu yī ge jīdàn.
en: Today I had rice, and I also ate an egg.

zh: 他喜欢踢球，还有游泳的时候也很开心。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuān tīqiú, háiyǒu yóuyǒng de shíhou yě hěn kāixīn.
en: He likes playing soccer, and he's also very happy when swimming.

zh: 除了英语课，学生还有数学和科学要学习。
pinyin: Chúle yīngyǔ kè, xuésheng háiyǒu shùxué hé kēxué yào xuéxí.
en: Apart from English class, students also have to study math and science.

zh: 这个项目虽然成本高，但还有很大的市场潜力和发展前景。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù suīrán chéngběn gāo, dàn háiyǒu hěn dà de shìchǎng qiánlì hé fāzhǎn qiánjǐng.
en: Although this project is expensive, it still has significant market potential and promising prospects for development.

zh: 我又吃米饭了。
pinyin: Wǒ yòu chī mǐfàn le.
en: I ate rice again.

zh: 他今天又迟到了,真不好。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān yòu chídào le, zhēn búhǎo.
en: He was late again today—that's really not good.

zh: 虽然他很累,但他又工作又照顾孩子。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dàn tā yòu gōngzuò yòu zhàogu hái.
en: Although he's exhausted, he both works and takes care of his child.

zh: 因为疫情,公司又取消了会议,员工们又失望了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yìqíng, gōngsī yòu qǔxiāo le huìyì, yuángōngmen yòu shīwàng le.
en: Because of the epidemic, the company cancelled the meeting again, and the staff were disappointed once more.

zh: 他既聪明又勤奋,工作效率总是又快又准,难怪升职这么快。
pinyin: Tā jì聪míng yòu qínfèn, gōngzuò xiàolǜ zǒngshi yòu kuài yòu zhǔn, nánguài shēngzhí zhème kuài.
en: He's both intelligent and hardworking; his work is always both fast and accurate—no wonder he got promoted so quickly.

zh: 我有一只小狗。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī zhī xiǎo gǒu.
en: I have a small dog.

zh: 昨天我买了一个小苹果。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎile yī ge xiǎo píngguǒ.
en: Yesterday I bought a small apple.

zh: 虽然这家小餐厅很小，但是菜特别好吃。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā xiǎo cāntīng hěn xiǎo, dànshì cài tèbié hǎochī.
en: Even though this little restaurant is tiny, the food is really delicious.

zh: 他在一家小公司工作，虽然工资不高，但很喜欢这份工作。
pinyin: Tā zài yī jiā xiǎo gōngsī gōngzuò, suīrán gōngzī búgāo, dàn hěn xǐhuān zhè fèn gōngzuò.
en: He works at a small company; even though the pay isn't great, he really enjoys the job.

zh: 从小事开始做起，才能逐渐成就大事业。
pinyin: Cóng xiǎo shì kāishǐ zuòqǐ, cáinéng zhújiàn chéngjiù dà shìyè.
en: Starting with small things is how you gradually build something great.

zh: 我在中国。
pinyin: Wǒ zài zhōngguó.
en: I'm in China.

zh: 今天中午我吃了米饭。
pinyin: Jīntiān zhōngwǔ wǒ chīle mǐfàn.
en: I ate rice at noon today.

zh: 虽然中文很难，但是我每天都在学。
pinyin: Suīrán zhōngwén hěn nán, dànshì wǒ měitiān dōu zài xué.
en: Although Chinese is difficult, I study it every day.

zh: 在中学的时候，他是班级中最聪明的学生。
pinyin: Zài zhōngxué de shíhou, tā shì bānjí zhōng zuì congming de xuésheng.
en: When he was in middle school, he was the smartest student in his class.

zh: 这个项目中存在的问题需要在下周的会议中讨论解决。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù zhōng cúnzài de wèntí xūyào zài xiàzhōu de huìyì zhōng tǎolùn jiějué.
en: The issues that exist within this project need to be discussed and resolved at next week's meeting.

zh: 我叫王明。
pinyin: Wǒ jiào Wángmíng.
en: My name is Wang Ming.

zh: 妈妈叫我去买菜。
pinyin: Māma jiào wǒ qù mǎi cài.
en: Mom asked me to go buy vegetables.

zh: 虽然下雨了，他还是叫出租车去上班。
pinyin: Suīrán xiàyǔ le, tā háishi jiào chūzūchē qù shàngbān.
en: Although it was raining, he still called a taxi to go to work.

zh: 这家餐厅的服务员叫得很急，因为今天客人特别多。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de fúwùyuán jiào de hěn jí, yīnwèi jīntiān kèrén tèbié duō.
en: The waiters at this restaurant were calling out orders urgently because there were exceptionally many customers today.

zh: 他一听到消息就叫停了整个项目，生怕出现什么问题。
pinyin: Tā yī tīngdào xiāoxī jiù jiào tíng le zhěngge xiàngmù, shēngpà chūxiàn shénme wèntí.
en: The moment he heard the news, he called a halt to the entire project, worried something might go wrong.

zh: 嗯，我喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: En, wǒ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: Yeah, I like eating rice.

zh: 嗯，昨天我去了公园，很开心。
pinyin: En, zuótiān wǒ qùle gōngyuán, hěn kāixīn.
en: Mm-hmm, I went to the park yesterday and had a really good time.

zh: 嗯，虽然今天很冷，但是我还是想去外面走走。
pinyin: En, suīrán jīntiān hěn lěng, dànshi wǒ háishi xiǎng qù wàimiàn zǒuzǒu.
en: Yeah, even though it's cold today, I still want to go out for a walk.

zh: 嗯，因为你上次的意见很有帮助，所以这次我特意听了你的建议。
pinyin: En, yīnwèi nǐ shàng cì de yìjiàn hěn yǒu bāngzhù, suǒyǐ zhè cì wǒ tèyì tīngle nǐ de jiànyì.
en: Yeah, because your feedback last time was really helpful, this time I made a point to listen to what you suggested.

zh: 嗯，我觉得这个方案虽然前期投入大，但长期来看还是值得的。
pinyin: En, wǒ juéde zhège fāng'àn suīrán qiánqī tóurù dà, dàn chángqī lái kàn háishi zhídé de.
en: Yeah, I think this plan requires a big upfront investment, but in the long run it's worth it.

zh: 该吃饭了。
pinyin: Gāi chīfàn le.
en: It's time to eat.

zh: 明天该去医生那里了。
pinyin: Míngtiān gāi qù yīshēng nàlǐ le.
en: I should go to the doctor tomorrow.

zh: 虽然很累，但是该完成这个工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì gāi wánchéng zhège gōngzuò.
en: Although I'm tired, I still need to finish this work.

zh: 他迟到了，该给朋友道歉才对。
pinyin: Tā chídào le, gāi gěi péngyou dàoqiàn cái duì.
en: He was late—he really ought to apologize to his friend.

zh: 既然承诺了就该负责，这是最基本的诚信。
pinyin: 既然 chéngnuò le jiù gāi fùzé, zhè shì zuì jīběn de chéngxìn.
en: If you've made a commitment, you should take responsibility for it—that's basic integrity.

zh: 我喜欢苹果、香蕉等水果。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ、xiāngjiāo děng shuǐguǒ。
en: I like fruits like apples and bananas.

zh: 他每天早上喝牛奶、吃面包等早餐。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang hē niúnǎi、chī miànbāo děng zǎocān。
en: He drinks milk and eats bread and other breakfast items every morning.

zh: 因为下雨了，我们等朋友的时候在咖啡馆里喝茶等。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le，wǒmen děng péngyou de shíhou zài kāfēi guǎn lǐ hēchá děng。
en: Because it was raining, while waiting for our friend, we sat in a café drinking tea and such.

zh: 会议上讨论了销售、市场营销等几个重要问题。
pinyin: Huìyì shang tǎolùn le xiāoshòu、shìchǎng yíngxiāo děng jǐ ge zhòngyào wèntí。
en: During the meeting, they discussed several important issues such as sales and marketing.

zh: 公司的员工、客户乃至合作伙伴等都对这个新政策有疑虑。
pinyin: Gōngsī de yuángōng、kèhù nǎizhì hézuò huǒbàn děng dōu duì zhège xīn zhèngcè yǒu yíyǜ。
en: The company's employees, clients, and business partners alike have reservations about this new policy.

zh: 这是什么问题？
pinyin: Zhè shì shénme wèntí?
en: What is this problem?

zh: 我有一个问题想问你。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī ge wèntí xiǎng wèn nǐ.
en: I have a question I want to ask you.

zh: 虽然这个问题很难，但是我想试试看。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège wèntí hěn nán, dànshì wǒ xiǎng shìshi kàn.
en: Even though this problem is hard, I want to try it anyway.

zh: 经理说明天开会讨论这个重要问题。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuōmíngtiān kāihuì tǎolùn zhège zhòngyào wèntí.
en: The manager said we'll have a meeting tomorrow to discuss this important issue.

zh: 与其逃避问题，不如主动面对它。
pinyin: Yǔqī táobì wèntí, búrú zhǔdòng miànduì tā.
en: Rather than avoid the problem, it's better to face it head-on.

zh: 我们一起吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīqǐ chīfàn.
en: We eat together.

zh: 今天下午我和朋友一起去公园。
pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ hé péngyou yīqǐ qù gōngyuán.
en: This afternoon my friend and I are going to the park together.

zh: 虽然我们很忙，但是我们还是一起完成了这个项目。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen hěn máng, dànshì wǒmen háishi yīqǐ wánchéngle zhège xiàngmù.
en: Even though we were busy, we still completed the project together.

zh: 因为疫情的原因，很多学生不能一起在教室里上课。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yìqíng de yuányīn, hěnduō xuésheng búnéng yīqǐ zài jiàoshì lǐ shàngkè.
en: Because of the pandemic, many students couldn't take classes together in the classroom.

zh: 我们决定把这个想法和团队一起讨论，这样能听到不同的意见。
pinyin: Wǒmen juéding bǎ zhège xiǎngfǎ hé tuánduì yīqǐ tǎolùn, zhèyàng néng tīngdào búdǒng de yìjiàn.
en: We decided to discuss this idea with the team together, that way we can hear different perspectives.

zh: 我拿一个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ ná yī gè píngguǒ.
en: I'll take an apple.

zh: 早上我拿书去学校。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ ná shū qù xuéxiào.
en: In the morning I take my book to school.

zh: 因为下雨，我拿了伞才出门。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒ nále sǎn cái chūmén.
en: Because it was raining, I grabbed an umbrella before leaving.

zh: 你能拿一下这个包吗？我的手有点满。
pinyin: Nǐ néng ná yīxià zhège bāo ma? Wǒ de shǒu yǒudiǎn mǎn.
en: Can you hold this bag for a moment? My hands are a bit full.

zh: 这份工作虽然薪水不错，但拿的起来也挺累的。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò suīrán xīnshuǐ búcuò, dàn náde qǐlai yě tǐng léi de.
en: Although the salary is decent for this job, it's quite tiring to actually manage it all.

zh: 今天更热。
pinyin: Jīntiān gèng rè.
en: Today is even hotter.

zh: 他的房间更大，更干净。
pinyin: Tā de fángjiān gèng dà, gèng gān净.
en: His room is bigger and even cleaner.

zh: 虽然这个菜很好吃，但是那个更好吃。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège cài hěn hǎochī, dànshì nàge gèng hǎochī.
en: Although this dish is delicious, that one is even more so.

zh: 自从他换了工作以后，压力更大，但是收入也更高了。
pinyin: Zìcóng tā huànle gōngzuò yǐhòu, yālì gèng dà, dànshì shōurù yě gèng gāo le.
en: Since he changed jobs, the stress has been even greater, but his income is higher too.

zh: 与其等待完美的机会，不如把握眼前的机会，这样才能取得更大的成就。
pinyin: Yǔqī děngdài wánměi de jīhuì, búrú bǎwoū yǎnqián de jīhuì, zhèyàng cáinéng qǔdé gèng dà de chéngjiù.
en: Rather than waiting for the perfect opportunity, it's better to seize the one in front of you—that's how you achieve even greater success.

zh: 课开始了。
pinyin: Kè kāishǐ le.
en: The class has started.

zh: 明天早上八点开始上班。
pinyin: Míngtiān zǎoshang bā diǎn kāishǐ shàngbān.
en: Tomorrow morning I start work at eight o'clock.

zh: 虽然很累，但是我们还是开始做功课。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn léi, dànshì wǒmen háishi kāishǐ zuò gōngkè.
en: Although we were tired, we still started doing our homework.

zh: 因为疫情，公司决定从下个月开始在家办公。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yìqíng, gōngsī juédìng cóng xiàge yuè kāishǐ zàijiā bàngōng.
en: Because of the pandemic, the company decided to start working from home next month.

zh: 自从她开始学习编程以后，工作效率提高了不少。
pinyin: Zìcóng tā kāishǐ xuéxí biānchéng yǐhòu, gōngzuò xiàolǜ tíhuà le búshào.
en: Ever since she started learning programming, her work efficiency has improved considerably.

zh: 妈妈帮我穿衣服。
pinyin: Māma bāng wǒ chuān yīfu.
en: Mom helps me get dressed.

zh: 昨天我帮爸爸洗了车。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ bāng bàba xǐle chē.
en: Yesterday I helped Dad wash the car.

zh: 因为他生病了，所以我帮他做功课。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā shēngbìng le, suǒyǐ wǒ bāng tā zuò gōngkè.
en: Because he was sick, I helped him with his homework.

zh: 虽然很忙，但我还是抽时间帮朋友搬家了。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, dàn wǒ háishi chōu shíjiān bāng péngyou bānjiā le.
en: Even though I was busy, I still made time to help my friend move.

zh: 他经常帮助别人解决问题，这样做受到了大家的认可。
pinyin: Tā jīngcháng bāngzhù biérén jiějué wèntí, zhèyàng zuò shòudào le dàjiā de rènkě.
en: He regularly helps others solve problems, and that's earned him everyone's respect.

zh: 我打电话。
pinyin: Wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
en: I'm making a phone call.

zh: 他每天早上打篮球。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang dǎ lánqiú.
en: He plays basketball every morning.

zh: 因为下雨，所以我打了一辆出租车回家。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ dǎle yī liàng chūzūchē huíjiā.
en: Because it was raining, I took a taxi home.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但是他还是坚持打网球来保持健康。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi jiānchí dǎ wǎngqiú lái bǎochí jiànkāng.
en: Although his work is demanding, he still insists on playing tennis to stay fit.

zh: 自从用了新软件以后，他打字的速度快了不少，工作效率也提高了。
pinyin: Zìcóng yòngle xīn ruǎnjiàn yǐhòu, tā dǎzì de sùdù kuàile búshǎo, gōngzuò xiàolǜ yě tíghāole.
en: Since he started using the new software, his typing speed has improved considerably, and his work efficiency has gone up too.

zh: 我爱吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ ài chī mǐfàn.
en: I love eating rice.

zh: 她很爱她的小猫。
pinyin: Tā hěn ài tā de xiǎo māo.
en: She really loves her kitten.

zh: 因为妈妈爱我们，所以她每天都做饭。
pinyin: Yīnwèi māma ài wǒmen, suǒyǐ tā měi tiān dōu zuò fàn.
en: Because our mom loves us, she cooks every single day.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他仍然爱坚持运动。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn tā réngránh ài jiānchí yùndòng.
en: Even though work is hectic, he still insists on exercising regularly.

zh: 他对音乐的热爱已经成为他生活的一部分。
pinyin: Tā duì yīnyuè de rè'ài yǐjīng chéngwéi tā shēnghuó de yī búfen.
en: His passion for music has become an integral part of his life.

zh: 我带了一个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ dàile yī gè píngguǒ.
en: I brought an apple.

zh: 明天请你带上你的书来。
pinyin: Míngtiān qǐng nǐ dàishang nǐ de shū lái.
en: Please bring your books with you tomorrow.

zh: 因为下雨，我带了伞，所以没有淋湿。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒ dàile sǎn, suǒyǐ méiyǒu línshī.
en: Because it was raining, I brought an umbrella, so I didn't get wet.

zh: 这个项目需要带上专业的工具才能完成得好。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào dàishang zhuānyè de gōngjù cáinéng wánchéng de hǎo.
en: This project needs professional tools to be done well.

zh: 虽然他没有带过这么大的团队，但他的领导能力还是有目共睹的。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méiyǒu dàiguò zhème dà de tuánduì, dàn tā de lǐngdǎo nénglikǔ háishi yǒu mùgòng gòngdu睹 de.
en: Although he's never led such a large team before, his leadership abilities are plain for everyone to see.

zh: 我没有时间。
pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān.
en: I don't have time.

zh: 早上的时间很短，我很忙。
pinyin: Zǎoshang de shíjiān hěn duǎn, wǒ hěn máng.
en: My morning is short, and I'm very busy.

zh: 虽然时间不多，但是我想去公园走走。
pinyin: Suīrán shíjiān búduō, dànshì wǒ xiǎng qù gōngyuán zǒuzou.
en: Although I don't have much time, I still want to take a walk in the park.

zh: 因为工作很忙，我近来没有足够的时间陪家人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò hěn máng, wǒ jìnlái méiyǒu zúgòu de shíjiān péi jiārén.
en: Because work has been hectic, I haven't had enough time to spend with my family recently.

zh: 随着年纪增长，我越来越明白时间的珍贵。
pinyin: Suízhe niánjì zēngzhǎng, wǒ yuèláiyuè míngbai shíjiān de zhēnguì.
en: As I get older, I increasingly understand how precious time is.

zh: 我今年十岁。
pinyin: Wǒ jīnnián shí suì.
en: I'm ten years old.

zh: 去年我去了北京。
pinyin: Qùnián wǒ qù le běi jīng.
en: Last year I went to Beijing.

zh: 虽然今年很忙，但是我还是想去旅游。
pinyin: Suīrán jīnnián hěn máng, dànshì wǒ háishi xiǎng qù lǚyóu.
en: Even though this year has been busy, I still want to take a trip.

zh: 因为去年的经验，我今年更懂得怎样计划了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi qùnián de jīngyàn, wǒ jīnnián gèng dǒngde zěnyàng jìhuà le.
en: Because of last year's experience, I know better how to plan things this year.

zh: 这些年来，他一直坚持学习中文，如今已经可以自如交流了。
pinyin: Zhèxiē nián lái, tā yīzhí jiānchí xuéxí zhōngwén, rújīn yǐjīng kěyǐ zìrú jiāoliú le.
en: Over these years, he's consistently stuck with learning Chinese, and by now he can communicate quite fluently.

zh: 请坐。
pinyin: Qǐng zuò.
en: Please sit down.

zh: 请给我一杯水。
pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yī bēi shuǐ.
en: Could you give me a glass of water, please?

zh: 因为今天很忙，请你帮我买菜。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān hěn máng, qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ mǎi cài.
en: Since I'm really busy today, could you help me buy groceries?

zh: 请你不要告诉别人这个秘密。
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ búyào gàosu biérén zhège mìmì.
en: Please don't tell anyone else about this secret.

zh: 请务必在下周五之前把报告交给我。
pinyin: Qǐng wùbì zài xiàzhōuwǔ zhīqián bǎ bàogào jiāo gěi wǒ.
en: Please make sure to submit the report to me by next Friday without fail.

zh: 我回家了。
pinyin: Wǒ huí jiā le.
en: I went home.

zh: 昨天晚上我回到家很晚。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ huí dào jiā hěn wǎn.
en: I got back home very late last night.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我决定回办公室工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒ juéding huí bàngōngshì gōngzuò.
en: Because it was raining, I decided to go back to the office to work.

zh: 虽然她已经离开了城市，但她每个月还是会回来看望父母。
pinyin: Suīrán tā yǐjing líkāi le chéngshì, dàn tā měi ge yuè háishi huì huílái kànwàng fùmǔ.
en: Although she's moved away from the city, she still comes back every month to visit her parents.

zh: 这个项目回报率不错，投资者都对结果感到满意。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù huībào lǜ búcuò, tóuzī zhě dōu duì jiéguǒ gǎndào mǎnyì.
en: This project has a decent return on investment, and the investors are satisfied with the results.

zh: 我的工作很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de gōngzuò hěn hǎo.
en: My job is really good.

zh: 她每天工作八小时。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān gōngzuò bā xiǎoshí.
en: She works eight hours every day.

zh: 因为工作很忙，所以我没有时间休息。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān xiūxi.
en: Because work is so busy, I don't have time to rest.

zh: 虽然这份工作工资不高，但是工作环境很舒服。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè fèn gōngzuò gōngzī búgāo, dànshì gōngzuò huánjìng hěn shūfu.
en: Although this job doesn't pay much, the work environment is quite comfortable.

zh: 他在这家公司工作了五年，现在已经是部门负责人。
pinyin: Tā zài zhè jiā gōngsī gōngzuòle wǔ nián, xiànzài yǐjīng shì bùmén fùzérénren.
en: He's been working at this company for five years and is now a department head.

zh: 我吃饭，然后睡觉。
pinyin: Wǒ chīfàn, ránhòu shuìjiào.
en: I eat, and then I sleep.

zh: 他先喝咖啡，然后去上班。
pinyin: Tā xiān hē kāfēi, ránhòu qù shàngbān.
en: He drinks coffee first, then goes to work.

zh: 虽然今天很累，但我完成了作业，然后才休息。
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān hěn léi, dàn wǒ wánchéngle zuòyè, ránhòu cái xiūxi.
en: Even though I was tired today, I finished my homework, and only then did I rest.

zh: 他们讨论了很久，然后才同意了这个计划。
pinyin: Tāmen tǎolùnle hěnjiǔ, ránhòu cái tóngyìle zhège jìhuà.
en: They discussed it for a long time before finally agreeing to the plan.

zh: 经过多次失败的尝试，他逐渐改进了方法，然后成功地解决了这个问题。
pinyin: Jīngguò duōcì shībài de chǎngshì, tā zhújiàn gǎijìnle fāngfǎ, ránhòu chénggōnglì de jiějuéle zhège wèntí.
en: After several failed attempts, he gradually refined his approach, and ultimately solved the problem successfully.

zh: 当老师很好。
pinyin: Dāng lǎoshī hěn hǎo.
en: Being a teacher is really good.

zh: 我弟弟想当医生。
pinyin: Wǒ dìdi xiǎng dāng yīshēng.
en: My younger brother wants to become a doctor.

zh: 当我在家的时候，我喜欢看电视。
pinyin: Dāng wǒ zài jiā de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuān kàn diànshì.
en: When I'm at home, I like to watch TV.

zh: 他当了经理以后，工作变得更忙了。
pinyin: Tā dāngle jīnglǐ yǐhòu, gōngzuò biànde gèng máng le.
en: After he became a manager, his work got much busier.

zh: 当今社会的年轻人面临很多压力和机会。
pinyin: Dāngjīn shèhuì de niánqīngrén miànlín hěn duō yālì hé jīhuì.
en: Young people in today's society face a lot of pressure and opportunities.

zh: 我见过他。
pinyin: Wǒ jiàn guò tā.
en: I've met him before.

zh: 昨天我在公园见到了你的朋友。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài gōngyuán jiàn dào le nǐ de péngyou.
en: I ran into your friend at the park yesterday.

zh: 因为工作忙，我很久没见过家人了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò máng, wǒ hěn jiǔ méi jiàn guò jiārén le.
en: Because I've been so busy with work, I haven't seen my family in ages.

zh: 从这个角度来看，我们能更清楚地见到问题的本质。
pinyin: Cóng zhège jiǎodù lái kàn, wǒmen néng gèng qīngchǔ de jiàn dào wèntí de běnzhì.
en: From this perspective, we can see the core of the problem more clearly.

zh: 随着城市发展，我们见证了许多传统文化逐渐消失的过程。
pinyin: Suízhe chéngshì fāzhǎn, wǒmen jiànzhèng le xǔduō chuántǒng wénhuà zhújiàn xiāoshī de guòchéng.
en: As the city has developed, we've witnessed the gradual disappearance of much traditional culture.

zh: 我有一百块钱。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yībǎi kuài qián.
