en: I have one hundred yuan.

zh: 昨天我买书花了五十块钱。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎi shū huāle wǔshí kuài qián.
en: Yesterday I spent fifty yuan buying books.

zh: 因为没有钱，所以他没去旅游。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu qián, suǒyǐ tā méi qù lǚyóu.
en: Because he didn't have money, he didn't go on the trip.

zh: 虽然这个工作钱不多，但是很有意思。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò qián búduō, dànshì hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Although this job doesn't pay much, it's quite interesting.

zh: 现在的年轻人都想着赚钱，却忽视了身体健康。
pinyin: Xiànzài de niánqīngrén dōu xiǎngzhe zuàn qián, què húshìle shēntǐ jiànkāng.
en: Young people these days are all focused on making money, but they overlook their physical health.

zh: 噢，我喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Ó, wǒ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: Oh, I like eating rice.

zh: 噢，原来你今天不来上课啊。
pinyin: Ó, yuánlái nǐ jīntiān búlái shàngkè a.
en: Oh, so you're not coming to class today, I see.

zh: 噢，因为天气不好，所以他没有去公园。
pinyin: Ó, yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ tā méiyǒu qù gōngyuán.
en: Oh, because the weather was bad, he didn't go to the park.

zh: 噢，我这才明白了你之前为什么那么生气。
pinyin: Ó, wǒ zhè cái míngbaile nǐ zhīqián wèishéme nàme shēngqì.
en: Ah, now I understand why you were so angry back then.

zh: 噢，你的意思是说他虽然技术很强，但处事还是有点不成熟。
pinyin: Ó, nǐ de yìsi shi shuō tā suīrán jìshù hěn qiáng, dàn chǔshì háishi yǒudiǎn búchéngshú.
en: Oh, so you're saying that although his skills are excellent, his judgment is still a bit immature.

zh: 我和你一样喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ hé nǐ yīyàng xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: I like eating rice just like you do.

zh: 今天天气和昨天一样冷。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hé zuótiān yīyàng lěng.
en: The weather today is just as cold as it was yesterday.

zh: 虽然他们穿的衣服不一样，但是他们一样开心。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen chuān de yīfu búyīyàng, dànshi tāmen yīyàng kāixīn.
en: Although they're wearing different clothes, they're equally happy.

zh: 这个问题和上次考试的一样，所以学生们都答对了。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí hé shàng cì kǎoshì de yīyàng, suǒyǐ xuéshengmen dōu dá duì le.
en: This question is the same as the one from last exam, so all the students got it right.

zh: 不管环境多么恶劣，这些运动员的决心始终一样坚定。
pinyin: Búguǎn huánjìng duōme ěliè, zhèxiē yùndòng yuán de juéxīn shǐzhōng yīyàng jiāndìng.
en: No matter how harsh the conditions are, these athletes' determination remains equally unwavering.

zh: 今天的事情很多。
pinyin: Jīntiān de shìqing hěn duō.
en: There are a lot of things to do today.

zh: 昨天发生了一件有趣的事情。
pinyin: Zuótiān fāshēng le yī jiàn yǒuqù de shìqing.
en: Something interesting happened yesterday.

zh: 虽然这件事情很难,但是我会努力去做。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiàn shìqing hěn nán, dànshì wǒ huì nǔlì qù zuò.
en: Although this matter is difficult, I'll try my best to handle it.

zh: 他不想告诉我们真正的事情原因是什么。
pinyin: Tā búxiǎng gàosu wǒmen zhēnzhèng de shìqing yuányīn shì shénme.
en: He doesn't want to tell us what the real reason behind this situation is.

zh: 与其纠缠这些琐碎的事情,不如把精力放在重要的事上。
pinyin: Yǔqī jiūchán zhèxiē suǒsuì de shìqing, búrú bǎ jīnglì fàngzài zhòngyào de shì shang.
en: Rather than getting caught up in these trivial matters, it's better to focus your energy on what really matters.

zh: 我最喜欢的就是苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de jiùshì píngguǒ.
en: My favorite is apples.

zh: 他每天就是在家里看书。
pinyin: Tā měitiān jiùshì zài jiāli kànshū.
en: Every day he just stays home and reads.

zh: 虽然很累，但他就是坚持去上班。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn tā jiùshì jiānchí qù shàngbān.
en: Even though he was exhausted, he still insisted on going to work.

zh: 问题就是我们沟通不够，导致了很多误会。
pinyin: Wèntí jiùshì wǒmen gōutōng búgòu, dǎozhì le hěnduō wùhuì.
en: The thing is, we didn't communicate enough, which led to a lot of misunderstandings.

zh: 生活的意义就是在困难中找到属于自己的价值。
pinyin: Shēnghuó de yìyì jiùshì zài kùnnan zhōng zhǎodào shǔyú zìjǐ de jiàzhí.
en: The meaning of life is finding your own sense of worth in the face of challenges.

zh: 我吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ chī mǐfàn.
en: I eat rice.

zh: 早上我吃了一个苹果。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ chīle yī ge píngguǒ.
en: This morning I had an apple.

zh: 因为很饿，所以我吃得很快。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn饿，suǒyǐ wǒ chīde hěn kuài.
en: Because I was very hungry, I ate really fast.

zh: 虽然这家餐厅很贵，但是我们还是常常去吃。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā cāntīng hěn guì, dànshì wǒmen háishi chángcháng qù chī.
en: Even though this restaurant is expensive, we still go there to eat often.

zh: 在外面吃饭的时候，他从不吝啬给服务员小费。
pinyin: Zài wàimiàn chīfàn de shíhou, tā cóngbuì lìnshě gěi fúwùyuán xiǎofèi.
en: When eating out, he never hesitates to tip the server generously.

zh: 所有的书都在桌子上。
pinyin: Suǒyǒu de shū dōu zài zhuōzi shàng.
en: All the books are on the table.

zh: 今天所有的学生都来上课了。
pinyin: Jīntiān suǒyǒu de xuésheng dōu lái shànngkè le.
en: All the students came to class today.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但所有人还是去公园了。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dàn suǒyǒu rén háishi qù gōngyuán le.
en: Even though the weather was bad, everyone still went to the park.

zh: 公司决定给所有员工加工资，因为大家的表现都很好。
pinyin: Gōngsī juéding gěi suǒyǒu yuángōng jiā gōngzī, yīnwèi dàjiā de biǎoxiàn dōu hěn hǎo.
en: The company decided to give all employees a raise because everyone's performance has been excellent.

zh: 这个项目涉及所有部门的合作，所以需要充分沟通才能成功。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù shèjī suǒyǒu bùmén de hézuò, suǒyǐ xūyào chōngfèn gōutōng cáinéng chénggōng.
en: This project involves collaboration from all departments, so we need thorough communication to make it work.

zh: 我开门。
pinyin: Wǒ kāi mén.
en: I open the door.

zh: 早上我开车去上班。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ kāi chē qù shàngbān.
en: In the morning I drive to work.

zh: 因为天气很热，所以我们开了空调。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, suǒyǐ wǒmen kāile kōngtiào.
en: Because it was very hot, we turned on the air conditioning.

zh: 虽然他开了自己的小店，但是生意并不太好。
pinyin: Suīrán tā kāile zìjǐ de xiǎo diàn, dànshì shēngyì bìngbù tài hǎo.
en: Although he started his own small shop, the business hasn't been very good.

zh: 自从开始学中文以后，他就特别坚持每天练习。
pinyin: Zìcóng kāishǐ xué zhōngwén yǐhòu, tā jiù tèbié jiānchí měi tiān liànxí.
en: Ever since he began studying Chinese, he's been really committed to practicing every day.

zh: 我尝一下。
pinyin: Wǒ cháng yīxià.
en: Let me taste it.

zh: 请等一下，我马上来。
pinyin: Qǐng děng yīxià, wǒ mǎshàng lái.
en: Please wait a moment; I'll be right there.

zh: 因为天气不好，我们休息一下再走。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, wǒmen xiūxi yīxià zài zǒu.
en: Because the weather is bad, let's rest a bit before we leave.

zh: 虽然很累，但我想再试一下这个方法。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn wǒ xiǎng zài shì yīxià zhège fāngfǎ.
en: Even though I'm exhausted, I want to try this approach one more time.

zh: 我们先停一下讨论，听听别人的意见怎么样？
pinyin: Wǒmen xiān tíng yīxià tǎolùn, tīngtīng biérén de yìjiàn zěnyàng?
en: Let's pause our discussion for a moment and hear what others have to say—how does that sound?

zh: 我家有五口人。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
en: There are five people in my family.

zh: 每天早上我在家吃早饭。
pinyin: Měi tiān zǎo shang wǒ zài jiā chī zǎo fàn.
en: Every morning I eat breakfast at home.

zh: 因为今天下雨，所以我没有出家门。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīn tiān xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ méi yǒu chū jiā mén.
en: Because it rained today, I didn't leave the house.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但她周末还是会回家陪家人。
pinyin: Suīrán gōng zuò hěn máng, dàn tā zhōu mò háishi huì huí jiā péi jiā rén.
en: Although her job is busy, she still goes home on weekends to spend time with family.

zh: 他离开家乡多年后，终于找到了心灵的归属感。
pinyin: Tā lí kāi jiā xiāng duō nián hòu, zhōng yú zhǎo dào le xīn líng de guī shǔ gǎn.
en: After leaving his hometown for many years, he finally found a sense of belonging.

zh: 这个苹果非常甜。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ fēicháng tián.
en: This apple is very sweet.

zh: 昨天的天气非常冷，我穿了厚衣服。
pinyin: Zuótiān de tiānqì fēicháng lěng, wǒ chuānle hòu yīfu.
en: The weather yesterday was extremely cold, so I wore thick clothes.

zh: 虽然这部电影很长，但是我觉得非常有意思。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè bù diànyǐng hěn cháng, dànshì wǒ juéde fēicháng yǒu yìsi.
en: Although the movie was long, I found it very interesting.

zh: 因为他工作非常努力，所以老板决定给他加薪。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā gōngzuò fēicháng nǔlì, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn juédìng gěi tā jiāxīn.
en: Because he works extremely hard, his boss decided to give him a raise.

zh: 这次演讲的效果非常显著，观众们的反应也出乎意料地热烈。
pinyin: Zhè cì yǎnjiǎng de xiàoguǒ fēicháng xiǎnzhù, guānzhòngmen de fǎnyìng yě chūhū yìliào de règuó.
en: The speech had a remarkably strong effect, and the audience's response was unexpectedly enthusiastic.

zh: 我看到一只猫。
pinyin: Wǒ kàndào yī zhī māo.
en: I saw a cat.

zh: 早上我看到了很多人在公园里。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ kàndàole hěnduō rén zài gōngyuán lǐ.
en: This morning I saw a lot of people in the park.

zh: 虽然天很黑，但我还是看到了那个东西。
pinyin: Suīrán tiān hěn hēi, dànshì wǒ háishi kàndàole nàge dōngxi.
en: Even though it was dark outside, I still managed to see that thing.

zh: 从我的房间窗户，我可以看到城市的夜景。
pinyin: Cóng wǒ de fángjiān chuānghu, wǒ kěyǐ kàndào chéngshì de yèjǐng.
en: From my bedroom window, I can see the city lights at night.

zh: 走在街上时，我看到了一个朋友，但他没有看到我。
pinyin: Zǒu zài jiēshang shí, wǒ kàndàole yīge péngyou, dànshì tā méiyǒu kàndào wǒ.
en: While walking down the street, I spotted a friend, but he didn't notice me.

zh: 我希望吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng chī mǐfàn.
en: I hope to eat rice.

zh: 明天我希望去公园玩。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ xīwàng qù gōngyuán wán.
en: Tomorrow I hope to go play in the park.

zh: 虽然很累，但我还是希望今天能完成工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn wǒ háishi xīwàng jīntiān néng wánchéng gōngzuò.
en: Even though I'm exhausted, I still hope to finish work today.

zh: 他希望通过努力学习来改变自己的未来。
pinyin: Tā xīwàng tōngguò nǔlì xuéxí lái gǎibiàn zìjǐ de wèilái.
en: He hopes to change his future by studying hard.

zh: 与其坐以待毙，我们不如积极采取行动，希望能扭转局面。
pinyin: Yǔqī zuò yǐ dāibì, wǒmen búrú jījí cǎiqǔ xíngdòng, xīwàng néng niǔzhuǎn júmiàn.
en: Rather than sit and wait for disaster, we should take proactive steps and hope to turn things around.

zh: 那些是苹果。
pinyin: Nàxiē shì píngguǒ.
en: Those are apples.

zh: 我喜欢那些红色的花。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān nàxiē hóngsè de huā.
en: I like those red flowers.

zh: 虽然那些书很贵，但是我想买。
pinyin: Suīrán nàxiē shū hěn guì, dànshì wǒ xiǎng mǎi.
en: Although those books are expensive, I still want to buy them.

zh: 那些在会议上发言的人都是公司的高管。
pinyin: Nàxiē zài huìyì shang fāyán de rén dōu shì gōngsī de gāoguǎn.
en: The people who spoke at the meeting are all executives of the company.

zh: 关于那些历史问题，专家们众说纷纭，很难达成共识。
pinyin: Guānyú nàxiē lìshǐ wèntí, zhuānjiā men zhòngsuō fēnyún, hěn nán dáchéng gòngshí.
en: Regarding those historical issues, the experts have differing opinions and it's hard to reach consensus.

zh: 你的书在哪？
pinyin: Nǐ de shū zài nǎ?
en: Where is your book?

zh: 你今天去哪里吃饭了？
pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān qù nǎlǐ chīfàn le?
en: Where did you eat today?

zh: 我不知道他住在哪个城市，因为他很少告诉我。
pinyin: Wǒ búzhīdào tā zhùzài nǎge chéngshì, yīnwèi tā hěn shǎo gàosu wǒ.
en: I don't know which city he lives in, because he rarely tells me.

zh: 你知道那家餐厅在哪吗？我上次去过，但忘记了具体位置。
pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào nà jiā cāntīng zài nǎ ma? Wǒ shàng cì qùguò, dàn wàngjìle jùtǐ wèizhì.
en: Do you know where that restaurant is? I went there before, but I forgot the exact location.

zh: 他们还没决定哪个方案比较合适，所以今天的会议可能会开得比较长。
pinyin: Tāmen háishi méi juédìng nǎge fāng'àn bǐjiào héshì, suǒyǐ jīntiān de huìyì kěnéng huì kāi de bǐjiào cháng.
en: They still haven't decided which plan is more suitable, so today's meeting might run pretty long.

zh: 你喜欢吃米饭，当然可以。
pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn,当然 kěyǐ.
en: You like eating rice, so of course you can.

zh: 明天天气很好，我们当然要去公园。
pinyin: Míngtiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen 当然 yào qù gōngyuán.
en: The weather tomorrow will be nice, so naturally we should go to the park.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但当然不会忘记朋友的生日。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn 当然 búhuì wàngjì péngyou de shēngrì.
en: Even though he's busy, of course he won't forget his friend's birthday.

zh: 既然你已经努力学习了，进步当然是很正常的事。
pinyin: Jìrán nǐ yǐjīng nǔlì xuéxí le, jìnbù 当然 shì hěn zhèngcháng de shì.
en: Since you've been studying hard, making progress is naturally to be expected.

zh: 他有丰富的工作经验，所以升职当然在情理之中。
pinyin: Tā yǒu fēngfù de gōngzuò jīngyàn, suǒyǐ shēngzhí 当然 zài qíngǐ zhī zhōng.
en: He has rich work experience, so his promotion is naturally what you'd expect.

zh: 也许明天下雨。
pinyin: Yěxǔ míngtiān xiàyǔ.
en: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.

zh: 他也许喜欢吃米饭和鱼。
pinyin: Tā yěxǔ xǐhuān chī mǐfàn hé yú.
en: He might like eating rice and fish.

zh: 因为今天很冷，也许妈妈不会去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān hěn lěng, yěxǔ māma búhuì qù gōngyuán.
en: Since it's so cold today, maybe mom won't go to the park.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但也许他的考试成绩不会很理想。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, dàn yěxǔ tā de kǎoshì chéngjì búhuì hěn lǐxiǎng.
en: Even though he's smart, his exam results might not turn out as well as hoped.

zh: 也许是因为工作压力太大，最近他对什么事情都提不起兴趣。
pinyin: Yěxǔ shì yīnwèi gōngzuò yālì tài dà, zuìjìn tā duì shénme shìqing dōu tíbuqǐ xìngqù.
en: Probably because work stress is so overwhelming, he hasn't been interested in anything lately.

zh: 这个计划行吗？
pinyin: Zhège jìhuà xíng ma?
en: Is this plan okay?

zh: 明天天气好，我们一起去行走吧。
pinyin: Míngtiān tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen yìqǐ qù xíngzǒu ba.
en: The weather will be nice tomorrow, so let's go for a walk together.

zh: 虽然这条路很远，但是我们还是决定行动。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè tiáo lù hěn yuǎn, dànshì wǒmen háishi juéding xíngdòng.
en: Even though the route is far, we decided to go ahead with it anyway.

zh: 因为交通堵塞，他不得不改变行程，晚了一个小时。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jiāotōng dǔsè, tā búdébuzhī gǎibiàn xíngchéng, wǎn le yī ge xiǎoshí.
en: Because of traffic congestion, he had to change his itinerary and ended up an hour late.

zh: 这家公司虽然规模不大，但在行业内很有名气，服务行为也值得称赞。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán guīmó búdà, dàn zài hángyè nèi hěn yǒu míngqi, fúwù xíngwéi yě zhíde chēngzàn.
en: Although this company isn't large, it's quite well-known in the industry, and its service conduct is also praiseworthy.

zh: 我有一个朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī gè péngyou.
en: I have a friend.

zh: 昨天我和朋友一起吃饭。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé péngyou yīqǐ chīfàn.
en: Yesterday I had dinner with a friend.

zh: 虽然我们是新朋友,但是我们相处得很好。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen shì xīn péngyou, dànshì wǒmen xiāngchǔ de hěn hǎo.
en: Even though we're new friends, we get along really well.

zh: 因为工作太忙,我很久没有见我的朋友了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, wǒ hěnjiǔ méiyǒu jiàn wǒ de péngyou le.
en: Because work has been so busy, I haven't seen my friends in a long time.

zh: 真正的朋友不仅陪你笑,还会在你最困难的时候支持你。
pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyou búyǐn péi nǐ xiào, háishi huì zài nǐ zuì kùnnan de shíhou zhīchí nǐ.
en: A true friend not only laughs with you, but also supports you when you're going through the hardest times.

zh: 我妈妈很好。
pinyin: Wǒ māmā hěn hǎo.
en: My mom is very nice.

zh: 早上妈妈给我做早饭。
pinyin: Zǎoshang māmā gěi wǒ zuò zǎofàn.
en: In the morning, my mom makes breakfast for me.

zh: 因为妈妈很忙，所以我帮她做家务。
pinyin: Yīnwèi māmā hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒ bāng tā zuò jiāwù.
en: Because my mom is busy, I help her with the housework.

zh: 妈妈虽然工作很累，但是每天都坚持接我放学。
pinyin: Māmā suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì měitiān dōu jiānchíjiē wǒ fàngxué.
en: Although my mom is exhausted from work, she still insists on picking me up from school every day.

zh: 听妈妈讲她年轻时的故事，我才明白了她为什么这么要求我们。
pinyin: Tīng māmā jiǎng tā niánqīng shí de gùshi, wǒ cái míngbai le tā wèishéme zhème yāoqiú wǒmen.
en: After listening to my mom tell stories about her youth, I finally understood why she has such high expectations for us.

zh: 我相信妈妈。
pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn māma.
en: I trust my mom.

zh: 我相信明天会下雨。
pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn míngtiān huì xiàyǔ.
en: I believe it will rain tomorrow.

zh: 因为他很聪明，所以我相信他能做好。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn聪míng, suǒyǐ wǒ xiāngxìn tā néng zuòhǎo.
en: Because he's smart, I'm confident he can do it well.

zh: 虽然有困难，但我们都相信这个项目会成功。
pinyin: Suīrán yǒu kùnnan, dàn wǒmen dōu xiāngxìn zhège xiàngmù huì chéngōng.
en: Even though there are challenges, we all believe this project will succeed.

zh: 在这个信息时代，我们更应该学会辨别，而不是盲目相信网上的每一个消息。
pinyin: Zài zhège xìnxī shídài, wǒmen gèng yīnggāi xuéhuì biànbié, érbuìshi māngmù xiāngxìn wǎngshang de měi yī ge xiāoxī.
en: In this information age, we should learn to discern rather than blindly believe every message online.

zh: 我前面有一个人。
pinyin: Wǒ qiánmiàn yǒu yī gè rén.
en: There's a person in front of me.

zh: 昨天前我没有看过这部电影。
pinyin: Zuótiān qián wǒ méiyǒu kànguò zhè bù diànyǐng.
en: I hadn't seen this movie before yesterday.

zh: 虽然前面很拥挤，但是我们还是继续往前走。
pinyin: Suīrán qiánmiàn hěn yōngjǐ, dànshì wǒmen háishi jìxù wǎng qián zǒu.
en: Although it was crowded ahead, we kept moving forward anyway.

zh: 在提交报告之前，你需要检查一下所有的数据。
pinyin: Zài tíjiāo bàogào zhīqián, nǐ xūyào jiǎnchá yīxià suǒyǒu de shùjù.
en: Before submitting the report, you need to double-check all the data.

zh: 根据前几年的经验，我们应该提前做好充分的准备。
pinyin: Gēnjù qián jǐ nián de jīngyàn, wǒmen yīnggāi tíqián zuòhǎo充fēn de zhǔnbèi.
en: Based on experience from the past few years, we should prepare thoroughly in advance.

zh: 嗨，你好！
pinyin: Hāi, nǐ hǎo!
en: Hey, how are you!

zh: 昨天我在公园里嗨了一整天。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài gōngyuán lǐ hāi le yì zhěngtiān.
en: Yesterday I had a blast in the park all day long.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但我们还是和朋友们嗨到很晚。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dàn wǒmen háishi hé péngyoumen hāi dào hěn wǎn.
en: Even though the weather was bad, we still had fun with friends until late.

zh: 派对上大家都很嗨，音乐一直放到了凌晨两点。
pinyin: Pàiduì shàng dàjiā dōu hěn hāi, yīnyuè yìzhí fàng dào le língchén liǎng diǎn.
en: Everyone at the party was really hyped; the music didn't stop until 2 AM.

zh: 那个演唱会简直绝了，五万多粉丝一起嗨，现场气氛热得不行。
pinyin: Nàge yǎnchànghuì jiǎnzhí juéle, wǔ wàn duō fěnsī yìqǐ hāi, xiànchǎng qìfēn rè de búxíng.
en: That concert was absolutely incredible—fifty thousand fans going wild together, the energy was completely insane.

zh: 我认为这个苹果很好吃。
pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi zhège píngguǒ hěn hǎochī.
en: I think this apple tastes really good.

zh: 他认为昨天的电影很有意思。
pinyin: Tā rènwéi zuótiān de diànyǐng hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: He thinks yesterday's movie was really interesting.

zh: 虽然价格贵，但我认为质量很好。
pinyin: Suīrán jiàgé guì, dàn wǒ rènwéi zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
en: Even though it's expensive, I think the quality is excellent.

zh: 大多数人认为学习外语需要花很多时间。
pinyin: Dàduōshù rén rènwéi xuéxí wàiyǔ xūyào huā hěn duō shíjiān.
en: Most people believe that learning a foreign language requires a lot of time.

zh: 虽然他成绩不错，但老师认为他还有很大的进步空间。
pinyin: Suīrán tā chéngjì búcuò, dàn lǎoshī rènwéi tā háiyǒu hěn dà de jìnbù kōngjiān.
en: Although his grades are decent, the teacher believes he still has considerable room for improvement.

zh: 我将吃午饭。
pinyin: Wǒ jiāng chī wǔfàn.
en: I'm going to eat lunch.

zh: 明天我将去公园玩。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ jiāng qù gōngyuán wán.
en: Tomorrow I'm going to go play in the park.

zh: 因为下雨了，我们将推迟比赛时间。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, wǒmen jiāng tuīchíhuǎn bǐsài shíjiān.
en: Because it's raining, we're going to postpone the game.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他仍将按时完成这个项目。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn tā réng jiāng ànshí wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
en: Although work is hectic, he's still going to finish this project on time.

zh: 如果我们继续这样浪费资源，将来必然会面临严重的后果。
pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒmen jìxù zhèyàng làngfèi zīyuán, jiānglái bìránhuì miànlín yánzhòng de hòuguǒ.
en: If we keep wasting resources like this, we're bound to face serious consequences down the line.

zh: 这儿有苹果。
pinyin: Zhè'er yǒu píngguǒ.
en: There are apples here.

zh: 早上我在这儿吃早饭。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ zài zhè'er chī zǎofàn.
en: I eat breakfast here in the morning.

zh: 因为这儿很安静，所以我喜欢在这儿学习。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè'er hěn ānjìng, suǒyǐ wǒ xǐhuān zài zhè'er xuéxí.
en: Because it's quiet here, I like studying in this place.

zh: 虽然这儿的房租很贵，但是位置特别好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè'er de fángzū hěn guì, dànshì wèizhì tèbié hǎo.
en: Although the rent here is expensive, the location is really convenient.

zh: 自从搬到这儿以后，我们的生活质量明显改善了。
pinyin: Zìcóng bāndào zhè'er yǐhòu, wǒmen de shēnghuó zhìliàng míngxiǎn gǎishàn le.
en: Ever since we moved here, our quality of life has noticeably improved.

zh: 今天我吃米饭。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ chī mǐfàn.
en: I'm eating rice today.

zh: 今天天气很好,我们去公园。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen qù gōngyuán.
en: The weather is nice today, so we're going to the park.

zh: 虽然今天下雨,但是我还是要上班。
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān xiàyǔ, dànshì wǒ háishi yào shàngbān.
en: Even though it's raining today, I still have to go to work.

zh: 今天在公司开会的时候,我提了一个新想法。
pinyin: Jīntiān zài gōngsī kāihuì de shíhou, wǒ tíle yīge xīn xiǎngfǎ.
en: During today's meeting at the office, I brought up a new idea.

zh: 今天的销售数据比预期增长了百分之二十,真是出乎意料。
pinyin: Jīntiān de xiāoshòu shùjù bǐ yùqī zēngzhǎngle bǎifēnzhī èrshí, zhēnshi chūhúyìliào.
en: Today's sales figures grew twenty percent more than expected—quite a pleasant surprise.

zh: 我明白了。
pinyin: Wǒ míngbai le.
en: I understand.

zh: 你说得很清楚，我现在明白了。
pinyin: Nǐ shuō de hěn qīngchǔ, wǒ xiànzài míngbai le.
en: You explained it clearly, and I understand now.

zh: 虽然这个问题很难，但我经过思考还是明白了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège wèntí hěn nán, dàn wǒ jīngguò sīkǎo háishi míngbai le.
en: Although the question was difficult, I figured it out after thinking about it.

zh: 他终于明白了为什么老板对他的工作不太满意。
pinyin: Tā zhōngyú míngbai le wèishéme lǎobǎn duì tā de gōngzuò búguò tài mǎnyì.
en: He finally understood why his boss wasn't very satisfied with his work.

zh: 经过几次失败的经历，他才真正明白了成功需要坚持和耐心。
pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ cì shībài de jīnglì, tā cái zhēnzhèng míngbai le chéngōng xūyào jiānchí hé nàixīn.
en: Only after several failures did he truly grasp that success requires persistence and patience.

zh: 我一直喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yīzhí xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: I've always liked eating rice.

zh: 他一直在家里看书。
pinyin: Tā yīzhí zài jiāli kànshū.
en: He's been reading at home the whole time.

zh: 虽然很累,但我一直坚持去跑步。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn wǒ yīzhí jiānchí qù pǎobù.
en: Even though I'm tired, I keep going jogging.

zh: 因为工作太忙,她一直没有时间回家。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, tā yīzhí méiyǒu shíjiān huījiā.
en: Because work has been so busy, she hasn't had time to go home.

zh: 这个公司一直秉持诚实守信的原则,赢得了很多客户的信任。
pinyin: Zhège gōngsī yīzhí bǐngchí chéngshí shǒuxìn de yuáncé, yíngdéle hěnduō kèhù de xìnrèn.
en: This company has consistently adhered to principles of honesty and integrity, earning the trust of many clients.

zh: 我想看看你的书。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kànkan nǐ de shū.
en: I'd like to take a look at your book.

zh: 明天我们去看看新的电影吧。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒmen qù kànkan xīn de diànyǐng ba.
en: Tomorrow let's go check out the new movie.

zh: 因为天气很好，我们去公园看看吧。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen qù gōngyuán kànkan ba.
en: Since the weather is nice, let's go take a walk in the park.

zh: 你先把报告写完，我等一下再看看。
pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ bàogào xiěwán, wǒ děng yīxià zài kànkan.
en: Finish the report first, and I'll review it in a moment.

zh: 这个问题比较复杂，让我仔细看看再给你答复。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí bǐjiào fùzá, ràng wǒ zǐxì kànkan zài gěi nǐ dáfù.
en: This issue is rather complicated—let me look it over carefully before I get back to you.

zh: 我的车很新。
pinyin: Wǒ de chē hěn xīn.
en: My car is very new.

zh: 昨天我开车去了公园。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kāichē qùle gōngyuán.
en: Yesterday I drove to the park.

zh: 因为堵车，所以我迟到了半小时。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dǔchē, suǒyǐ wǒ chídàole bàn xiǎoshí.
en: Because of traffic, I was half an hour late.

zh: 他买车的时候虽然花了很多钱，但是很满意。
pinyin: Tā mǎichē de shíhou suīrán huāle hěnduō qián, dànshi hěn mǎnyì.
en: Although he spent a lot of money when he bought the car, he's very satisfied with it.

zh: 现在很多年轻人选择坐公交车而不是买私家车，为了保护环境。
pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō niánqīngrén xuǎnzé zuò gōngjiāochē érbúshì mǎi sījiāchē, wèile bǎohù huánjìng.
en: Nowadays, many young people choose to take public buses instead of buying private cars to protect the environment.

zh: 现在什么时候？
pinyin: Xiànzài shénme shíhou?
en: What time is it now?

zh: 早上八点的时候我吃早饭。
pinyin: Zǎoshang bā diǎn de shíhou wǒ chī zǎofàn.
en: I eat breakfast at eight in the morning.

zh: 虽然那时候很忙，但是我还是去了朋友的派对。
pinyin: Suīrán nà shíhou hěn máng, dànshi wǒ háishi qùle péngyou de pàiduì.
en: Even though I was busy back then, I still went to my friend's party.

zh: 每次有重要会议的时候，他都会提前准备好所有资料。
pinyin: Měi cì yǒu zhòngyào huìyì de shíhou, tā dōu huì tíqiān zhǔnbèi hǎo suǒyǒu zīliào.
en: Whenever there's an important meeting, he always prepares all the documents in advance.

zh: 当今时代，年轻人需要既掌握传统技能，又适应快速变化的技术环境。
pinyin: Dāngjīn shídài, niánqīng rén xūyào jì zhǎng握 chuántǒng jìnéng, yòu shìyìng kuàisù biànhuà de jìshù huánjìng.
en: In today's era, young people need to both master traditional skills and adapt to rapidly changing technology.

zh: 我们杀了一只鸡。
pinyin: Wǒmen shāle yī zhī jī.
en: We killed a chicken.

zh: 昨天妈妈杀了两条鱼做饭。
pinyin: Zuótiān māma shāle liǎng tiáo yú zuòfàn.
en: Yesterday Mom killed two fish to cook dinner.

zh: 因为要做红烧肉，所以爸爸杀了一只猪。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yào zuò hóngshāo ròu, suǒyǐ bàba shāle yī zhī zhū.
en: Because we needed to make braised pork, Dad killed a pig.

zh: 虽然我不喜欢杀生，但做这道菜必须杀鸡。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ búxǐhuan shāshēng, dàn zuò zhè dào cài bìxū shā jī.
en: Although I don't like killing animals, we have to kill a chicken to make this dish.

zh: 在农村，很多人会自己杀牲口，这样可以节省买肉的钱。
pinyin: Zài nóngcūn, hěnduō rén huì zìjǐ shā shēngkǒu, zhèyàng kěyǐ jiéshěng mǎi ròu de qián.
en: In rural areas, lots of people slaughter their own livestock to save money on buying meat.

zh: 这个地方很好。
pinyin: Zhège dìfang hěn hǎo.
en: This place is really nice.

zh: 我喜欢那个地方，因为很安静。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān nàge dìfang, yīnwèi hěn ānjìng.
en: I like that place because it's very quiet.

zh: 虽然这个地方远，但是景色很美。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège dìfang yuǎn, dànshi jǐngsè hěn měi.
en: Although this place is far away, the scenery is really beautiful.

zh: 他找了很久才找到停车的地方。
pinyin: Tā zhǎole hěnjiǔ cái zhǎodào tíngchē de dìfang.
en: He searched for a long time before he finally found a place to park.

zh: 这个地方虽然不起眼，但美食特别地道，很多人来这里吃饭。
pinyin: Zhège dìfang suīrán búqǐyǎn, dàn měishí tèbié dìdào, hěnduō rén lái zhèlǐ chīfàn.
en: This place might not look special, but the food is authentically delicious, and lots of people come here to eat.

zh: 这个苹果很好吃，不过有点酸。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ hěn hǎochī, búguò yǒudiǎn suān.
en: This apple tastes good, but it's a bit sour.

zh: 昨天下雨了，不过我还是去公园了。
pinyin: Zuótiān xiàyǔ le, búguò wǒ háishi qù gōngyuán le.
en: It rained yesterday, but I still went to the park anyway.

zh: 虽然他很忙，但不过他还是有时间帮助我们。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dàn búguò tā háishi yǒu shíjiān bāngzhù wǒmen.
en: Although he's very busy, he still manages to find time to help us.

zh: 这部电影的故事不错，不过特效有些过时了。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de gùshi búcuò, búguò tèxiào yǒuxiē guòshí le.
en: The story in this movie is pretty good, but the special effects are somewhat outdated.

zh: 他的想法虽然有一定道理，不过缺乏实际考虑，难以实施。
pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ suīrán yǒu yīdìng dàolǐ, búguò quēfá shíjì kǎolǜ, nányǐ shíshī.
en: His ideas make some sense in theory, but they lack practical consideration and are hard to implement.

zh: 呃，我叫李明。
pinyin: Ē, wǒ jiào Lǐ Míng.
en: Um, my name is Li Ming.

zh: 呃，我昨天吃了很多米饭。
pinyin: Ē, wǒ zuótiān chīle hěnduō mǐfàn.
en: Uh, I ate a lot of rice yesterday.

zh: 呃，虽然今天很冷，但是我还是想去公园。
pinyin: Ē, suīrán jīntiān hěn lěng, dànshì wǒ háishi xiǎng qù gōngyuán.
en: Well, even though it's cold today, I still want to go to the park.

zh: 呃，你说的问题确实很难回答，我需要想一下。
pinyin: Ē, nǐ shuō de wèntí quèshí hěn nán huídá, wǒ xūyào xiǎng yīxià.
en: Um, that's actually a really tough question you're asking—let me think about it for a second.

zh: 呃，关于那个项目的进展，我们还需要跟客户沟通一下具体的时间表。
pinyin: Ē, guānyú nàge xiàngmù de jìnzhǎn, wǒmen háishi xūyào跟 kèhù gōutōng yīxià jùtǐ de shíjiānbiǎo.
en: Well, regarding the project's progress, we still need to discuss the specific timeline with the client.

zh: 今天发生了什么？
pinyin: Jīntiān fāshēngle shénme?
en: What happened today?

zh: 昨天晚上发生了一个有趣的事情。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang fāshēngle yī ge yǒuqù de shìqing.
en: Something interesting happened last night.

zh: 因为下雨，所以发生了一场车祸。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ fāshēngle yī chǎng chēhuò.
en: Because of the rain, a car accident occurred.

zh: 虽然我们做了准备，但还是发生了意外的问题。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen zuòle zhǔnbèi, dàn háishi fāshēngle yìwài de wèntí.
en: Even though we prepared, unexpected problems still came up.

zh: 在生活中，有些最重要的改变往往发生在我们毫不知觉的时候。
pinyin: Zài shēnghuó zhōng, yǒuxiē zuì zhòngyào de gǎibiàn wǎngwǎng fāshēng zài wǒmen háobù zhījué de shíhou.
en: In life, some of the most important changes often happen when we least expect them.

zh: 你有几个苹果？
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu jǐ gè píngguǒ?
en: How many apples do you have?

zh: 今天你吃了几碗米饭？
pinyin: Jīntiān nǐ chīle jǐ wǎn mǐfàn?
en: How many bowls of rice did you eat today?

zh: 虽然我只睡了几个小时，但是我还是很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ zhǐ shuìle jǐ ge xiǎoshí, búguò wǒ háishi hěn kāixīn.
en: Even though I only slept a few hours, I'm still in a good mood.

zh: 因为下雨，所以今天只有几个学生来上课。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ jīntiān zhǐyǒu jǐ ge xuésheng lái shàngkè.
en: Because it rained, only a few students showed up to class today.

zh: 这个项目虽然投入了几百万，但几个月后就失败了，真是得不偿失。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù suīrán tóuruìle jǐ bǎi wàn, búguò jǐ ge yuè hòu jiù shībàile, zhēnshi débuzhàngcháng shī.
en: Although the project invested several million, it failed after just a few months—a real waste of effort.

zh: 妈妈回来了。
pinyin: Māma huílái le.
en: Mom is back.

zh: 他下午三点回来吃饭。
pinyin: Tā xiàwǔ sāndiǎn huílái chīfàn.
en: He'll come back at 3 p.m. to eat dinner.

zh: 虽然他昨天出去了，但是他今天早上回来了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zuótiān chūqù le, dànshì tā jīntiān zǎoshang huílái le.
en: Although he went out yesterday, he came back this morning.

zh: 因为天气不好，所以我们提前回来了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen tíqián huílái le.
en: Because the weather was bad, we came back early.

zh: 他在国外工作了五年，最后还是决定回来发展。
pinyin: Tā zài guówaì gōngzuò le wǔ nián, zuìhòu háishi juéding huílái fāzhǎn.
en: After working abroad for five years, he ultimately decided to come back and develop his career here.

zh: 我准备吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǔnbèi chīfàn.
en: I'm going to eat.

zh: 明天我准备去公园玩。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ zhǔnbèi qù gōngyuán wán.
en: Tomorrow I'm planning to go play in the park.

zh: 因为要下雨,所以我准备带伞。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yào xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ zhǔnbèi dài sǎn.
en: Because it's going to rain, I'm getting ready to bring an umbrella.

zh: 虽然时间紧张,但我们已经准备好了报告。
pinyin: Suīrán shíjiān jǐnzhāng, dàn wǒmen yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo le bàogào.
en: Even though time is tight, we've already prepared the report.

zh: 为了这次面试,他提前两周就开始准备复习材料。
pinyin: Wèile zhè cì miànshì, tā tíqián liǎng zhōu jiù kāishǐ zhǔnbèi fùxí cáiliào.
en: To prepare for this interview, he started gathering review materials two weeks in advance.

zh: 我找到了钥匙。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǎodào le yàoshi.
en: I found my keys.

zh: 昨天我在公园里找到了一只猫。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài gōngyuán lǐ zhǎodào le yī zhī māo.
en: Yesterday I found a cat in the park.

zh: 因为我仔细寻找，所以最后找到了那份重要的文件。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ zǐxì xúnzhǎo, suǒyǐ zuìhòu zhǎodào le nà fèn zhòngyào de wénjiàn.
en: Because I searched carefully, I eventually found that important document.

zh: 虽然这家店很隐蔽，但我们还是找到了它的位置。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā diàn hěn yǐnbì, dàn wǒmen háishi zhǎodào le tā de wèizhì.
en: Although the shop was quite hidden, we still managed to find its location.

zh: 经过几个月的调查，警察终于找到了那起案件的关键证人。
pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè de tiáochá, jǐngchá zhōngyú zhǎodào le nà qǐ ànjiàn de guānjiàn zhèngrén.
en: After months of investigation, the police finally found the key witness to the case.

zh: 吃饭后我睡觉。
pinyin: Chīfàn hòu wǒ shuìjiào.
en: After eating, I sleep.

zh: 下课后，我和朋友去公园。
pinyin: Xiàkè hòu, wǒ hé péngyou qù gōngyuán.
en: After class, my friend and I go to the park.

zh: 虽然今天很忙，但是工作完成后我会很开心。
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān hěn máng, dànshì gōngzuò wánchéng hòu wǒ huì hěn kāixīn.
en: Even though I'm busy today, I'll be really happy once I finish my work.

zh: 他毕业后决定去北京工作，而不是留在家乡。
pinyin: Tā bìyè hòu juédìng qù Běijīng gōngzuò, érbúshì liúzài jiāxiāng.
en: After graduation, he decided to work in Beijing rather than stay in his hometown.

zh: 经过多年的努力之后，她终于在这个领域取得了显著的成就。
pinyin: Jīngguò duōnián de nǔlì zhī hòu, tā zhōngyú zài zhège lǐngyù qǔdéle xiǎnzhù de chéngjiù.
en: After years of hard work, she finally achieved significant success in this field.

zh: 爸爸喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Bàba xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: Dad likes to eat rice.

zh: 我的爸爸每天早上跑步。
pinyin: Wǒ de bàba měi tiān zǎoshang pǎobù.
en: My dad goes running every morning.

zh: 因为爸爸工作很忙，所以他周末才回家。
pinyin: Yīnwèi bàba gōngzuò hěn máng, suǒyǐ tā zhōumò cái huíjiā.
en: Because Dad's work is very busy, he only comes home on weekends.

zh: 爸爸虽然不会做饭，但是他很会修东西。
pinyin: Bàba suīrán búhuì zuòfàn, dànshì tā hěn huì xiū dōngxi.
en: Although Dad can't cook, he's really good at fixing things.

zh: 爸爸的事业成功了，但他从不骄傲，反而更加谦虚。
pinyin: Bàba de shìyè chénggōng le, dàn tā cóng bújiāo'ào, fǎn'ér gèngjiā qiānxū.
en: Dad's business became successful, but he's never arrogant about it—in fact, he's even more humble.

zh: 一切都很好。
pinyin: Yīqiē dōu hěn hǎo.
en: Everything is fine.

zh: 今天一切都准备好了。
pinyin: Jīntiān yīqiē dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
en: Everything is ready today.

zh: 虽然计划改了，但一切还是按时进行。
pinyin: Suīrán jìhuà gǎi le, dàn yīqiē háishi ànshí jìnxíng.
en: Even though the plan changed, everything still proceeded on schedule.

zh: 因为他们沟通不好，所以一切变得很复杂。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tāmen gōutōng búhǎo, suǒyǐ yīqiē biàn de hěn fùzá.
en: Because they didn't communicate well, everything became complicated.

zh: 他对工作的态度很认真，一切细节都不放过。
pinyin: Tā duì gōngzuò de tàidù hěn rènzhēn, yīqiē xì节 dōu búfàngguò.
en: He takes his work very seriously and doesn't overlook any details.

zh: 我迟到了，很抱歉。
pinyin: Wǒ chídào le, hěn bàoqiàn.
en: I'm late. I'm really sorry.

zh: 昨天我忘记了，现在很抱歉。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ wàngjì le, xiànzài hěn bàoqiàn.
en: I forgot yesterday, and I'm sorry about it now.

zh: 因为天气不好，我们不能去，真的很抱歉。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, wǒmen búnéng qù, zhēnde hěn bàoqiàn.
en: Because of the bad weather, we can't go. We're really sorry.

zh: 虽然我提前通知了，但还是给你添麻烦，抱歉。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ tíqián tōngzhī le, dàn háishi gěi nǐ tiānmaófan, bàoqiàn.
en: Even though I gave you notice ahead of time, I still caused you trouble, and I apologize.

zh: 这次项目延期确实出乎意料，给各位带来不便，实在抱歉。
pinyin: Zhè cì xiàngmù yánqī quèshí chūhū yìliào, gěi gèwèi dàilái búbiàn, shízài bàoqiàn.
en: The project delay this time was genuinely unexpected and has caused inconvenience for everyone. I sincerely apologize.

zh: 我比你高。
pinyin: Wǒ bǐ nǐ gāo.
en: I'm taller than you.

zh: 今天比昨天冷多了。
pinyin: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng duō le.
en: Today is much colder than yesterday.

zh: 虽然他比我年轻，但是他工作经验丰富。
pinyin: Suīrán tā bǐ wǒ niánqīng, dànshì tā gōngzuò jīngyàn fēngfù.
en: Although he's younger than me, he has plenty of work experience.

zh: 和去年相比，今年的销售额增长了百分之二十。
pinyin: Hé qùnián xiāngbǐ, jīnnián de xiāoshòu é zēngzhǎng le bǎifēnzhī èrshí.
en: Compared to last year, this year's sales have grown by twenty percent.

zh: 她的表现无与伦比，比赛结束后得到了全场掌声。
pinyin: Tā de biǎoxiàn wúyǔlúnbǐ, bǐsài jiéshù hòu dé到le quánchǎng zhǎngshēng.
en: Her performance was incomparable, and she received a standing ovation when the competition ended.

zh: 这个苹果很甜，感觉很好。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ hěn tián, gǎnjué hěn hǎo.
en: This apple is sweet; it feels really nice.

zh: 昨天我很累，今天感觉还是没有力气。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hěn lèi, jīntiān gǎnjué háishi méiyǒu lìqi.
en: I was exhausted yesterday, and I still feel tired today.

zh: 虽然下雨了，但是我的感觉是今天会放晴。
pinyin: Suīrán xiàyǔ le, búshì wǒ de gǎnjué shì jīntiān huì fàngqíng.
en: Although it's raining, I have a feeling it will clear up today.

zh: 自从搬到新城市，我对这里的感觉慢慢变得更好了。
pinyin: Zìcóng bānzào xīn chéngshì, wǒ duì zhèlǐ de gǎnjué màanman biàndé gèng hǎo le.
en: Since moving to this new city, my feelings toward it have gradually improved.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但那种被需要的感觉让我觉得特别有意义。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, búshì nàzhǒng bèi xūyào de gǎnjué ràng wǒ juéde tèbié yǒu yìyì.
en: Even though work is hectic, that sense of being needed makes me feel like what I do really matters.

zh: 我吃了一些米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ chīle yīxiē mǐfàn.
en: I ate some rice.

zh: 今天我买了一些水果和蔬菜。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ mǎile yīxiē shuǐguǒ hé shūcài.
en: Today I bought some fruit and vegetables.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但是有些人还是喜欢跑步。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì yǒuxiē rén háishi xǐhuān pǎobù.
en: Although the weather is cold, some people still like to run.

zh: 因为工作比较忙，我这些天没有时间陪家人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò bǐjiào máng, wǒ zhèxiē tiān méiyǒu shíjiān péi jiārén.
en: Because work has been quite hectic, I haven't had time to spend with my family these past few days.

zh: 他提出的这些建议虽然有些武断，但确实值得我们认真考虑。
pinyin: Tā tíchūde zhèxiē jiànyì suīrán yǒuxiē wǔduàn, dàn quèshí zhíde wǒmen rènzhēn kǎolǜ.
en: Though some of the suggestions he put forward are a bit hasty, they're definitely worth our serious consideration.

zh: 我只是喝水。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǐshì hēshuǐ.
en: I'm just drinking water.

zh: 他只是看了一下手机。
pinyin: Tā zhǐshì kànle yīxià shǒujī.
en: He only took a quick look at his phone.

zh: 虽然很贵，但我只是想买一件。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn guì, dàn wǒ zhǐshì xiǎng mǎi yī jiàn.
en: Even though it's expensive, I just want to buy one.

zh: 他说自己只是个普通员工，但实际上很重要。
pinyin: Tā shuō zìjǐ zhǐshì ge pǔtōng yuángōng, dàn shíjìshang hěn zhòngyào.
en: He says he's just an ordinary employee, but he's actually quite important.

zh: 这只是开始，不要因为一点困难就放弃。
pinyin: Zhè zhǐshì kāishǐ, búyào yīnwèi yīdiǎn kùnnan jiù fàngqì.
en: This is only the beginning—don't give up just because of a little difficulty.

zh: 这个苹果怎么样？
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ zěnyàng?
en: How is this apple?

zh: 今天天气怎么样？很冷吗？
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì zěnyàng? Hěn lěng ma?
en: How's the weather today? Is it very cold?

zh: 虽然价格有点贵，但是质量怎么样？
pinyin: Suīrán jiàgé yǒudiǎn guì, dànshì zhìliàng zěnyàng?
en: Even though it's a bit pricey, what's the quality like?

zh: 你觉得这个新项目怎么样？值得投资吗？
pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhège xīn xiàngmù zěnyàng? Zhídé tóuzī ma?
en: What do you think of this new project? Is it worth investing in?

zh: 他的工作表现这半年来怎么样？是否有明显的进步？
pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn zhè bàn nián lái zěnyàng? Shìfǒu yǒu míngxiǎn de jìnbù?
en: How has his work performance been over the past six months? Has there been any noticeable improvement?

zh: 猫出来了。
pinyin: māo chūlái le.
en: The cat came out.

zh: 早上太阳出来了，天气很好。
pinyin: Zǎoshang tàiyáng chūlái le, tiānqì hěn hǎo.
en: This morning the sun came out, and the weather is lovely.

zh: 虽然下雨了，但是我们还是走出来了。
pinyin: Suīrán xiàyǔ le, dànshì wǒmen háishi zǒu chūlái le.
en: Even though it was raining, we still came out anyway.

zh: 他在会议上说出来的想法让大家都很惊讶。
pinyin: Tā zài huìyì shang shuō chūlái de xiǎngfǎ ràng dàjiā dōu hěn jīngyà.
en: The ideas he voiced at the meeting surprised everyone.

zh: 这个问题一直憋在心里，直到昨天才说出来。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí yīzhí biēzài xīnli, zhídào zuótiān cái shuō chūlái.
en: I'd been holding back this concern for a while, but finally let it out yesterday.

zh: 不要吃糖。
pinyin: Búyào chī táng.
en: Don't eat candy.

zh: 晚上不要喝咖啡,会睡不好。
pinyin: Wǎnshang búyào hē kāfēi, huì shuì bu hǎo.
en: Don't drink coffee in the evening—it'll keep you awake.

zh: 因为天气不好,所以不要出门的时候带伞。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì bu hǎo, suǒyǐ búyào chūmén de shíhou dài sǎn.
en: Because the weather's bad, don't forget to bring an umbrella when you go out.

zh: 虽然他很生气,但我们还是不要跟他吵架比较好。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn shēngqì, dàn wǒmen háishi búyào gēn tā chǎojià bǐjiào hǎo.
en: Even though he's really angry, it's probably better if we don't argue with him.

zh: 这个项目很重要,所以不要在最后一刻才才开始准备。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ búyào zài zuìhòu yī kè cái kāishǐ zhǔnbèi.
en: This project is crucial, so don't leave preparation until the last minute.

zh: 对不起，我迟到了。
pinyin: Duìbúqǐ, wǒ chídào le.
en: Sorry, I'm late.

zh: 对不起，我昨天没有给你打电话。
pinyin: Duìbúqǐ, wǒ zuótiān méiyǒu gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
en: I'm sorry—I didn't call you yesterday.

zh: 虽然我很忙，但我还是要说对不起，因为我忘记了你的生日。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ hěn máng, dàn wǒ háishi yào shuō duìbúqǐ, yīnwèi wǒ wàngjì le nǐ de shēngrì.
en: Even though I've been busy, I still need to apologize because I forgot your birthday.

zh: 对不起打扰你，我想请问一下怎样才能到达火车站。
pinyin: Duìbúqǐ dǎrǎo nǐ, wǒ xiǎng qǐngwèn yīxià zěnyàng cáinéng dàodá huǒchēzhàn.
en: Sorry to bother you, but could you tell me how to get to the train station?

zh: 对不起，我之前的态度不好，希望你能理解我当时的处境。
pinyin: Duìbúqǐ, wǒ zhīqián de tàidu búhǎo, xīwàng nǐ néng lǐjiě wǒ dāngshí de chǔjìng.
en: I apologize—my attitude before wasn't good, and I hope you can understand the situation I was in at the time.

zh: 我问妈妈今天吃什么。
pinyin: Wǒ wèn māma jīntiān chī shénme.
en: I ask my mom what we're eating today.

zh: 昨天老师问了我一个很难的问题。
pinyin: Zuótiān lǎoshī wènle wǒ yī ge hěn nán de wèntí.
en: Yesterday the teacher asked me a really difficult question.

zh: 因为我不知道怎么去那儿，所以我问了朋友。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ búzhīdào zěnme qù nàr, suǒyǐ wǒ wènle péngyou.
en: Because I didn't know how to get there, I asked my friend.

zh: 在面试的时候，经理问我为什么想要这份工作。
pinyin: Zài miànshì de shíhou, jīnglǐ wèn wǒ wèishéme xiǎngyào zhè fen gōngzuò.
en: During the interview, the manager asked me why I wanted this job.

zh: 我问了好几个专家，但他们对这个问题的看法都不一样。
pinyin: Wǒ wènle hǎo jǐ ge zhuānjiā, dàn tāmen duì zhège wèntí de kànfǎ dōu búyīyàng.
en: I consulted several experts, but they all had different views on this issue.

zh: 我要离开了。
pinyin: Wǒ yào líkāi le.
en: I'm leaving now.

zh: 他明天早上离开这个城市。
pinyin: Tā míngtiān zǎoshang líkāi zhège chéngshì.
en: He's leaving the city tomorrow morning.

zh: 因为工作太忙，他决定离开这个公司。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, tā juéding líkāi zhège gōngsī.
en: Because the job was too demanding, he decided to leave the company.

zh: 虽然她很喜欢这份工作，但还是选择离开去照顾家人。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn xǐhuān zhè fèn gōngzuò, dàn háishi xuǎnzé líkāi qù zhàogu jiārén.
en: Although she really liked the job, she still chose to leave in order to take care of her family.

zh: 他们无法接受现实，最后还是被迫离开了那个地方。
pinyin: Tāmen wúfǎ jiēshòu xiànshí, zuìhòu háishi bèipò líkāi le nàge dìfang.
en: Unable to accept reality, they were ultimately forced to leave that place.

zh: 我要一点水。
pinyin: Wǒ yào yīdiǎn shuǐ.
en: I want a little water.

zh: 这个菜有一点辣，但很好吃。
pinyin: Zhège cài yǒu yīdiǎn là, dàn hěn hǎochī.
en: This dish is a bit spicy, but it tastes really good.

zh: 因为昨天下雨，今天天气一点也不热。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zuótiān xiàyǔ, jīntiān tiānqì yīdiǎn yě búrè.
en: Because it rained yesterday, it's not hot at all today.

zh: 虽然他只学了一点中文，但能和我们简单交流。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐ xuéle yīdiǎn zhōngwén, dàn néng hé wǒmen jiǎndān jiāoliú.
en: Although he's only learned a bit of Chinese, he can have basic conversations with us.

zh: 这份工作压力大，但薪水一点都不理想，让我有点后悔。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò yālì dà, dàn xīnshuǐ yīdiǎn dōu búlǐxiǎng, ràng wǒ yǒudiǎn hòuhuǐ.
en: This job is stressful, and the salary isn't appealing at all, which makes me regret it a bit.

zh: 他一定喜欢吃苹果。
pinyin: Tā yīdìng xǐhuān chī píngguǒ.
en: He definitely likes eating apples.

zh: 明天你一定要来我家。
pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ yīdìng yào lái wǒ jiā.
en: You absolutely must come to my place tomorrow.

zh: 因为他很聪明，所以一定能考好。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn cōngming, suǒyǐ yīdìng néng kǎo hǎo.
en: Because he's very smart, he's sure to do well on the exam.

zh: 虽然这件事很困难，但我一定会想办法解决。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiàn shì hěn kùnnan, dàn wǒ yīdìng huì xiǎng bànfǎ jiějué.
en: Although this matter is quite difficult, I'm definitely going to find a way to solve it.

zh: 如果你现在不努力学习，将来一定会后悔的。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiànzài bù nǔlì xuéxí, jiānglái yīdìng huì hòuhuǐ de.
en: If you don't study hard now, you'll definitely regret it in the future.

zh: 我起床了。
pinyin: Wǒ qǐchuáng le.
en: I got up.

zh: 每天早上我六点起床。
pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang wǒ liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
en: I get up at six o'clock every morning.

zh: 因为今天很冷，所以我不想起床。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān hěn lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ búxiǎng qǐchuáng.
en: Because it's very cold today, I don't want to get out of bed.

zh: 自从搬到新公寓后，我早上起得比以前早多了。
pinyin: Zìcóng bāndào xīn gōngyù hòu, wǒ zǎoshang qǐ de bǐ yǐqián zǎo duō le.
en: Since moving to the new apartment, I've been waking up much earlier in the morning than before.

zh: 他最近工作压力大，经常早上五点多就起来处理邮件。
pinyin: Tā zuìjìn gōngzuò yālì dà, jīngcháng zǎoshang wǔ diǎn duō jiù qǐlái chǔlǐ yóujiàn.
en: He's been under a lot of work stress lately, and often gets up before five in the morning to deal with emails.

zh: 你还是喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Nǐ háishi xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: You still like to eat rice.

zh: 明天还是下雨的时候见面吧。
pinyin: Míngtiān háishi xiàyǔ de shíhou jiànmiàn ba.
en: Let's meet tomorrow even if it's raining.

zh: 虽然很累，但他还是坚持去上班了。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn tā háishi jiānchí qù shàngbān le.
en: Although he was very tired, he still insisted on going to work.

zh: 我们试过很多办法，最后还是决定找专业人士帮忙。
pinyin: Wǒmen shìguò hěnduō bànfǎ, zuìhòu háishi juédìng zhǎo zhuānyè rénshì bāngmang.
en: We tried many approaches, but ultimately decided to ask a professional for help.

zh: 尽管新技术层出不穷，传统手艺在某些领域还是有它独特的价值。
pinyin: Jìnguǎn xīn jìshù céngchūbú穷, chuántǒng shǒuyì zài mǒuxiē lǐngyù háishi yǒu tā dúchū de jiàzhí.
en: Despite the constant emergence of new technology, traditional craftsmanship still has its unique value in certain fields.

zh: 我发现一只猫。
pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn yī zhī māo.
en: I found a cat.

zh: 昨天我发现了一个新公园。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ fāxiànle yī ge xīn gōngyuán.
en: Yesterday I discovered a new park.

zh: 虽然很早，但我发现街上已经有很多人了。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn zǎo, dàn wǒ fāxiàn jiēshang yǐjīng yǒu hěnduō rén le.
en: Even though it was early, I noticed there were already lots of people on the street.

zh: 研究员发现了这种病毒的新变种，因此提高了警惕。
pinyin: Yánjiūyuán fāxiànle zhè zhǒng bìngdú de xīn biànzhǒng, yīnci tígāole jǐngtì.
en: Researchers discovered a new variant of this virus, so they raised their guard.

zh: 通过长期观察，科学家发现了许多人忽视的细节问题。
pinyin: Tōngguò chángqī guānchá, kēxuéjiā fāxiànle xǔduō rén húshì de xìjié wèntí.
en: Through sustained observation, scientists uncovered many detailed problems that people had overlooked.

zh: 这是我所有的钱。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ suǒyǒu de qián.
en: This is all the money I have.

zh: 他去了所有的商店买衣服。
pinyin: Tā qùle suǒyǒu de shāngdiàn mǎi yīfu.
en: He visited all the shops to buy clothes.

zh: 虽然这家餐厅很贵，但所有的菜都很好吃。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā cāntīng hěn guì, dàn suǒyǒu de cài dōu hěn hǎochī.
en: Although this restaurant is expensive, all the dishes taste really good.

zh: 你所说的问题其实很多学生都遇到过。
pinyin: Nǐ suǒ shuōde wèntí qíshí hěnduō xuésheng dōu yùdàoguò.
en: The issues you mentioned are actually ones that many students have encountered before.

zh: 他采纳了所有同事的建议，最后项目才得以顺利完成。
pinyin: Tā cǎinà le suǒyǒu tóngshì de jiànyì, zuìhòu xiàngmù cái déyǐ shùnlì wánchéng.
en: He took on board all his colleagues' suggestions, and that's ultimately how the project was completed smoothly.

zh: 我住在北京。
pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài Běijīng.
en: I live in Beijing.

zh: 我的朋友住在一个大房子里。
pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou zhù zài yī ge dà fángzi lǐ.
en: My friend lives in a big house.

zh: 因为工作的原因，他们住在城市里，但是周末喜欢住在乡村。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò de yuányīn, tāmen zhù zài chéngshì lǐ, dànshì zhōumò xǐhuān zhù zài xiāngcūn.
en: Because of work, they live in the city, but they like to stay in the countryside on weekends.

zh: 虽然租金很贵，但是这个地方交通方便，所以很多人都选择住在这里。
pinyin: Suīrán zūjīn hěn guì, dànshì zhège dìfang jiāotōng fāngbiàn, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén dōu xuǎnzé zhù zài zhèlǐ.
en: Although the rent is expensive, the transportation here is convenient, so many people choose to live here.

zh: 他在同一个城市住了十年以上，对周边的环境和人文风俗早已了如指掌。
pinyin: Tā zài tóngyī ge chéngshì zhù le shí nián yǐshàng, duì zhōubiān de huánjìng hé rénwén fēngsú zǎo yǐ liǎoruòzhǐzhǎng.
en: He's lived in the same city for over ten years and knows the surrounding environment and local customs inside out.

zh: 我买了两件衣服。
pinyin: Wǒ mǎile liǎng jiàn yīfu.
en: I bought two pieces of clothing.

zh: 昨天发生了一件有趣的事情。
pinyin: Zuótiān fāshēngle yī jiàn yǒuqù de shìqing.
en: Something interesting happened yesterday.

zh: 虽然这件事很难，但是我会尽力去做。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiàn shì hěn nán, dànshì wǒ huì jìnlì qù zuò.
en: Even though this matter is difficult, I'll do my best to handle it.

zh: 警察正在调查这件案件的具体情况。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zhèngzài diàochá zhè jiàn ànjian de jùtǐ qíngkuàng.
en: The police are investigating the specific details of this case.

zh: 这件事让我意识到团队合作的重要性。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ yìshi dào tuánduì hézuò de zhòngyàoxìng.
en: This incident made me realize how important teamwork really is.

zh: 现在正下雨。
pinyin: xiànzài zhèng xiàyǔ。
en: It's raining right now.

zh: 他正在吃早饭，不能来。
pinyin: tā zhèngzài chī zǎofàn, búnéng lái。
en: He's eating breakfast and can't come.

zh: 因为他正在忙工作，所以今天不能见面。
pinyin: yīnwèi tā zhèngzài máng gōngzuò, suǒyǐ jīntiān búnéng jiànmiàn。
en: Because he's busy with work right now, we can't meet today.

zh: 虽然他正在处理很多事情，但是他还是决定帮助我们。
pinyin: suīrán tā zhèngzài chǔlǐ hěnduō shìqing, dànshì tā háishi juéding bāngzhù wǒmen。
en: Although he's dealing with a lot right now, he still decided to help us.

zh: 正当他打算放弃时，意外的机会出现了，改变了他的整个人生。
pinyin: zhèngdāng tā dǎsuàn fàngqì shí, yìwài de jīhuì chūxiàn le, gǎibiàn le tā de zhěngge rénshēng。
en: Just when he was about to give up, an unexpected opportunity appeared and changed his entire life.

zh: 我喜欢苹果，而且很甜。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ, érqiě hěn tián.
en: I like apples, and they're very sweet.

zh: 今天天气很好，而且不太热。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, érqiě bújiàn tài rè.
en: The weather is nice today, and it's not too hot.

zh: 因为他很聪明，而且学习的时候很认真。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn cōngming, érqiě xuéxí de shíhou hěn rènzhēn.
en: Because he's smart and studies very seriously, he does well in school.

zh: 这个工作不仅薪水不错，而且离家也比较近。
pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò bújǐn xīnshuǐ búcuò, érqiě líjiā yě bǐjiào jìn.
en: This job not only pays decently, but it's also pretty close to home.

zh: 他的建议很有建设性，而且考虑得特别周到。
pinyin: Tā de jiànyì hěn yǒu jiànshè xìng, érqiě kǎolǜ de tèbié zhōudào.
en: His suggestions are really constructive, and he's thought things through very carefully.

zh: 我喜欢苹果并喜欢香蕉。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ bìng xǐhuān xiāngjiāo.
en: I like apples and bananas.

zh: 他每天早上跑步并喝牛奶。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang pǎobù bìng hē niúnǎi.
en: He runs and drinks milk every morning.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但是我们并没有取消计划。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshi wǒmen bìng méiyǒu qǔxiāo jìhuà.
en: Although the weather was cold, we didn't cancel our plans.

zh: 这个项目不仅成本低，而且执行速度也很快并得到了客户认可。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù bújǐn chéngběn dī, érqiě zhíxíng sùdù yě hěn kuài bìng dé到le kèhù rènkě.
en: This project is not only low-cost but also executes quickly and has won client approval.

zh: 他在公司工作十年，业绩显著并多次获得年度最佳员工的荣誉。
pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī gōngzuò shí nián, yèjī xiǎnzhù bìng duō cì huòdé niándù zuìjiā yuángōng de róngyù.
en: He's worked at the company for ten years, with outstanding performance and multiple recognitions as Employee of the Year.

zh: 你必须吃饭。
pinyin: Nǐ bìxū chīfàn.
en: You have to eat.

zh: 明天我必须去学校上课。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ bìxū qù xuéxiào shànngkè.
en: Tomorrow I have to go to school for class.

zh: 因为今天下雨,所以我们必须待在家里。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen bìxū dāi zài jiālǐ.
en: Because it's raining today, we have to stay at home.

zh: 如果想成功,你必须花更多时间练习。
pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng chénggōng, nǐ bìxū huā gèngduō shíjiān liànxí.
en: If you want to succeed, you have to spend more time practicing.

zh: 虽然工作很忙,但是我们必须保持身体健康。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì wǒmen bìxū bǎochí shēntǐ jiànkāng.
en: Even though work is hectic, we really have to maintain our physical health.

zh: 这是什么意思？
pinyin: Zhè shì shénme yìsi?
en: What does this mean?

zh: 他说的意思是明天不来了。
pinyin: Tā shuō de yìsi shì míngtiān búlái le.
en: What he's saying is that he won't come tomorrow.

zh: 虽然她没有说话，但是她的意思很清楚。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méiyǒu shuōhuà, dànshì tā de yìsi hěn qīngchu.
en: Even though she didn't speak, her meaning was very clear.

zh: 你好像理解错了我的意思，我不是那个意思。
pinyin: Nǐ hǎoxiàng lǐjiě cuò le wǒ de yìsi, wǒ búshì nàge yìsi.
en: It seems you misunderstood what I meant—that's not what I was trying to say.

zh: 与其猜测他的真实意思，不如直接问他比较好。
pinyin: Yǔqī cāicè tā de zhēnshí yìsi, búrú zhíjiē wèn tā bǐjiào hǎo.
en: Rather than guessing what he really means, it's better to just ask him directly.

zh: 我放书在桌子上。
pinyin: Wǒ fàng shū zài zhuōzi shang.
en: I put the book on the table.

zh: 妈妈放了一些米饭在碗里。
pinyin: Māma fàngle yīxiē mǐfàn zài wǎn lǐ.
en: Mom put some rice in the bowl.

zh: 因为天气很热，我们放弃了户外运动。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, wǒmen fàngqìle hùwài yùndòng.
en: Because the weather was so hot, we gave up the outdoor activity.

zh: 虽然老板放松了工作要求，但大家还是很忙。
pinyin: Suīrán lǎobǎn fàngsōngle gōngzuò yāoqiú, dàn dàjiā háishi hěn máng.
en: Although the boss relaxed the work requirements, everyone is still very busy.

zh: 他不得不放弃这个机会，尽管这对他的前景影响很大。
pinyin: Tā búdé búfàng fàngqìle zhège jīhuì, jìnguǎn zhè duì tā de qiánjǐng yǐngxiǎng hěn dà.
en: He had no choice but to give up this opportunity, even though it significantly impacts his future prospects.

zh: 这个苹果不错。
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ búcuò.
en: This apple is pretty good.

zh: 今天天气不错，我们去公园吧。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, wǒmen qù gōngyuán ba.
en: The weather's nice today, so let's go to the park.

zh: 虽然这家餐厅很小，但是菜的味道不错。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā cāntīng hěn xiǎo, búshì cài de wèidào búcuò.
en: Even though this restaurant is small, the food tastes really good.

zh: 他的工作虽然不轻松，但薪水不错，所以他很满意。
pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò suīrán búqīngsōng, búshì xīnshuǐ búcuò, suǒyǐ tā hěn mǎnyì.
en: His job is demanding, but the salary is decent, so he's pretty satisfied with it.

zh: 这部电影虽然不是大制作，但编剧和演员的表现都不错，值得一看。
pinyin: Zhè búfèn diànyǐng suīrán búshì dà zhìzuòpǐn, búshì biānjù hé yǎnyuán de biǎoxiàn dōu búcuò, zhíde yī kàn.
en: Although it's not a big-budget film, both the screenplay and performances are solid—it's worth watching.

zh: 这是肯定好吃的。
pinyin: Zhè shì kěndìng hǎochī de.
en: This is definitely delicious.

zh: 明天肯定会下雨吗？不，肯定不会。
pinyin: Míngtiān kěndìng huì xiàyǔ ma? Búguò, kěndìng búhuì.
en: Will it definitely rain tomorrow? No, it definitely won't.

zh: 因为他很聪明，所以肯定能做好这件事。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn cōngming, suǒyǐ kěndìng néng zuòhǎo zhè jiàn shì.
en: Because he's so smart, he'll definitely be able to do this job well.

zh: 虽然条件很困难，但我们肯定会想办法解决这个问题。
pinyin: Suīrán tiáojiàn hěn kùnnan, dàn wǒmen kěndìng huì xiǎng bànfǎ jiějué zhège wèntí.
en: Although conditions are tough, we'll definitely find a way to solve this problem.

zh: 根据现在的情况来看，他肯定是在为下个月的考试做充分准备。
pinyin: Gēnjù xiànzài de qíngkuàng lái kàn, tā kěndìng shì zài wèi xiàge yuè de kǎoshì zuò chōngfèn zhǔnbèi.
en: Based on the current situation, he's clearly preparing thoroughly for next month's exam.

zh: 这是我的电话。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de diànhuà.
en: This is my phone.

zh: 妈妈每天用电话和朋友说话。
pinyin: Māma měitiān yòng diànhuà hé péngyou shuōhuà.
en: Mom talks to her friends on the phone every day.

zh: 因为我的电话坏了，所以我不能给你打电话。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ de diànhuà huài le, suǒyǐ wǒ búnéng gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
en: Because my phone is broken, I can't call you.

zh: 他在开会的时候接到了一个重要的电话。
pinyin: Tā zài kāihuì de shíhou jiēdào le yī ge zhòngyào de diànhuà.
en: He received an important phone call while he was in a meeting.

zh: 与其发短信，不如直接打电话沟通效率更高。
pinyin: Yǔqī fā duǎnxìn, búrú zhíjiē dǎ diànhuà gōutōng xiàolǜ gèng gāo.
en: Rather than texting, calling directly is much more efficient for communication.

zh: 我为了吃饭去家里。
pinyin: Wǒ wèile chīfàn qù jiālǐ.
en: I went home to eat.

zh: 她每天为了学习很早起床。
pinyin: Tā měitiān wèile xuéxí hěn zǎo qǐchuáng.
en: She gets up very early every day in order to study.

zh: 虽然很累，但他为了工作还是坚持了下来。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn tā wèile gōngzuò háishi jiānchí le xiàlái.
en: Even though he was exhausted, he kept going for the sake of his work.

zh: 为了能更好地理解这个问题，我查了很多资料。
pinyin: Wèile néng gèng hǎo de lǐjiě zhège wèntí, wǒ chá le hěnduō zīliào.
en: To better understand this problem, I looked up a lot of information.

zh: 为了确保项目按时完成，团队成员们放弃了周末休息。
pinyin: Wèile quèbǎo xiàngmù ànshí wánchéng, tuánduì chéngyuán men fàngqì le zhōumò xiūxi.
en: To ensure the project was completed on time, the team members gave up their weekend rest.

zh: 我在搞饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zài搞fàn.
en: I'm making dinner.

zh: 他每天都搞卫生，房间很干净。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu搞wèishēng, fángjiān hěn gānnjìng.
en: He cleans every day, so the room is very tidy.

zh: 因为搞不懂这个问题，所以我问了老师。
pinyin: Yīnwèi搞bu dǒng zhège wèntí, suǒyǐ wǒ wènle lǎoshī.
en: Because I couldn't understand the problem, I asked the teacher.

zh: 他搞了一个新项目，虽然有难度，但进展得还不错。
pinyin: Tā搞le yīge xīn xiàngmù, suīrán yǒu náandù, dàn jìnzhǎn de háibucuò.
en: He's working on a new project; although it's challenging, it's progressing well.

zh: 公司最近搞了个改革，想提高工作效率，结果有人支持有人反对。
pinyin: Gōngsī zuìjìn搞le ge gǎigé, xiǎng tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ, jiéguǒ yǒurén zhīchí yǒurén fǎnduì.
en: The company recently launched a reform to boost work efficiency, but people are split on it.

zh: 这个棒球很棒。
pinyin: Zhège bàngqiú hěn bàng.
en: This baseball is great.

zh: 昨天的比赛很棒，我们赢了。
pinyin: Zuótiān de bǐsài hěn bàng, wǒmen yíng le.
en: Yesterday's game was awesome—we won.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但是他的表现还是很棒。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, búshì tā de biǎoxiàn háishi hěn bàng.
en: Even though the weather was bad, his performance was still excellent.

zh: 因为你这次的工作做得特别棒，所以老板决定给你加薪。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐ zhè cì de gōngzuò zuò de tèbié bàng, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn juéding gěi nǐ jiāxīn.
en: Because you did such an outstanding job this time, the boss decided to give you a raise.

zh: 这位教练虽然年纪大，但执教能力棒得不行，几乎每个学生在他手下都成了高手。
pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoliàn suīrán niánjì dà, búshì zhíjiào néngglì bàng de búxíng, jīhū měi ge xuésheng zài tā shǒuxià dōu chéng le gāoshǒu.
en: This coach may be getting on in years, but his coaching ability is outstanding—almost every student under his guidance becomes skilled.

zh: 这是我第一次来。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì lái.
en: This is my first time coming here.

zh: 我第一次吃中国菜的时候很开心。
pinyin: Wǒ dì yī cì chī Zhōngguó cài de shíhou hěn kāixīn.
en: I was really happy the first time I ate Chinese food.

zh: 虽然这是第一次见面，但我们已经是很好的朋友了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè shì dì yī cì jiànmiàn, dàn wǒmen yǐjīng shì hěn hǎo de péngyou le.
en: Even though it's our first time meeting, we're already really good friends.

zh: 他第一次参加公司会议就表现得非常出色。
pinyin: Tā dì yī cì cānjiā gōngsī huìyì jiù biǎoxiàn de fēicháng chūcsè.
en: He performed exceptionally well at the company meeting the very first time he attended.

zh: 我对这份工作的第一印象很好，虽然后来遇到了一些挑战。
pinyin: Wǒ duì zhè fèn gōngzuò de dì yī yìnxiàng hěn hǎo, suīrán hòulái yùdàole yīxiē tiǎozhàn.
en: My first impression of this job was really positive, though I ran into some challenges later on.

zh: 我妈是老师。
pinyin: Wǒ mā shì lǎoshī.
en: My mom is a teacher.

zh: 昨天我妈给我买了新书。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mā gěi wǒ mǎi le xīn shū.
en: Yesterday my mom bought me a new book.

zh: 因为妈妈很忙，所以我自己做早饭。
pinyin: Yīnwèi māma hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒ zìjǐ zuò zǎofàn.
en: Because Mom is very busy, I make my own breakfast.

zh: 我妈虽然工作很累，但她总是关心我的学习。
pinyin: Wǒ mā suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dàn tā zǒngshì guānxin wǒ de xuéxí.
en: Although my mom's work is tiring, she's always concerned about my studies.

zh: 我妈说得没错，有时候坚持比聪明更重要。
pinyin: Wǒ mā shuō de méi cuò, yǒushíhou jiānchí bǐ聪ming gèng zhòngyào.
en: My mom was right—sometimes persistence matters more than being smart.

zh: 我在地上坐。
pinyin: Wǒ zài dìshang zuò.
en: I'm sitting on the ground.

zh: 孩子们高兴地在公园里跑。
pinyin: Háizimen gāoxìng de zài gōngyuán lǐ pǎo.
en: The children are running happily in the park.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以他慢慢地走回家。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ tā mànman de zǒu huíjiā.
en: Because it was raining, he walked home slowly.

zh: 虽然工作很累，但她还是认真地完成了任务。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì tā háishi rènzhēn de wánchéng le rènwù.
en: Although the work was tiring, she still completed the task seriously.

zh: 他总是想当然地处理问题，结果往往事与愿违。
pinyin: Tā zǒngshi xiǎng dāngrán de chǔlǐ wèntí, jiéguǒ wǎngwǎng shì yǔ yuàn wéi.
en: He always deals with problems too casually, and things often turn out contrary to his wishes.

zh: 我进教室了。
pinyin: Wǒ jìn jiàoshì le.
en: I went into the classroom.

zh: 昨天我们进了一家新餐厅吃饭。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen jìnle yī jiā xīn cāntīng chīfàn.
en: Yesterday we went into a new restaurant to eat.

zh: 因为天气不好，我们没有进公园散步。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, wǒmen méiyǒu jìn gōngyuán sǎnbù.
en: Because the weather was bad, we didn't go into the park for a walk.

zh: 虽然公司进展很快，但是员工的压力也在不断增加。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngsī jìnzhǎn hěn kuài, búshì yuángōng de yālì yě zài búduàn zēngjiā.
en: Although the company is making rapid progress, employees' stress is also constantly increasing.

zh: 为了进一步改善客户体验，我们决定引进更先进的技术系统。
pinyin: Wèile jìnyībù gǎishàn kèhù tǐyàn, wǒmen juédìng yǐnjìn gèng xiāngjìn de jìshù xìtǒng.
en: To further improve customer experience, we decided to introduce more advanced technological systems.

zh: 我不想那样做。
pinyin: Wǒ búxiǎng nàyàng zuò.
en: I don't want to do it that way.

zh: 昨天他那样说话，我很生气。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā nàyàng shuōhuà, wǒ hěn shēngqì.
en: When he talked like that yesterday, I got really upset.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但是他还是那样坚持去了。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dànshì tā háishi nàyàng jiānchíle qùle.
en: Even though the weather was bad, he still insisted on going anyway.

zh: 如果你一直那样对待他，他肯定会离开的。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yìzhí nàyàng duìdài tā, tā kěndìng huì líkāi de.
en: If you keep treating him like that, he'll definitely leave.

zh: 与其那样被动等待，倒不如主动出击寻求机会。
pinyin: Yǔqī nàyàng bèidòng děngdài, dàoburú zhǔdòng chūjī xúnqiú jīhuì.
en: Rather than passively waiting around like that, you might as well take the initiative and go after opportunities.

zh: 大家好！
pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo!
en: Hello, everyone!

zh: 今天大家都来我家吃饭。
pinyin: Jīntiān dàjiā dōu lái wǒ jiā chīfàn.
en: Everyone is coming to my place for dinner today.

zh: 因为天气很好，所以大家都想去公园玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu xiǎng qù gōngyuán wán.
en: Because the weather is nice, everyone wants to go play in the park.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但大家还是按时完成了这个项目。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn dàjiā háishi ànshí wánchéng le zhège xiàngmù.
en: Although the work was busy, everyone still managed to finish the project on time.

zh: 经理在会议上强调，只有大家齐心协力，才能应对这次市场挑战。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ zài huìyì shang qiángdiào, zhǐyǒu dàjiā qīxīn xiéLì, cáinéng yìngduì zhè cì shìchǎng tiǎozhàn.
en: The manager emphasized in the meeting that only if everyone works together can we meet this market challenge.

zh: 这是新书。
pinyin: Zhè shì xīn shū.
en: This is a new book.

zh: 我昨天买了一件新衣服。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān mǎile yī jiàn xīn yīfu.
en: I bought a new piece of clothing yesterday.

zh: 虽然这个手机很贵，但是它是最新的型号。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège shǒujī hěn guì, dànshì tā shì zuì xīn de xínghaò.
en: Even though this phone is expensive, it's the newest model.

zh: 因为搬到了新公司，她的工作环境改善了很多。
pinyin: Yīnwèi bānle xīn gōngsī, tā de gōngzuò huánjìng gǎishàn le hěnduō.
en: Because she moved to the new company, her work environment improved a lot.

zh: 与其不断抱怨旧工作，不如主动去适应新的挑战。
pinyin: Yǔqī búduàn bàoyuàn jiù gōngzuò, búrú zhǔdòng qù shìyìng xīn de tiǎozhàn.
en: Rather than constantly complaining about the old job, it's better to actively adapt to new challenges.

zh: 您好！
pinyin: Nín hǎo!
en: Hello!

zh: 您今天吃饭了吗？
pinyin: Nín jīntiān chīfàn le ma?
en: Have you eaten today?

zh: 因为您很忙，所以我明天再来找您。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nín hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒ míngtiān zài lái zhǎo nín.
en: Since you're very busy, I'll come find you again tomorrow.

zh: 您如果有时间，能帮我看看这份文件吗？
pinyin: Nín rúguǒ yǒu shíjiān, néng bāngwǒ kànkan zhè fèn wénjiàn ma?
en: If you have time, could you take a look at this document for me?

zh: 您的建议非常有道理，我们应该认真考虑一下。
pinyin: Nín de jiànyì fēicháng yǒu dàoli, wǒmen yīnggāi rènzhēn kǎolǜ yīxià.
en: Your suggestion makes a lot of sense; we should give it serious thought.

zh: 我向妈妈要糖。
pinyin: Wǒ xiàng māma yào táng.
en: I'm asking my mom for candy.

zh: 昨天我向老师问了一个问题。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ xiàng lǎoshī wènle yīge wèntí.
en: Yesterday I asked my teacher a question.

zh: 因为他不懂，所以向我请教怎么做。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā búdǒng, suǒyǐ xiàng wǒ qǐngjiào zěnme zuò.
en: Because he didn't understand, he asked me for advice on how to do it.

zh: 员工们向经理提出了改进工作效率的建议。
pinyin: Yuángōngmen xiàng jīnglǐ tíchūle gǎijìn gōngzuò xiàolǜ de jiànyì.
en: The employees made suggestions to the manager about improving work efficiency.

zh: 随着社会发展，越来越多的人向政府部门建议制定更完善的政策。
pinyin: Suízhe shèhuì fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de rén xiàng zhèngfǔ bùmén jiànyì zhìdìng gèng wánshàn de zhèngcè.
en: As society develops, more and more people are proposing to government departments that they establish more comprehensive policies.

zh: 我吃一些米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ chī yīxiē mǐfàn.
en: I'm eating some rice.

zh: 妈妈买了一些苹果和香蕉。
pinyin: Māma mǎile yīxiē píngguǒ hé xiāngjiāo.
en: Mom bought some apples and bananas.

zh: 因为明天要考试，我复习了一些语法。
pinyin: Yīnwèi míngtiān yào kǎoshì, wǒ fùxíle yīxiē yǔfǎ.
en: Because there's an exam tomorrow, I reviewed some grammar.

zh: 他虽然很忙，但还是抽出时间帮我解决一些问题。
pinyin: Tā suīrán hěn máng, dàn háishi chōuchūlái shíjiān bāng wǒ jiějué yīxiē wèntí.
en: Even though he's very busy, he still made time to help me solve some problems.

zh: 最近工作压力大，我决定周末约朋友出去散心，放松一些。
pinyin: Zuìjìn gōngzuò yālì dà, wǒ juéding zhōumò yuē péngyou chūqù sǎnxin, fàngsōng yīxiē.
en: Work's been stressful lately, so I decided to meet up with friends this weekend to get out and relax a bit.

zh: 我有三个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu sān ge píngguǒ.
en: I have three apples.

zh: 她每周去三次健身房。
pinyin: Tā měi zhōu qù sān cì jiànshēnfáng.
en: She goes to the gym three times a week.

zh: 虽然只有三个小时，但是我们完成了所有工作。
pinyin: Suīrán zhǐyǒu sān ge xiǎoshíshi, dànshì wǒmen wánchéngle suǒyǒu gōngzuò.
en: Although we only had three hours, we managed to finish all the work.

zh: 这个项目需要三个月才能完成，因为流程比较复杂。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào sān ge yuè cáinéng wánchéng, yīnwèi liúchéng bǐjiào fùzá.
en: This project will take three months to complete because the process is quite complex.

zh: 他在公司工作了三年多，现在已经成为部门的骨干力量。
pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī gōngzuòle sān nián duō, xiànzài yǐjīng chéngwéi bùmén de gǔgānliàliàng.
en: He's been working at the company for over three years and has become a key person in the department.

zh: 我的书在那里。
pinyin: Wǒ de shū zài nàlǐ.
en: My book is over there.

zh: 昨天我在那里吃了好吃的饭。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài nàlǐ chīle hǎochī de fàn.
en: Yesterday I ate delicious food at that place.

zh: 虽然那里很远，但是我们经常去那里。
pinyin: Suīrán nàlǐ hěn yuǎn, dànshì wǒmen jīngcháng qù nàlǐ.
en: Even though it's far away, we go there often.

zh: 因为那里的环境很好，所以很多人喜欢在那里工作。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nàlǐ de huánjìng hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén xǐhuān zài nàlǐ gōngzuò.
en: Because the environment there is nice, lots of people like working there.

zh: 他搬到那里以后，生活质量确实提高了不少。
pinyin: Tā bānhuà dào nàlǐ yǐhòu, shēnghuó zhìliàng quèshí tígāole búshǎo.
en: After he moved there, his quality of life actually improved quite a bit.

zh: 我以为你在家。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi nǐ zài jiā.
en: I thought you were at home.

zh: 昨天我以为他不来了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ yǐwéi tā búlái le.
en: Yesterday I thought he wasn't coming.

zh: 虽然他没说话，但我以为他同意了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā méi shuōhuà, dàn wǒ yǐwéi tā tóngyì le.
en: Even though he didn't say anything, I thought he agreed.

zh: 我以为这个工作很容易，结果比想象难多了。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi zhège gōngzuò hěn róngyì, jiéguǒ bǐ xiǎngxiàng nán duō le.
en: I assumed this job would be easy, but it turned out to be much harder than expected.

zh: 很多人以为成功就是赚钱，其实那只是其中一个方面。
pinyin: Hěnduō rén yǐwéi chénggōng jiùshì zuànqián, qīshí nà zhǐshì qīzhōng yī ge fāngmiàn.
en: Many people think success is just about making money, but that's really only one aspect of it.

zh: 我很高兴。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
en: I'm very happy.

zh: 今天天气好，我很高兴。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hǎo, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
en: The weather is nice today, so I'm really happy.

zh: 因为你来了，所以我很高兴。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐ lái le, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
en: Because you came, I'm very happy.

zh: 虽然工作很累，但是看到孩子高兴的样子，我就开心了。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì kàndào háizi gāoxìng de yàngzi, wǒ jiù kāixīn le.
en: Although work is exhausting, when I see how happy the kids are, it makes me feel cheerful.

zh: 他们听到这个好消息以后，高兴得不知道说什么才好。
pinyin: Tāmen tīngdào zhège hǎo xiāoxī yǐhòu, gāoxìng de búzhīdào shuō shénme cái hǎo.
en: After hearing the good news, they were so delighted they didn't know what to say.

zh: 这是水嘛。
pinyin: Zhè shì shuǐ ma.
en: This is water, right?

zh: 你今天不来上班嘛？
pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān búlái shàngbān ma?
en: You're not coming to work today, are you?

zh: 因为下雨，所以我们不能去公园嘛。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen búnéng qù gōngyuán ma.
en: Since it's raining, we can't go to the park, obviously.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但是周末还是要休息嘛。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì zhōumò háishi yào xiūxi ma.
en: Work is busy, sure, but you still need to rest on weekends, don't you?

zh: 这种事情谁都会遇到，关键是怎么处理嘛。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shìqing shéi dōu huì yùdào, guānjiàn shì zěnme chǔlǐ ma.
en: Everyone runs into situations like this—what matters is how you handle it, right?

zh: 我的老师很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de lǎoshī hěn hǎo.
en: My teacher is really nice.

zh: 老王每天都喝咖啡。
pinyin: Lǎo Wáng měi tiān dōu hē kāfēi.
en: Old Wang drinks coffee every single day.

zh: 虽然这个手机很老,但是它还能用。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège shǒujī hěn lǎo, dànshì tā háinnéng yòng.
en: Even though this phone is old, it still works fine.

zh: 他老是忘记带钥匙,所以经常被锁在门外。
pinyin: Tā lǎoshì wàngjì dài yàoshi, suǒyǐ jīngcháng bèi suǒ zài mén wài.
en: He's always forgetting his keys, so he gets locked out pretty often.

zh: 这家餐厅虽然看起来很老旧,但老板做的菜味道一绝。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng suīrán kàn qǐlái hěn lǎojiù, dàn lǎobǎn zuò de cài wèidào yī jué.
en: This restaurant looks run-down, but the owner's cooking is absolutely outstanding.

zh: 这位老师很好。
pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī hěn hǎo.
en: This teacher is very nice.

zh: 那位医生今天在医院工作。
pinyin: Nà wèi yīshēng jīntiān zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
en: That doctor is working at the hospital today.

zh: 虽然这位顾客很挑剔,但是服务员还是很耐心。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè wèi gùkè hěn tiāotī, dànshì fúwùyuán háishi hěn nàixīn.
en: Although this customer is quite picky, the server remains patient.

zh: 如果你想了解这位专家的观点,可以读他最近发表的文章。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng liǎojiě zhè wèi zhuānjiā de guāndiǎn, kěyǐ dú tā zuìjìn fābiǎo de wénzhāng.
en: If you want to understand this expert's perspective, you can read the article he published recently.

zh: 这位经理提出的方案虽然创新,但实施起来需要克服不少困难。
pinyin: Zhè wèi jīnglǐ tíchū de fāng'àn suīrán chuàngxīn, dàn shíshī qǐlai xūyào kèfúguò búshǎo kùnnan.
en: Although the proposal put forward by this manager is innovative, implementing it will require overcoming considerable challenges.

zh: 妈妈，你过来。
pinyin: Māma, nǐ guòlái.
en: Mom, come over here.

zh: 请你过来帮我一下。
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ guòlái bāng wǒ yīxià.
en: Could you come help me for a moment?

zh: 虽然很远，但他还是走过来了。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn yuǎn, dànshì tā háishi zǒu guòlái le.
en: Even though it was far, he still managed to walk over.

zh: 他听到声音以后就跑过来，看看发生了什么。
pinyin: Tā tīngdào shēngyīn yǐhòu jiù pǎo guòlái, kànkan fāshēng le shénme.
en: He heard the noise and ran over to see what had happened.

zh: 这个问题我一开始想不明白，后来通过讨论才想过来。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí wǒ yī kāishǐ xiǎng bu míngbai, hòuláir tōngguò tǎolùn cái xiǎng guòlái.
en: I couldn't figure out this problem at first, but after discussing it with others, I finally got it.

zh: 我掉了一个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ diào le yī ge píngguǒ.
en: I dropped an apple.

zh: 昨天我在公园掉了钥匙。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài gōngyuán diào le yàoshì.
en: I lost my keys in the park yesterday.

zh: 虽然他很小心，但还是掉了手机。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn xiǎoxin, dàn háishi diào le shǒujī.
en: Although he was careful, he still dropped his phone.

zh: 因为下雨天路滑，他一不小心掉进了水里。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ tiān lù huá, tā yī búxiǎoxin diào jìnle shuǐ lǐ.
en: Because the road was slippery in the rain, he accidentally fell into the water.

zh: 长时间使用手机会掉电很快，这是个挺烦人的问题。
pinyin: Cháng shíjiān shǐyòng shǒujī huì diào diàn hěn kuài, zhè shi ge tǐng fánrén de wèntí.
en: Using your phone for long periods drains the battery really quickly—it's pretty annoying.

zh: 先吃饭再玩。
pinyin: Xiān chīfàn zài wán.
en: Eat first, then play.

zh: 我先喝咖啡，然后上班。
pinyin: Wǒ xiān hē kāfēi, ránhòu shàngbān.
en: I have coffee first, then go to work.

zh: 虽然很累，但我先做完功课再睡觉。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn wǒ xiān zuòwán gōngkè zài shuìjiào.
en: Even though I'm tired, I finish my homework before sleeping.

zh: 你先告诉我意见，我们再一起讨论这个计划。
pinyin: Nǐ xiān gàosu wǒ yìjiàn, wǒmen zài yìqǐ tǎolùn zhège jìhuà.
en: Tell me your thoughts first, and then we can discuss the plan together.

zh: 我们先了解市场需求，再决定生产什么产品比较合理。
pinyin: Wǒmen xiān liǎojiě shìchǎng xūqiú, zài juéding shēngchǎn shénme chǎnpǐn bǐjiào héhéli.
en: We should first understand what the market needs, and then decide what products make sense to produce.

zh: 我喜欢苹果、香蕉等等。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ, xiāngjiāo děngděng.
en: I like apples, bananas, and so on.

zh: 今天要买米、油、盐等等的东西。
pinyin: Jīntiān yào mǎi mǐ, yóu, yán děngděng de dōngxi.
en: Today I need to buy rice, oil, salt, and other things like that.

zh: 因为要出门，所以要准备衣服、鞋子等等的东西。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yào chūmén, suǒyǐ yào zhǔnbèi yīfu, xiézi děngděng de dōngxi.
en: Because we're going out, we need to prepare clothes, shoes, and other things like that.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他还是抽空陪家人、做运动等等。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi chōukòng péi jiārén, zuò yùndòng děngděng.
en: Even though he's very busy with work, he still makes time to spend with family, exercise, and so on.

zh: 学习语言需要掌握语法、发音、文化背景等等多方面的知识。
pinyin: Xuéxí yǔyán xūyào zhǎngwò yǔfǎ, fāyīn, wénhuà bèijǐng děngděng duō fāngmiàn de zhīshi.
en: Learning a language requires mastering many aspects of knowledge, such as grammar, pronunciation, cultural background, and more.

zh: 我的生活很好。
pinyin: Wǒ de shēnghuó hěn hǎo.
en: My life is very good.

zh: 每天的生活很忙,但是很开心。
pinyin: Měitiān de shēnghuó hěn máng, búguò hěn kāixīn.
en: My daily life is busy, but I'm happy.

zh: 因为工作压力大,所以他的生活质量下降了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò yālì dà, suǒyǐ tā de shēnghuó zhìliàng xiàjiàng le.
en: Because of work stress, the quality of his life has declined.

zh: 搬到新城市以后,她逐渐适应了新的生活环境。
pinyin: Bān dào xīn chéngshì yǐhòu, tā zhújiàn shìyìng le xīn de shēnghuó huánjìng.
en: After moving to the new city, she gradually adapted to her new living environment.

zh: 虽然经济条件有限,但他们通过相互支持维持了充实的生活。
pinyin: Suīrán jīngjì tiáojiàn yǒuxiàn, bánshe tāmen tōngguò xiānghù zhīchí wéichíle chōngshí de shēnghuó.
en: Although their financial circumstances are limited, they maintain a fulfilling life through mutual support.

zh: 这是我之前的书。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ zhīqián de shū.
en: This is my book from before.

zh: 他去年之后就没来过。
pinyin: Tā qùnián zhīhòu jiù méi láiguò.
en: He hasn't come since last year.

zh: 因为工作忙，他很少有休息之时。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò máng, tā hěn shǎo yǒu xiūxi zhī shí.
en: Because work is busy, he rarely has time to rest.

zh: 虽然价格不便宜，但这款产品之质量值得信赖。
pinyin: Suīrán jiàgé búbiànyì, dàn zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn zhī zhìliàng zhídé xìnlài.
en: Although it's not cheap, the quality of this product is trustworthy.

zh: 面对这类突发状况，我们应该冷静以对，而非仓促之举。
pinyin: Miànduì zhè lèi túfā zhuàngkuàng, wǒmen yīnggāi lěngjìng yǐ duì, érfēi cāngcù zhī jǔ.
en: When faced with situations like this, we should respond calmly rather than act rashly.

zh: 我买苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ mǎi píngguǒ.
en: I'm buying apples.

zh: 昨天我买了一件新衣服。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mǎile yī jiàn xīn yīfu.
en: I bought a new shirt yesterday.

zh: 因为今天下雨，所以我买了一把伞。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ mǎile yī bǎ sǎn.
en: Because it's raining today, I bought an umbrella.

zh: 虽然这家店的东西比较贵，但我还是决定买。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā diàn de dōngxi bǐjiào guì, dàn wǒ háishi juédìng mǎi.
en: Even though things are pretty expensive at this shop, I still decided to buy from it.

zh: 他想买房子，可是房价太高了，暂时还是买不起。
pinyin: Tā xiǎng mǎi fángzi, kěshì fángjià tài gāole, zànshíhou háishi mǎi bu qǐ.
en: He wants to buy a house, but house prices are too high—he just can't afford it for now.

zh: 我种了一棵树。
pinyin: Wǒ zhòng le yī kē shù.
en: I planted a tree.

zh: 妈妈喜欢种各种花。
pinyin: Māma xǐhuān zhòng gè zhǒng huā.
en: Mom likes to grow all kinds of flowers.

zh: 因为天气好，所以农民今年种了很多蔬菜。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hǎo, suǒyǐ nóngmín jīnnián zhòng le hěnduō shūcài.
en: Because the weather has been good, the farmers planted a lot of vegetables this year.

zh: 虽然这种方法很简单，但效果却非常好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè zhǒng fāngfǎ hěn jiǎndān, dàn xiàoguǒ què fēicháng hǎo.
en: Although this method is quite simple, the results are actually very good.

zh: 他决定放弃城市生活，回到农村种植有机蔬菜。
pinyin: Tā juédìng fàngqì chéngshì shēnghuó, huídào nóngcūn zhòngzhí yǒujī shūcài.
en: He decided to give up city life and go back to the countryside to grow organic vegetables.

zh: 我爸爸是医生。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì yīshēng.
en: My father is a doctor.

zh: 昨天我去看医生了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ qù kàn yīshēng le.
en: I went to see the doctor yesterday.

zh: 因为我生病了，所以去医院找医生。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ shēngbìng le, suǒyǐ qù yīyuàn zhǎo yīshēng.
en: Because I was sick, I went to the hospital to see a doctor.

zh: 那位医生虽然很忙，但是对患者很有耐心。
pinyin: Nà wèi yīshēng suīrán hěn máng, dànshì duì huànzhě hěn yǒu nàixīn.
en: Although that doctor is very busy, he's quite patient with his patients.

zh: 她想成为一名医生，因为她觉得这份工作很有意义。
pinyin: Tā xiǎng chéngwéi yī míng yīshēng, yīnwèi tā juéde zhè fèn gōngzuò hěn yǒu yìyì.
en: She wants to become a doctor because she finds the work very meaningful.

zh: 最后我吃了一个苹果。
pinyin: Zuìhòu wǒ chīle yīge píngguǒ.
en: Finally I ate an apple.

zh: 今天最后一节课是英语课。
pinyin: Jīntiān zuìhòu yī jié kè shì yīngyǔ kè.
en: The last class today is English.

zh: 虽然很累，但是最后我还是完成了工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì zuìhòu wǒ háishi wánchéngle gōngzuò.
en: Although I was tired, I finally finished the work anyway.

zh: 经过三个小时的讨论，最后大家同意了这个计划。
pinyin: Jīngguò sān ge xiǎoshí de tǎolùn, zuìhòu dàjiā tóngyìle zhège jìhuà.
en: After discussing for three hours, everyone finally agreed on this plan.

zh: 那部电影虽然开头有点无聊，但最后的转折让所有人都吃了一惊。
pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng suīrán kāitou yǒudiǎn wúliáo, dàn zuìhòu de zhuǎnzhé ràng suǒyǒu rén dōu chīle yī jīng.
en: Though the movie started off a bit boring, the final twist shocked everyone.

zh: 吃饭之前洗手。
pinyin: Chīfàn zhīqián xǐ shǒu.
en: Wash your hands before eating.

zh: 上课之前，我喝了一杯水。
pinyin: Shàngkè zhīqián, wǒ hēle yībēi shuǐ.
en: Before class, I had a cup of water.

zh: 虽然我之前没去过那个地方，但是我很想去。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ zhīqián méi qùguo nàge dìfang, dànshì wǒ hěn xiǎng qù.
en: Although I've never been to that place before, I really want to go.

zh: 在你告诉我之前，我对这个话题一点都不了解。
pinyin: Zài nǐ gàosu wǒ zhīqián, wǒ duì zhège huàtí yìdiǎn dōu bu liǎojiě.
en: Before you told me, I didn't understand this topic at all.

zh: 他之前的工作经验让他在面试中表现得游刃有余。
pinyin: Tā zhīqián de gōngzuò jīngyàn ràng tā zài miànshì zhōng biǎoxiàn de yóu rènyóu yú.
en: His previous work experience enabled him to perform with ease during the interview.

zh: 老伙计，给我一杯水。
pinyin: Lǎo huǒjì, gěi wǒ yī bēi shuǐ.
en: Hey buddy, can you get me a glass of water?

zh: 昨天我和伙计们一起去吃饭了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé huǒjìmen yīqǐ qù chīfàn le.
en: Yesterday I went out to eat with my buddies.

zh: 虽然伙计们都很忙，但是他们还是来帮我的忙。
pinyin: Suīrán huǒjìmen dōu hěn máng, dànshì tāmen háishi lái bāng wǒ de máng.
en: Even though my friends were all busy, they still came to help me out.

zh: 因为这个伙计工作认真，所以老板很信任他。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhège huǒjì gōngzuò rènzhēn, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn hěn xìnrèn tā.
en: Because this guy is conscientious at work, the boss really trusts him.

zh: 在餐厅里那个伙计服务态度不错，我们都挺满意的。
pinyin: Zài cāntīng lǐ nàge huǒjì fúwù tàidù búcuò, wǒmen dōu tǐng mǎnyì de.
en: The waiter at that restaurant had a pretty good attitude, and we were all quite satisfied.

zh: 我的手很冷。
pinyin: Wǒ de shǒu hěn lěng.
en: My hands are very cold.

zh: 昨天我左手受伤了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zuǒ shǒu shòushāng le.
en: Yesterday I injured my left hand.

zh: 虽然他的手很疼，但是他还在工作。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de shǒu hěn téng, dànshì tā háizài gōngzuò.
en: Although his hand hurts a lot, he's still working.

zh: 因为手机坏了，他没法用手接电话。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shǒujī huài le, tā méifǎ yòng shǒu jiē diànhuà.
en: Because his phone broke, he couldn't answer calls by hand.

zh: 她做事很认真，从不假手于人处理重要的工作。
pinyin: Tā zuòshì hěn rènzhēn, cóng bu jiǎ shǒu yú rén chǔlǐ zhònyào de gōngzuò.
en: She's very conscientious and never delegates important work to others.

zh: 任何人都不能迟到。
pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu búnéng chídào.
en: Nobody can be late.

zh: 我不喜欢任何蔬菜，只吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ búxǐhuān rènhé shūcài, zhǐ chī mǐfàn.
en: I don't like any vegetables; I only eat rice.

zh: 虽然很贵，但是任何质量好的东西都值得买。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn guì, búshì rènhé zhìliàng hǎo de dōngxi dōu zhíde mǎi.
en: Although it's expensive, any good-quality item is worth buying.

zh: 如果没有任何证据，警察就不能逮捕他。
pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu rènhé zhèngjù, jǐngchá jiù búnéng dàibǔ tā.
en: If there's no evidence whatsoever, the police can't arrest him.

zh: 在做决定前，我们需要听取任何相关的意见。
pinyin: Zài zuò juéding qián, wǒmen xūyào tīngqǔ rènhé xiāngguān de yìjian.
en: Before making a decision, we need to hear out any relevant opinions.

zh: 我有很多书。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hěnduō shū.
en: I have a lot of books.

zh: 昨天我吃了很多水果。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ chīle hěnduō shuǐguǒ.
en: Yesterday I ate a lot of fruit.

zh: 因为下雨，所以很多人没来上课。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén méi lái shàngkè.
en: Because it was raining, a lot of people didn't come to class.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他还是看了很多有意思的电影。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi kànle hěnduō yǒu yìsi de diànyǐng.
en: Although work was hectic, he still managed to watch a lot of interesting movies.

zh: 网络的出现让人们能接触到很多以前根本无法获取的信息。
pinyin: Wǎngluò de chūxiàn ràng rénmen néng jiēchù dào hěnduō yǐqián gēnběn wúfǎ huòqǔ de xìnxī.
en: The emergence of the internet has allowed people to access a lot of information that was previously impossible to obtain.

zh: 你的书在哪儿？
pinyin: Nǐ de shū zài nǎ'er?
en: Where is your book?

zh: 妈妈今天在哪儿工作？
pinyin: Māma jīntiān zài nǎ'er gōngzuò?
en: Where is Mom working today?

zh: 虽然房间很大，但是浴室在哪儿都找不到。
