pinyin: Suīrán fángjiān hěn dà, dànshì yùshì zài nǎ'er dōu zhǎo bu dào.
en: Even though the room is big, I can't find the bathroom anywhere in it.

zh: 他问我最好吃的餐厅在哪儿，我建议去商业街。
pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ zuì hǎochī de cāntīng zài nǎ'er, wǒ jiànyì qù shāngyè jiē.
en: He asked me where the best restaurant is, so I suggested going to the business district.

zh: 这家公司的总部在哪儿都没人确定，因为他们刚搬迁。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de zǒngbù zài nǎ'er dōu méi rén quèdìng, yīnwèi tāmen gāng bānqiān.
en: Nobody's quite sure where the company headquarters is now since they just relocated.

zh: 这种苹果很好吃。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng píngguǒ hěn hǎochī.
en: This kind of apple tastes really good.

zh: 我每天都喝这种茶。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dōu hē zhè zhǒng chá.
en: I drink this type of tea every day.

zh: 因为这种天气很冷，所以我不想出门。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè zhǒng tiānqì hěn lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ búxiǎng chūmén.
en: Because this kind of weather is so cold, I don't feel like going out.

zh: 虽然这种方法比较简单，但是效果不一定最好。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè zhǒng fāngfǎ bǐjiào jiǎndān, dànshì xiàoguǒ búyīdìng zuì hǎo.
en: Although this method is relatively simple, the results aren't necessarily the best.

zh: 在工作压力大的时候，这种心态调整对心理健康很有帮助。
pinyin: Zài gōngzuò yālì dà de shíhou, zhè zhǒng xīntài tiáozhěng duì xīnlǐ jiànkāng hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
en: When work stress is high, this kind of mindset adjustment really helps with mental health.

zh: 上帝很好。
pinyin: Shàngdì hěn hǎo.
en: God is very good.

zh: 很多人相信上帝。
pinyin: Hěnduō rén xiāngxìn shàngdì.
en: Many people believe in God.

zh: 虽然我们看不见上帝，但是很多人信他。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen kànbujìan shàngdì, dànshì hěnduō rén xìn tā.
en: Although we can't see God, many people still have faith in him.

zh: 在困难的时候，她经常祈祷上帝能帮助她。
pinyin: Zài kùnnan de shíhou, tā jīngcháng qǐdào shàngdì néng bāngzhù tā.
en: During difficult times, she often prays that God will help her.

zh: 不同宗教的人对上帝的理解和信仰方式各不相同。
pinyin: Búntóng zōngjiào de rén duì shàngdì de lǐjiě hé xìnyǎng fāngshì gè búxiāng相同.
en: People from different religions have different understandings and ways of believing in God.

zh: 这个女人是我妈妈。
pinyin: Zhège nǚrén shì wǒ māma.
en: This woman is my mother.

zh: 那个女人每天都去公园。
pinyin: Nàge nǚrén měitiān dōu qù gōngyuán.
en: That woman goes to the park every day.

zh: 因为这个女人很聪明，所以她的工作很好。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhège nǚrén hěn cōngming, suǒyǐ tā de gōngzuò hěn hǎo.
en: Because this woman is smart, her job is really good.

zh: 那个女人虽然年纪比较大，但是她的想法很新潮。
pinyin: Nàge nǚrén suīrán niánjì bǐjiào dà, dànshì tā de xiǎngfǎ hěn xīncháo.
en: Although that woman is older, her ideas are quite modern.

zh: 我认识的那个女人在公司里工作了十年，现在是部门经理。
pinyin: Wǒ rènshi de nàge nǚrén zài gōngsī li gōngzuòle shí nián, xiànzài shì bùmén jīnglǐ.
en: The woman I know has worked at the company for ten years and is now a department manager.

zh: 我的名字是李明。
pinyin: Wǒ de míngzì shì Lǐ Míng.
en: My name is Li Ming.

zh: 你好，请告诉我你的名字。
pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, qǐng gàosu wǒ nǐ de míngzì.
en: Hi, could you tell me your name please?

zh: 因为这个名字很特别，所以大家都记得住。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhège míngzì hěn tèbié, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu jìde zhù.
en: Because this name is so unique, everyone remembers it.

zh: 他给女儿起的名字很有意义，代表了家族的传统。
pinyin: Tā gěi nǚ'ér qǐ de míngzì hěn yǒu yìyì, dàibiǎole jiāzú de chuántǒng.
en: The name he gave his daughter is very meaningful and represents the family's tradition.

zh: 取名字其实不容易，既要考虑寓意，也要念起来顺畅。
pinyin: Qǔ míngzì qīshí búróngyì, jìyào kǎolǜ yùyì, yě yào niàn qǐlai shùnchàng.
en: Naming someone isn't actually easy—you have to consider the meaning while making sure it flows well when spoken.

zh: 我认识她。
pinyin: Wǒ rènshi tā.
en: I know her.

zh: 我上周认识了一个新朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ shàng zhōu rènshile yī ge xīn péngyou.
en: I made a new friend last week.

zh: 虽然我们认识的时间不长，但是我很信任他。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen rènshi de shíjiān búcháng, dànshi wǒ hěn xìnrèn tā.
en: Although we haven't known each other long, I trust him a lot.

zh: 在工作中认识的同事现在成为了我最好的朋友。
pinyin: Zài gōngzuò zhōng rènshi de tóngshi xiànzài chéngwéile wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyou.
en: A colleague I met at work has become one of my best friends.

zh: 我们通过社交媒体认识，后来发现有很多共同的兴趣爱好。
pinyin: Wǒmen tōngguò shèjiāo méitǐ rènshi, hòulái fāxiàn yǒu hěnduō gòngtóng de xìngqù àihào.
en: We met through social media and later realized we had a lot of shared interests.

zh: 我坐在椅子上。
pinyin: Wǒ zuò zài yǐzi shang.
en: I'm sitting on a chair.

zh: 每天早上我坐公交车去上班。
pinyin: Měi tiān zǎo shang wǒ zuò gōngjiāo chē qù shàngbān.
en: Every morning I take the bus to work.

zh: 虽然坐了很久的飞机，但是我一点都不累。
pinyin: Suīrán zuò le hěn jiǔ de fēijī, dànshi wǒ yīdiǎn dōu búyòu.
en: Even though I sat on the plane for a long time, I'm not tired at all.

zh: 坐在咖啡馆里工作的人越来越多了。
pinyin: Zuò zài kāfēi guǎn li gōngzuò de rén yuèláiyuè duō le.
en: More and more people are working while sitting in cafés these days.

zh: 与其坐以待毙，不如主动出击寻找新的机会。
pinyin: Yǔqī zuò yǐ dàibì, búrú zhǔdòng chūjī xúnzhǎo xīn de jīhuì.
en: Rather than sit idle and wait for failure, it's better to take the initiative and actively seek new opportunities.

zh: 今晚我吃饭。
pinyin: Jīnwǎn wǒ chīfàn.
en: I'm eating dinner tonight.

zh: 今晚我们一起看电影好吗？
pinyin: Jīnwǎn wǒmen yīqǐ kàn diànyǐng hǎo ma?
en: Can we watch a movie together tonight?

zh: 因为今晚下雨，所以我们不能去公园。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīnwǎn xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen búnéng qù gōngyuán.
en: Since it's raining tonight, we can't go to the park.

zh: 今晚的会议虽然很重要，但我可能要迟到。
pinyin: Jīnwǎn de huìyì suīrán hěn zhòngyào, dàn wǒ kěnéng yào chídiào.
en: Although tonight's meeting is important, I might be late.

zh: 今晚的表现让我对他刮目相看，他确实进步了不少。
pinyin: Jīnwǎn de biǎoxiàn ràng wǒ duì tā guāmùxiāngkàn, tā quèshí jìnbù le búshǎo.
en: His performance tonight has really changed my opinion of him—he's made significant progress.

zh: 我喜欢苹果，其他水果不喜欢。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ, qítā shuǐguǒ búxǐhuān.
en: I like apples, but I don't like other fruits.

zh: 今天我买了书和笔，其他东西都没买。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ mǎile shū hé bǐ, qítā dōngxi dōu méi mǎi.
en: Today I bought books and pens, but I didn't buy anything else.

zh: 虽然天气很热，但我还要去上班，其他人也都在工作。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn rè, dàn wǒ háiyào qù shàngbān, qítā rén yě dōu zài gōngzuò.
en: Even though it's very hot, I still have to go to work, and everyone else is working too.

zh: 除了英语课以外，其他课程的难度都比较低，学生们学得很快。
pinyin: Chúle yīngyǔ kè yǐwài, qítā kèchéng de nándù dōu bǐjiào dī, xuéshēngmen xuéde hěn kuài.
en: Apart from the English class, all the other courses are relatively easy, so students pick them up quickly.

zh: 这个项目的预算已经确定了，其他部门不能随意改动，否则会影响整个计划的进度。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de yùsuàn yǐjīng quèdìngle, qítā bùmén búnéng suíyì gǎidòng, fǒuzé huì yǐngxiǎng zhěnggè jìhuà de jìndù.
en: The budget for this project has already been fixed, and other departments can't change it arbitrarily, or it will affect the overall progress of the plan.

zh: 我喝水。
pinyin: Wǒ hē shuǐ.
en: I'm drinking water.

zh: 早上我喝了一杯咖啡。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ hēle yī bēi kāfēi.
en: This morning I had a cup of coffee.

zh: 因为天气很热，所以我们喝冰茶。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, suǒyǐ wǒmen hē bīng chá.
en: Because it's really hot, we're drinking iced tea.

zh: 他不喜欢喝酒，所以聚会的时候总是喝果汁。
pinyin: Tā búxǐhuān hē jiǔ, suǒyǐ jùhuì de shíhou zǒngshi hē guǒzhī.
en: He doesn't like drinking alcohol, so he always has juice when we hang out.

zh: 很多上班族早上喝咖啡提神，晚上却喝茶放松。
pinyin: Hěnduō shàngbānzú zǎoshang hē kāfēi tíshén, wǎnshang què hē chá fàngsōng.
en: A lot of office workers drink coffee in the morning to wake up, but switch to tea at night to unwind.

zh: 我记得你的名字。
pinyin: Wǒ jìde nǐ de míngzi.
en: I remember your name.

zh: 你记得昨天买的书吗？
pinyin: Nǐ jìde zuótiān mǎi de shū ma?
en: Do you remember the book you bought yesterday?

zh: 虽然时间很长，但我还是记得那个故事。
pinyin: Suīrán shíjiān hěn cháng, dàn wǒ háishi jìde nàge gùshi.
en: Even though it's been a long time, I still remember that story.

zh: 他记得在大学的时候，经常和朋友一起学习。
pinyin: Tā jìde zài dàxué de shíhou, jīngcháng hé péngyou yìqǐ xuéxí.
en: He remembers that back in university, he often used to study with friends.

zh: 我记得最清楚的是她说话时那温和的语气。
pinyin: Wǒ jìde zuì qīngchu de shì tā shuōhuà shí nà wēnhuó de yǔqì.
en: What I remember most clearly is the gentle tone of her voice when she spoke.

zh: 那个家伙很坏。
pinyin: Nàge jiāhuǒ hěn huài.
en: That guy is really mean.

zh: 这个家伙每天都吃很多东西。
pinyin: Zhège jiāhuǒ měitiān dōu chī hěnduō dōngxi.
en: This guy eats a lot of food every single day.

zh: 虽然那个家伙很聪明，但是他很懒。
pinyin: Suīrán nàge jiāhuǒ hěn cōngmíng, dànshi tā hěn lǎn.
en: Even though that guy is smart, he's really lazy.

zh: 这个家伙因为总是迟到，所以老板很生气。
pinyin: Zhège jiāhuǒ yīnwei zǒngshi chídào, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn hěn shēngqi.
en: Because this guy is always late, the boss is really upset with him.

zh: 那个家伙看起来很凶，其实是个挺不错的人。
pinyin: Nàge jiāhuǒ kànqilái hěn xiōng, qīshí shì ge tǐng búcuò de rén.
en: That guy looks intimidating on the surface, but he's actually a pretty decent person.

zh: 我与妈妈在家。
pinyin: Wǒ yǔ māma zài jiā.
en: I'm at home with my mom.

zh: 他每天与朋友一起吃午饭。
pinyin: Tā měitiān yǔ péngyou yīqǐ chī wǔfàn.
en: He eats lunch with his friends every day.

zh: 虽然我与他性格不同，但是我们是好朋友。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ yǔ tā xìnggé búdòng, dànshì wǒmen shì hǎo péngyou.
en: Even though he and I have different personalities, we're good friends.

zh: 这个项目需要与多个部门合作才能完成。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào yǔ duōgè bùmén hézuò cáinéng wánchéng.
en: This project requires collaboration with multiple departments to be completed.

zh: 与其抱怨工作压力，不如主动调整自己的心态。
pinyin: Yǔqī bàoyuàn gōngzuò yālì, búrú zhǔdòng tiáozhěng zìjǐ de xīntài.
en: Rather than complaining about work stress, it's better to actively adjust your mindset.

zh: 你要茶或者咖啡？
pinyin: Nǐ yào chá huòzhě kāfēi?
en: Do you want tea or coffee?

zh: 明天我们可以去公园或者去电影院。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒmen kěyǐ qù gōngyuán huòzhě qù diànyǐngyuàn.
en: Tomorrow we can go to the park or go to the cinema.

zh: 因为下雨了，我们可以在家看书或者玩游戏。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, wǒmen kěyǐ zài jiā kànshū huòzhě wán yóuxì.
en: Since it's raining, we can read books at home or play games.

zh: 这个问题比较复杂，你可以请教老师或者查一下资料。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí bǐjiào fùzá, nǐ kěyǐ qǐngjiào lǎoshī huòzhě chá yīxià zīliào.
en: This question is quite complicated; you could ask your teacher or look up some information.

zh: 无论是工作压力还是家庭问题，我们都应该找人倾诉或者寻求专业帮助。
pinyin: Wúlùn shì gōngzuò yālì háishi jiātíng wèntí, wǒmen dōu yīnggāi zhǎo rén qīngshù huòzhě xúnqiú zhuānyè bāngzhù.
en: Whether it's work stress or family problems, we should always talk to someone or seek professional help.

zh: 我写字。
pinyin: Wǒ xiě zì.
en: I'm writing characters.

zh: 她每天写日记。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān xiě rìjì.
en: She writes in her diary every day.

zh: 因为明天要考试，所以我今晚要写作业。
pinyin: Yīnwèi míngtiān yào kǎoshì, suǒyǐ wǒ jīnwǎn yào xiě zuòyè.
en: Because there's a test tomorrow, I need to do my homework writing tonight.

zh: 虽然他写字很慢，但是他的字很漂亮。
pinyin: Suīrán tā xiě zì hěn màn, dànshì tā de zì hěn piàoliàng.
en: Although he writes slowly, his handwriting is really beautiful.

zh: 他用手机写了一份报告，然后通过电邮发给了老板。
pinyin: Tā yòng shǒujī xiěle yī fèn bàogào, ránhòu tōngguò diànyóu fāgěile lǎobǎn.
en: He wrote a report on his phone and then emailed it to his boss.

zh: 我穿红色的衣服。
pinyin: Wǒ chuān hóngsè de yīfu.
en: I'm wearing a red shirt.

zh: 冬天我穿很厚的外套。
pinyin: Dōngtiān wǒ chuān hěn hòu de wàitào.
en: In winter I wear a very thick coat.

zh: 因为今天很冷，所以我穿了两件毛衣。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān hěn lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ chuānle liǎng jiàn máoyī.
en: Because it's cold today, I put on two sweaters.

zh: 虽然这条裤子很贵，但她还是决定穿它去参加聚会。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè tiáo kùzi hěn guì, dànshì tā háishi juéding chuān tā qù cānjiā jùhuì.
en: Although those pants were expensive, she decided to wear them to the party anyway.

zh: 他穿着得体的商务装，看起来就像一个成功的商人。
pinyin: Tā chuānzhe déti de shāngwù zhuāng, kàn qǐlai jiùxiàng yīge chénggōng de shāngrén.
en: He was dressed in well-fitting business attire, looking every bit the successful businessman.

zh: 我弄坏了你的杯子。
pinyin: Wǒ nòng huài le nǐ de bēi zi.
en: I broke your cup.

zh: 他在厨房弄饭，很香。
pinyin: Tā zài chúfang nòng fàn, hěn xiāng.
en: He's making food in the kitchen, and it smells great.

zh: 因为下雨，我们弄不清楚去哪里玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen nòng bu qīngchu qù nǎlǐ wán.
en: Because of the rain, we couldn't figure out where to go and have fun.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但总是弄不明白别人的想法。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, dàn zǒngshì nòng bu míngbai biérén de xiǎngfǎ.
en: Even though he's smart, he always struggles to understand what other people are thinking.

zh: 这个项目很复杂，我们花了三个月才弄懂其中的关键问题。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù hěn fùzá, wǒmen huāle sān ge yuè cái nòng dǒng qīzhōng de guānjiàn wèntí.
en: This project was complicated—it took us three months to finally grasp the key issues involved.

zh: 我过去吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ guòqù chīfàn.
en: I went over to eat.

zh: 昨天我过去看了朋友。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ guòqù kànle péngyou.
en: I went to visit my friend yesterday.

zh: 因为天气很好，我们就过去公园玩了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen jiù guòqù gōngyuán wánle.
en: Because the weather was nice, we went to the park to play.

zh: 虽然他过去经常迟到，但现在他改好了。
pinyin: Suīrán tā guòqù jīngcháng chídào, dàn xiànzài tā gǎi hǎole.
en: Although he used to be late all the time, he's fixed that now.

zh: 他对过去的错误反思得很深入，这值得我们学习。
pinyin: Tā duì guòqù de cuòwù fǎnsī de hěn shēnyù, zhè zhídé wǒmen xuéxí.
en: He reflected very deeply on his past mistakes, which is worth learning from.

zh: 你的书在哪里？
pinyin: Nǐ de shū zài nǎlǐ?
en: Where is your book?

zh: 我不知道他现在在哪里。
pinyin: Wǒ búzhīdào tā xiànzài zài nǎlǐ.
en: I don't know where he is right now.

zh: 虽然我没去过，但我知道那个地方在哪里。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ méi qùguò, dàn wǒ zhīdào nàge dìfang zài nǎlǐ.
en: Although I've never been there, I know where that place is.

zh: 如果你想找工作，最好问一下哪里在招聘。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng zhǎo gōngzuò, zuìhǎo wèn yīxià nǎlǐ zài zhāopìn.
en: If you want to find a job, you should ask around to see which places are hiring.

zh: 与其盲目跟风，不如先搞清楚自己真正想要的是哪里。
pinyin: Yǔqīángmù gēnfēng, búrú xiān gǎoqīngchu zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xiǎngyào de shì nǎlǐ.
en: Rather than blindly following the crowd, it's better to first figure out what you really want and where that takes you.

zh: 我吃饭啦！
pinyin: Wǒ chīfàn la!
en: I'm eating now!

zh: 天黑了，我们回家啦。
pinyin: Tiānhēi le, wǒmen huíjiā la.
en: It's getting dark, so let's head home.

zh: 虽然很累，但是工作终于完成啦。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì gōngzuò zhōngyú wánchéng la.
en: Although I'm exhausted, the work is finally done.

zh: 因为下雨了，原定的计划只能取消啦。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, yuándìng de jìhuà zhǐnéng qǔxiāo la.
en: Since it started raining, we had to cancel our original plan.

zh: 他们把这个项目搞砸啦，现在想要补救都晚啦。
pinyin: Tāmen bǎ zhège xiàngmù gǎozá la, xiànzài xiǎngyào bǔjiù dōu wǎn la.
en: They botched the project, and now it's too late to salvage it.

zh: 我喜欢咖啡，她却喜欢茶。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān kāfēi, tā却 xǐhuān chá.
en: I like coffee, but she likes tea.

zh: 天气很冷，小孩们却在外面开心地玩。
pinyin: Tiānqì hěn lěng, xiǎo háizi men 却 zài wàimiàn kāixīn de wán.
en: The weather is cold, yet the children are happily playing outside.

zh: 虽然他很累，但是他却坚持要去健身房锻炼。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn lèi, dànshì tā 却 jiānchí yào qù jiànshēnfáng duànliàn.
en: Although he's exhausted, he still insists on going to the gym to work out.

zh: 很多人都认为这个计划会成功，结果却完全失败了。
pinyin: Hěnduō rén dōu rènwéi zhège jìhuà huì chénggōng, jiéguǒ 却 wánquán shībài le.
en: Many people thought this plan would succeed, but it completely fell through instead.

zh: 他花了好几年才学会这门技能，用起来却意外得简单。
pinyin: Tā huāle hǎo jǐ nián cái xuéhuì zhè mén jìnéng, yònglai 却 yìwài de jiǎndān.
en: It took him years to master this skill, yet when he uses it, it feels surprisingly straightforward.

zh: 两个苹果算多少钱？
pinyin: Liǎng ge píngguǒ suàn duōshao qián?
en: How much are two apples?

zh: 加上税，这件衣服算三百块钱。
pinyin: Jiāshang shuì, zhè jiàn yīfu suàn sānbǎi kuài qián.
en: With tax included, this shirt comes to about 300 yuan.

zh: 虽然他很年轻，但他的经验算是比较丰富的。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn niánqīng, dàn tā de jīngyàn suàn shì bǐjiào fēngfù de.
en: Although he's young, his experience is actually quite extensive.

zh: 这次失败不算什么，我们可以从中学到很多东西。
pinyin: Zhè cì shībài búsuàn shénme, wǒmen kěyǐ cóng zhōng xuéدào hěnduō dōngxi.
en: This failure isn't really a big deal—we can learn a lot from it.

zh: 按照目前的发展速度来算，公司在三年内应该能达到预期目标。
pinyin: Ànzhào mùqián de fāzhǎn sùdù lái suàn, gōngsī zài sān nián nèi yīnggāi néng dádào yùqī mùbiāo.
en: Based on the current development pace, the company should be able to reach its targets within three years.

zh: 我担心下雨。
pinyin: Wǒ dānxīn xiàyǔ.
en: I'm worried it will rain.

zh: 妈妈担心我的功课。
pinyin: Māma dānxīn wǒ de gōngkè.
en: Mom is worried about my homework.

zh: 因为飞机晚点,我担心会迟到。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fēijī wǎndiǎn, wǒ dānxīn huì chídào.
en: Because the plane is delayed, I'm worried I'll be late.

zh: 他一个人去旅游,家人都担心他的安全。
pinyin: Tā yīgèrén qù lǚyóu, jiārén dōu dānxīn tā de ānquán.
en: He's traveling alone, and his family is all worried about his safety.

zh: 虽然医生说没问题,但她还是担心病情会反复。
pinyin: Suīrán yīshēng shuō méi wèntí, dàn tā háishi dānxīn bìngqíng huì fǎnfù.
en: Even though the doctor said it's fine, she's still worried the condition might flare up again.

zh: 我继续吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ jìxù chīfàn.
en: I'll keep eating.

zh: 明天我继续上班。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ jìxù shàngbān.
en: Tomorrow I'll go back to work.

zh: 虽然很累，但是我继续工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn léi, dànshì wǒ jìxù gōngzuò.
en: Even though I'm exhausted, I'll keep working.

zh: 如果天气不好，我们还是继续比赛。
pinyin: Rúguǒ tiānqì búhǎo, wǒmen háishi jìxù bǐsài.
en: If the weather is bad, we'll go ahead with the match anyway.

zh: 尽管公司面临困难，管理层决定继续投资新项目。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn gōngsī miànlín kùnnan, guǎnlǐcéng juédìng jìxù tóuzī xīn xiàngmù.
en: Despite the company's difficulties, management decided to continue investing in new projects.

zh: 我送你一个礼物。
pinyin: Wǒ sòng nǐ yī ge lǐwù.
en: I'm giving you a gift.

zh: 昨天妈妈送给我一本书。
pinyin: Zuótiān māma sòng gěi wǒ yī běn shū.
en: Mom gave me a book yesterday.

zh: 因为他生日了，所以我送他一件衣服。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā shēngrì le, suǒyǐ wǒ sòng tā yī jiàn yīfu.
en: Since it's his birthday, I'm giving him a piece of clothing as a gift.

zh: 虽然礼物不贵，但我送给你是为了表示感谢。
pinyin: Suīrán lǐwù bu guì, dàn wǒ sòng gěi nǐ shìwèile biǎoshì gǎnxiè.
en: Although the gift isn't expensive, I'm giving it to you to show my appreciation.

zh: 每次出差回来，他都会送礼物给家里人，这已经成了他的习惯。
pinyin: Měi cì chūchāi huílái, tā dōu huì sòng lǐwù gěi jiālǐ rén, zhè yǐjīng chéngle tā de xíguàn.
en: Every time he comes back from a business trip, he brings gifts for his family—it's become a habit of his.

zh: 这个女孩很聪明。
pinyin: Zhège nǚ háir hěn cōngming.
en: This girl is very smart.

zh: 那个女孩喜欢吃苹果和葡萄。
pinyin: Nàge nǚ háir xǐhuān chī píngguǒ hé pútao.
en: That girl likes eating apples and grapes.

zh: 因为天气很好,所以那个女孩去公园玩了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ nàge nǚ háir qù gōngyuán wán le.
en: Because the weather was nice, the girl went to play in the park.

zh: 虽然这个女孩年纪小,但她已经会说三种语言了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège nǚ háir niánjì xiǎo, dàn tā yǐjīng huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔyán le.
en: Although this girl is young, she can already speak three languages.

zh: 那个女孩虽然家境不好,但学习成绩一直名列前茅。
pinyin: Nàge nǚ háir suīrán jiājìng búhǎo, dàn xuéxí chéngjì yīzhí míngliè qiánmáo.
en: Despite difficult family circumstances, that girl has consistently ranked at the top of her class.

zh: 我以水和米做饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐ shuǐ hé mǐ zuòfàn.
en: I cook rice with water.

zh: 他每天以骑自行车去上班。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān yǐ qī zìxíngchē qù shàngbān.
en: He goes to work by bicycle every day.

zh: 因为没有钱，所以他以走路的方式去学校。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu qián, suǒyǐ tā yǐ zǒulù de fāngshì qù xuéxiào.
en: Because he has no money, he goes to school by walking.

zh: 公司以提高效率为目标，改进了工作流程。
pinyin: Gōngsī yǐ tígāo xiàolǜ wéi mùbiāo, gǎijìnle gōngzuò liúchéng.
en: The company improved its workflow with the goal of increasing efficiency.

zh: 与其以消极态度面对困难，不如以积极心态去解决问题。
pinyin: Yǔqì yǐ xiāojí tàidù miànduì kùnnan, búrú yǐ jījí xīntài qù jiějué wèntí.
en: Rather than face difficulties with a negative attitude, it's better to tackle problems with a positive mindset.

zh: 我喜欢玩球。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān wán qiú.
en: I like to play ball.

zh: 周末我和朋友一起玩电脑游戏。
pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ hé péngyou yìqǐ wán diànnǎo yóuxì.
en: On weekends, my friends and I play computer games together.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但是孩子们还是想在外面玩。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì háizimen háishi xiǎng zài wàimiàn wán.
en: Even though the weather is cold, the children still want to play outside.

zh: 他沉迷于网络游戏，每天都玩到很晚才睡觉。
pinyin: Tā chénmì yú wǎngluò yóuxì, měi tiān dōu wán dào hěn wǎn cái shuìjiào.
en: He's addicted to online games and plays until very late every night before going to bed.

zh: 与其整天玩手机，不如花时间培养一些有意义的爱好。
pinyin: Yǔqī zhěng tiān wán shǒujī, búrú huā shíjiān péiyǎng yìxiē yǒu yìyì de àihào.
en: Rather than playing on your phone all day, it's better to invest time in developing meaningful hobbies.

zh: 这是我亲爱的妈妈。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ qīn'ài de māma.
en: This is my dear mother.

zh: 我每天都和亲爱的朋友一起玩。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dōu hé qīn'ài de péngyou yìqǐ wán.
en: Every day I play with my dear friends.

zh: 因为我很爱他，所以他是我亲爱的人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ hěn ài tā, suǒyǐ tā shì wǒ qīn'ài de rén.
en: Because I love him so much, he's someone very dear to me.

zh: 我的亲爱的家人虽然住得很远，但我们经常视频通话。
pinyin: Wǒ de qīn'ài de jiārén suīrán zhù de hěn yuǎn, dàn wǒmen jīngcháng shìpín通huà.
en: Although my dear family lives far away, we video call regularly.

zh: 能和亲爱的人一起分享成功的时刻，这才是人生最珍贵的事。
pinyin: Néng hé qīn'ài de rén yìqǐ fēnxiǎng chénggōng de shíkè, zhè cái shì rénshēng zuì zhēnguì de shì.
en: Being able to share moments of success with those we hold dear—that's what makes life truly precious.

zh: 请坐下来。
pinyin: Qǐng zuò xiàlái.
en: Please sit down.

zh: 雨停下来了，我们可以出去。
pinyin: Yǔ tíng xiàlái le, wǒmen kěyǐ chūqù.
en: The rain has stopped, so we can go outside.

zh: 虽然很累，但他还是坚持跑下来了。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn tā háishi jiānchí pǎo xiàlái le.
en: Even though he was exhausted, he still managed to finish the run.

zh: 经理听完我的计划以后，冷静下来，开始认真讨论。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ tīngwán wǒ de jìhuà yǐhòu, lěngjìng xiàlái, kāishǐ rènzhēn tǎolùn.
en: After hearing my plan, the manager calmed down and started discussing it seriously.

zh: 那次争执让我们都冷静下来反思，结果反而增进了相互理解。
pinyin: Nà cì zhēngzhí ràng wǒmen dōu lěngjìng xiàlái fǎnsī, jiéguǒ fǎn'ér zēngjìn le xiānghù lǐjiě.
en: That argument forced us both to calm down and reflect, which actually deepened our mutual understanding.

zh: 我成了医生。
pinyin: Wǒ chéngle yīshēng.
en: I became a doctor.

zh: 去年他成功地完成了这个项目。
pinyin: Qùnián tā chénggōng de wánchéngle zhège xiàngmù.
en: Last year he successfully completed this project.

zh: 虽然很困难，但他的努力最后还是成了果实。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn kùnnan, dàn tāde nǔlì zuìhòu háishi chéngle guǒshí.
en: Although it was very difficult, his effort eventually bore fruit.

zh: 因为坚持不懈的训练，她终于成为了职业运动员。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jiānchíbùxié de xùnliàn, tā zhōngyú chéngwèile zhíyè yùndòngyuán.
en: Because of persistent training, she finally became a professional athlete.

zh: 这家公司从小作坊成长为行业领头羊，说明了团队的执行力。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī cóng xiǎo zuòfāng chéngzhǎng wéi hángyè lǐngtóu yáng, shuōmíng le tuánduì de zhíxíng lì.
en: The fact that this company has grown from a small workshop into an industry leader demonstrates the team's execution capacity.

zh: 我有一条狗。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī tiáo gǒu.
en: I have a dog.

zh: 今天我买了两条鱼。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ mǎile liǎng tiáo yú.
en: Today I bought two fish.

zh: 虽然这条路很远，但是风景很美。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè tiáo lù hěn yuǎn, dànshì fēngjǐng hěn měi.
en: Although this road is long, the scenery is really beautiful.

zh: 因为时间紧张，他只穿了一条裤子就出门了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shíjiān jǐnzhāng, tā zhǐ chuānle yī tiáo kùzi jiù chūmén le.
en: Because he was in a hurry, he just threw on one pair of pants and left.

zh: 这条新闻报道虽然篇幅不大，但包含了很多值得关注的信息。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo xīnwén bàodào suīrán piānfu búdà, dàn bāohánle hěnduō zhídé guānzhù de xìnxī.
en: While this news article isn't very long, it contains a lot of information worth paying attention to.

zh: 这些饭够吃吗？
pinyin: Zhèxiē fàn gòu chī ma?
en: Is this food enough to eat?

zh: 我的钱不够买这个书。
pinyin: Wǒ de qián búgòu mǎi zhège shū.
en: I don't have enough money to buy this book.

zh: 虽然他很努力，但是经验还不够做这个工作。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn nǔlì, dànshì jīngyàn háishi búgòu zuò zhège gōngzuò.
en: Although he works hard, his experience still isn't enough for this job.

zh: 这个计划的细节不够完善，我们需要再改进一下。
pinyin: Zhège jìhuà de xì节 búgòu wánshàn, wǒmen xūyào zài gǎijìn yīxià.
en: The details of this plan aren't detailed enough—we need to refine it further.

zh: 仅仅靠热情是不够的，还要有实际行动才能成功。
pinyin: Jǐnjǐn kào règing shì búgòu de, háiyào yǒu shíjì xíngdòng cáinéng chénggōng.
en: Passion alone isn't enough—you need concrete action to succeed.

zh: 我的父亲是医生。
pinyin: Wǒ de fùqīn shì yīshēng.
en: My father is a doctor.

zh: 昨天我和父亲一起去公园了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé fùqīn yìqǐ qù gōngyuán le.
en: Yesterday I went to the park with my father.

zh: 虽然父亲很忙，但是他经常陪我做功课。
pinyin: Suīrán fùqīn hěn máng, dànshì tā jīngcháng péi wǒ zuò gōngkè.
en: Although my father is very busy, he often helps me with my homework.

zh: 我父亲退休后，开始学习书法和绘画。
pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn tuì休 hòu, kāishǐ xuéxí shūfǎ hé huìhuà.
en: After my father retired, he started learning calligraphy and painting.

zh: 父亲总是教导我们要诚实守信，这些品质影响了我们一生。
pinyin: Fùqīn zǒngshì jiàodào wǒmen yào chéngshí shǒuxìn, zhèxiē pǐnzhì yǐngxiǎngle wǒmen yīshēng.
en: My father always taught us to be honest and keep our word—qualities that have shaped us for life.

zh: 我以前喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: I used to like eating rice.

zh: 以前我每天都去公园。
pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ měitiān dōu qù gōngyuán.
en: I used to go to the park every day before.

zh: 以前的时候，我们住在山里，因为那里很安静。
pinyin: Yǐqián de shíhou, wǒmen zhù zài shānlǐ, yīnwèi nàli hěn ānjìng.
en: Back when we lived in the mountains, it was because the place was very peaceful.

zh: 虽然以前我对这个工作不感兴趣，但现在我觉得很有意义。
pinyin: Suīrán yǐqián wǒ duì zhège gōngzuò bù gǎn xìngqù, dàn xiànzài wǒ juéde hěn yǒu yìyì.
en: Although I wasn't interested in this job before, I find it very meaningful now.

zh: 以前我对这些问题想都没想过，直到遇见了能改变我想法的人。
pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ duì zhèxiē wèntí xiǎng dōu méi xiǎngguò, zhídào yùjiàn le néng gǎibiàn wǒ xiǎngfǎ de rén.
en: I'd never even considered these issues before, until I met someone who could change the way I think.

zh: 小狗跑了。
pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu pǎole.
en: The puppy ran away.

zh: 每天早上我都跑步。
pinyin: Měi tiān zǎo shang wǒ dōu pǎo bù.
en: I go running every morning.

zh: 因为下雨了，孩子们不能跑出去玩。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔle, háizi men búnéng pǎo chū qù wán.
en: Because it's raining, the kids can't run outside to play.

zh: 他听到噪音就跑到楼下去看发生了什么。
pinyin: Tā tīng dào zàoyīn jiù pǎo dào lóu xià qù kàn fāshēngle le shénme.
en: As soon as he heard the noise, he ran downstairs to see what happened.

zh: 这份工作压力太大，他最后还是选择跑去创业了。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò yālì tài dà, tā zuìhòu háishi xuǎnzé pǎo qù chuàngyè le.
en: The job was too stressful, so in the end he decided to leave and start his own business.

zh: 今年八月很热。
pinyin: Jīnnián bāyuè hěn rè.
en: August this year is very hot.

zh: 我每个月都去看我的奶奶。
pinyin: Wǒ měi ge yuè dōu qù kàn wǒ de nǎinai.
en: I visit my grandmother every month.

zh: 虽然上个月很忙，但是我还是坚持运动。
pinyin: Suīrán shàng ge yuè hěn máng, dànshì wǒ háishi jiānchí yùndòng.
en: Even though last month was hectic, I still kept up with exercise.

zh: 因为这个月的销售数据不错，公司决定给员工加奖金。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhège yuè de xiāoshòu shùjù búcuò, gōngsī juéding gěi yuángōng jiā jiǎngjīn.
en: Because sales this month have been good, the company decided to give employees a bonus.

zh: 这几个月他工作表现稳定，月薪也随之上升，前景看起来相当不错。
pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge yuè tā gōngzuò biǎoxiàn wěndìng, yuèxīn yě suízhī shàngshēng, qiánjǐng kàn qǐlái xiāngdāng búcuò.
en: Over these past months his work performance has been steady, his monthly salary has gone up accordingly, and his prospects look quite promising.

zh: 我早上吃面包。
pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang chī miànbāo.
en: I eat bread in the morning.

zh: 她每天早上六点起床。
pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
en: She gets up at six o'clock every morning.

zh: 因为起床太早，所以我现在很困。
pinyin: Yīnwèi qǐchuáng tài zǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ xiànzài hěn kùn.
en: Because I woke up too early, I'm really sleepy now.

zh: 早点完成这个项目会让我们有更多时间检查。
pinyin: Zǎodiǎn wánchéng zhège xiàngmù huì ràng wǒmen yǒu gèngduō shíjiān jiǎnchá.
en: Finishing this project earlier will give us more time to review it.

zh: 他早就意识到那个计划有问题，但是没有人听他的。
pinyin: Tā zǎojiù yìshí dào nàge jìhuà yǒu wèntí, dànshì méiyǒu rén tīng tā de.
en: He'd realized for a while that the plan had problems, but nobody paid attention to him.

zh: 我来自美国。
pinyin: Wǒ láizì Měiguó.
en: I'm from the United States.

zh: 美国人喜欢吃汉堡包。
pinyin: Měiguórén xǐhuān chī hànbǎobāo.
en: Americans like to eat hamburgers.

zh: 虽然美国很大，但是我去过很多城市。
pinyin: Suīrán Měiguó hěn dà, dànshì wǒ qùguò hěnduō chéngshì.
en: Although the US is huge, I've still visited many cities there.

zh: 因为工作的原因，他在美国生活了五年。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò de yuányīn, tā zài Měiguó shēnghuó le wǔ nián.
en: Because of work, he lived in the United States for five years.

zh: 美国的教育系统虽然资源丰富，但各地差异仍然很大。
pinyin: Měiguó de jiàoyù xìtǒng suīrán zīyuán fēngfù, dàn gè dì chāyì réngrán hěn dà.
en: While America's education system is well-resourced, there are still significant disparities across regions.

zh: 我的头发很长。
pinyin: Wǒ de tóufa hěn cháng.
en: My hair is very long.

zh: 去年我长高了很多。
pinyin: Qùnián wǒ zhǎng gāo le hěnduō.
en: I grew quite a bit taller last year.

zh: 因为他经常锻炼，所以身体长得很健康。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā jīngcháng duànliàn, suǒyǐ shēntǐ zhǎng de hěn jiànkāng.
en: Because he exercises regularly, his body is developing very healthily.

zh: 虽然这条河很长，但是我们可以用船快速穿过。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè tiáo hé hěn cháng, dànshì wǒmen kěyǐ yòng chuán kuàisù chuānguò.
en: Although this river is quite long, we can cross it quickly by boat.

zh: 在长期的工作压力下，他逐渐意识到健康比成功更重要。
pinyin: Zài chángqī de gōngzuò yālì xià, tā zhújiàn yìshí dào jiànkāng bǐ chéngōng gèng zhòngyào.
en: Under sustained work pressure over time, he gradually came to realize that health matters more than success.

zh: 我完全不吃辣。
pinyin: Wǒ wánquán bù chī là.
en: I don't eat spicy food at all.

zh: 他昨天完全没有来上课。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān wánquán méiyǒu lái shàngkè.
en: He didn't come to class at all yesterday.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我完全改变了计划。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒ wánquán gǎibiàn le jìhuà.
en: Because it rained, I completely changed my plans.

zh: 虽然我们努力了，但结果完全不符合期望。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen nǔlì le, dàn jiéguǒ wánquán bù fúhé qīwàng.
en: Although we tried hard, the result completely fell short of our expectations.

zh: 这个项目的成功完全取决于团队的配合程度。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chénggōng wánquán qǔjuéyú tuánduì de pèihé chéngdù.
en: The success of this project entirely depends on how well the team works together.

zh: 这是我的宝贝。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de bǎobèi.
en: This is my treasure.

zh: 妈妈每天都喜欢抱着小宝贝。
pinyin: Māma měitiān dōu xǐhuān báozhe xiǎo bǎobèi.
en: Mom loves holding the baby every day.

zh: 虽然宝贝很调皮，但是我们都很爱他。
pinyin: Suīrán bǎobèi hěn tiáopí, dànshì wǒmen dōu hěn ài tā.
en: Although the baby is mischievous, we all love him very much.

zh: 我女儿把那个玩具当成宝贝一样保护得很仔细。
pinyin: Wǒ nǚ'ér bǎ nàge wánjù dāngchéng bǎobèi yīyàng bǎohù de hěn zǐxì.
en: My daughter treasures that toy and takes very careful care of it.

zh: 这件古董虽然不值钱，但对爷爷来说就像宝贝一样有纪念意义。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn gǔdòng suīrán búzhí qián, dàn duì yéye láishuō jiùxiàng bǎobèi yīyàng yǒu jìniàn yìyì.
en: This antique may not be worth much, but it holds sentimental value for Grandpa like a precious treasure.

zh: 我的号码是八八八。
pinyin: Wǒ de hàomǎ shì bā bā bā.
en: My number is 888.

zh: 今天是十二号，明天放假。
pinyin: Jīntiān shì shí'èr hào, míngtiān fàngjià.
en: Today is the 12th, and we have a day off tomorrow.

zh: 因为我丢了手机，所以我的号码现在用不了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ diūle shǒujī, suǒyǐ wǒ de hàomǎ xiànzài yòngbuliao.
en: Because I lost my phone, my number doesn't work anymore.

zh: 公司要求所有员工用工作号码处理业务，不能用私人手机。
pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqiú suǒyǒu yuángōng yòng gōngzuò hàomǎ chǔlǐ yèwù, búnéng yòng sīrén shǒujī.
en: The company requires all employees to use their work number to handle business matters, not personal phones.

zh: 这个快递号码显示已经签收了，但我一直没收到包裹，得联系卖家调查一下。
pinyin: Zhège kuàidì hàomǎ xiǎnshì yǐjīng qiānshōule, dàn wǒ yìzhí méi shōudào bāoguǒ, děi liánxì màijiā diàochá yīxià.
en: This tracking number says the package was signed for, but I've never received it—I need to contact the seller to look into it.

zh: 他有一把枪。
pinyin: Tā yǒu yī bǎ qiāng.
en: He has a gun.

zh: 警察拿着枪在街上。
pinyin: Jǐngchá názhe qiāng zài jiēshang.
en: The police officer is carrying a gun on the street.

zh: 虽然他害怕枪，但是他学会了怎样使用。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hàipà qiāng, dànshì tā xuéhuìle zěnyàng shǐyòng.
en: Although he was scared of guns, he learned how to use one.

zh: 在电影里，士兵们用枪保护了城镇的安全。
pinyin: Zài diànyǐng lǐ, shìbīngmen yòng qiāng bǎohùle chéngzhèn de ānquán.
en: In the movie, the soldiers used guns to protect the town's safety.

zh: 新闻报道了关于非法枪支的问题，政府决定加强管制。
pinyin: Xīnwén bàodàole guānyú fēifǎ qiāngzhī de wèntí, zhèngfǔ juédìng jiāqiáng guǎnzhì.
en: The news reported on the problem of illegal firearms, and the government decided to strengthen regulations.

zh: 我有一只狗。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī zhī gǒu.
en: I have a dog.

zh: 这只狗很可爱，我很喜欢它。
pinyin: Zhè zhī gǒu hěn kě'ài, wǒ hěn xǐhuān tā.
en: This dog is really cute, and I like it a lot.

zh: 因为狗喜欢吃肉，所以我每天给它买骨头。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gǒu xǐhuān chī ròu, suǒyǐ wǒ měi tiān gěi tā mǎi gǔtou.
en: Because dogs like eating meat, I buy bones for mine every day.

zh: 虽然邻居的狗有时候很吵闹，但我们还是和它相处得不错。
pinyin: Suīrán línjū de gǒu yǒushíhou hěn chāonào, dàn wǒmen háishi hé tā xiāngchǔ de búcuò.
en: Although the neighbor's dog can be noisy sometimes, we still get along with it pretty well.

zh: 养狗需要花不少时间和金钱，但能从中获得很多陪伴和快乐。
pinyin: Yǎng gǒu xūyào huā búshǎo shíjiān hé jīnqián, dàn néng cóng zhōng huòdé hěnduō péibàn hé kuàilè.
en: Owning a dog requires quite a bit of time and money, but you gain a lot of companionship and joy from it.

zh: 我喜欢苹果,可是不喜欢香蕉。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān píngguǒ, kěshì búxǐhuān xiāngjiāo.
en: I like apples, but I don't like bananas.

zh: 今天很冷,可是我还要去公园。
pinyin: Jīntiān hěn lěng, kěshì wǒ háiyào qù gōngyuán.
en: It's very cold today, but I still want to go to the park.

zh: 虽然他很忙,可是他每天都陪家人吃饭。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, kěshì tā měitiān dōu péi jiārén chīfàn.
en: Although he's busy, he still eats with his family every day.

zh: 这个工作薪水不错,可是工作时间太长了。
pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò xīnshuǐ búcuò, kěshì gōngzuò shíjiān tài cháng le.
en: The salary for this job is pretty good, but the working hours are too long.

zh: 他考试失败了,可是他没有放弃,反而更努力了。
pinyin: Tā kǎoshì shībài le, kěshì tā méiyǒu fàngqì, fǎn'ér gèng nǔlì le.
en: He failed the exam, but instead of giving up, he worked even harder.

zh: 世界很大。
pinyin: Shìjiè hěn dà.
en: The world is very big.

zh: 我想去世界各地旅游。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù shìjiè gè dì lǚyóu.
en: I want to travel to different places around the world.

zh: 因为世界有很多人，所以我们要互相帮助。
pinyin: Yīnwèi shìjiè yǒu hěnduō rén, suǒyǐ wǒmen yào hùxiāng bāngzhù.
en: Because there are so many people in the world, we need to help each other.

zh: 虽然世界上有很多困难，但是人们一直在寻找解决办法。
pinyin: Suīrán shìjiè shang yǒu hěnduō kunnan, dànshi rénmen yīzhí zài xúnzhǎo jiějué bànfǎ.
en: Although there are many difficulties in the world, people are constantly looking for solutions.

zh: 随着科技发展，世界变得更加紧密，但人与人之间的理解反而更难了。
pinyin: Suízhe kējì fāzhǎn, shìjiè biàn de gèngjiā jǐnmì, dàn rén yǔ rén zhījiān de lǐjiě fǎn'ér gèng nán le.
en: As technology advances, the world becomes more interconnected, yet understanding between people has paradoxically become harder.

zh: 我每天睡八小时。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shuì bā xiǎoshí.
en: I sleep eight hours every day.

zh: 昨天我们玩了三小时的游戏。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen wánle sān xiǎoshí de yóuxì.
en: Yesterday we played games for three hours.

zh: 因为堵车，开车去公司用了两小时。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dǔchē, kāichē qù gōngsī yòngle liǎng xiǎoshí.
en: Because of traffic, it took two hours to drive to the office.

zh: 虽然只有一小时的休息时间，但我还是感觉放松了。
pinyin: Suīrán zhǐyǒu yī xiǎoshí de xiūxi shíjiān, dàn wǒ háishi gǎnjuéle fàngsōngle.
en: Even though I only had an hour to rest, I still felt relaxed.

zh: 会议本应半小时结束，结果拖了三小时才散会。
pinyin: Huìyì běnyīng bàn xiǎoshí jiéshù, jiéguǒ tuōle sān xiǎoshí cái sǎnhuì.
en: The meeting was supposed to end in thirty minutes, but it dragged on for three hours before finally wrapping up.

zh: 健康很重要。
pinyin: Jiànkāng hěn zhòingyào.
en: Health is very important.

zh: 每天睡觉对我们很重要。
pinyin: Měitiān shuìjiào duì wǒmen hěn zhòingyào.
en: Getting sleep every day is really important for us.

zh: 虽然这个工作很难，但是它很重要。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò hěn nán, dànshì tā hěn zhòingyào.
en: Although this job is hard, it's still really important.

zh: 学生在考试前复习是很重要的，因为能帮助他们更好地学习。
pinyin: Xuésheng zài kǎoshì qián fùxí shì hěn zhòingyào de, yīnwèi néng bāngzhù tāmen gènghǎo de xuéxí.
en: It's really important for students to review before exams because it helps them learn better.

zh: 在快速发展的社会里，不仅技能重要，诚实的态度同样不可或缺。
pinyin: Zài kuàisù fāzhǎn de shèhuì lǐ, bújǐn jìnéng zhòingyào, chéngshí de tàidù tóngyàng búkě huòquē.
en: In a rapidly developing society, not only are skills important, but an honest attitude is equally indispensable.

zh: 我们谈天气。
pinyin: Wǒmen tán tiānqì.
en: We're talking about the weather.

zh: 昨天我和朋友谈了工作。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé péngyou tánle gōngzuò.
en: Yesterday I talked with my friend about work.

zh: 虽然他们谈了很久，但是没有解决问题。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen tánle hěnjiǔ, dànshì méiyǒu jiějué wèntí.
en: Although they talked for a long time, they didn't solve the problem.

zh: 经理和员工谈了加薪的事情，双方都很满意。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ hé yuángōng tánle jiāxīn de shìqing, shuāngfāng dōu hěn mǎnyì.
en: The manager and employee discussed the salary increase, and both sides were satisfied.

zh: 两国领导人谈到了贸易合作问题，希望能够达成共识。
pinyin: Liǎng guó lǐngdǎo rén tandào le màoyì hézuò wèntí, xīwàng nénggoù dáchéng gòngshí.
en: The two countries' leaders touched on trade cooperation issues, hoping to reach a consensus.

zh: 我喜欢别人的狗。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān biérén de gǒu.
en: I like other people's dogs.

zh: 别人在吃饭的时候，我在做功课。
pinyin: Biérén zài chīfàn de shíhou, wǒ zài zuò gōngkè.
en: While other people were eating, I was doing my homework.

zh: 虽然别人说很难，但是我觉得这个游戏很有意思。
pinyin: Suīrán biérén shuō hěn nán, danshi wǒ juéde zhège yóuxì hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Although other people say it's really hard, I think this game is very interesting.

zh: 他不喜欢听别人的意见，总是坚持自己的想法。
pinyin: Tā búxǐhuān tīng biérén de yìjiàn, zǒngshi jiānchí zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
en: He doesn't like listening to other people's opinions and always insists on his own ideas.

zh: 别人的成功往往激励我们反思自己的不足。
pinyin: Biérén de chénggōng wǎngwǎng jīlì wǒmen fǎnsī zìjǐ de búzú.
en: Other people's success often inspires us to reflect on our own shortcomings.

zh: 那个男人是我爸爸。
pinyin: Nàge nánrén shì wǒ bàba.
en: That man is my dad.

zh: 昨天我看到一个年轻的男人。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kàndào yīge niánqīng de nánrén.
en: Yesterday I saw a young man.

zh: 虽然那个男人很忙，但是他每天都陪孩子。
pinyin: Suīrán nàge nánrén hěn máng, dànshì tā měitiān dōu péi háizi.
en: Although that man is very busy, he spends time with his children every day.

zh: 这位男人因为工作压力大，所以经常睡眠不足。
pinyin: Zhè wèi nánrén yīnwèi gōngzuò yālì dà, suǒyǐ jīngcháng shuìmián búzú.
en: This man often lacks sleep because of work stress.

zh: 那个男人虽然出身普通，但通过自己的努力成了公司的领导。
pinyin: Nàge nánrén suīrán chūshēn pǔtōng, dàn tōngguò zìjǐ de nǔlì chéngle gōngsī de lǐngdǎo.
en: Though that man came from an ordinary background, he became a company leader through his own hard work.

zh: 我的头疼。
pinyin: Wǒ de tóu téng.
en: My head hurts.

zh: 早上我洗了头，现在很舒服。
pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ xǐle tóu, xiànzài hěn shūfu.
en: I washed my hair this morning, and now I feel much better.

zh: 虽然他今天工作很忙，但是他还是抽时间理了头发。
pinyin: Suīrán tā jīntiān gōngzuò hěn máng, búshì tā háishi chōu shíjiān lǐle tóufa.
en: Even though he was very busy at work today, he still made time to get a haircut.

zh: 因为长时间对着电脑，他经常感觉头晕，所以决定去医院检查。
pinyin: Yīnwèi cháng shíjiān duìzhe diànnǎo, tā jīngcháng gǎnjuéde tóu yūn, suǒyǐ juéding qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
en: Because he spent a lot of time in front of a computer, he often felt dizzy, so he decided to go to the hospital for a checkup.

zh: 这个项目从一开头就困难重重，但团队没有低头认输，最终还是成功了。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù cóng yī kāitóu jiù kùnnan zhòngzhòng, dàn tuánduì méiyǒu dītóu rènshū, zuìzhōng háishi chénggōngle.
en: This project was fraught with difficulties from the very beginning, but the team refused to give up and ultimately succeeded.

zh: 这是一个好机会。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè hǎo jīhuì.
en: This is a good opportunity.

zh: 明天有机会去公园吗？
pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu jīhuì qù gōngyuán ma?
en: Do you have a chance to go to the park tomorrow?

zh: 因为下雨，所以我们没有机会踢球。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen méiyǒu jīhuì tīqiú.
en: Because it rained, we didn't have the chance to play soccer.

zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他还是抓住了这个机会学习新技能。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn tā háishi zhuāzhù le zhège jīhuì xuéxí xīn jìnéng.
en: Although work was busy, he still seized this opportunity to learn new skills.

zh: 与其等待完美的机会，不如抓住眼前的机会去实践。
pinyin: Yǔqī děngdài wánměi de jīhuì, búrú zhuāzhù yǎnqián de jīhuì qù shíjiàn.
en: Rather than waiting for the perfect opportunity, it's better to seize what's in front of you and take action.

zh: 我今年八岁。
pinyin: Wǒ jīnnián bā suì.
en: I'm eight years old this year.

zh: 她的女儿五岁了，很聪明。
pinyin: Tā de nǚ'ér wǔ suì le, hěn cōngming.
en: Her daughter is five now, and she's very smart.

zh: 因为他才六岁，所以不能上学。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā cái liù suì, suǒyǐ búnéng shàngxué.
en: Because he's only six years old, he can't go to school yet.

zh: 虽然我的祖父已经九十岁了，但他身体还很健康。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ de zǔfù yǐjīng jiǔshí suì le, dàn tā shēntǐ háishi hěn jiànkāng.
en: Although my grandfather is already ninety years old, his health is still quite good.

zh: 根据研究，现在的孩子平均在十岁左右才能独立完成复杂任务。
pinyin: Gēnjù yánjiū, xiànzài de háizi píng均 zài shí suì zuǒyòu cáinéng dúlì wánchéng fùzá rènwu.
en: According to research, children these days can typically complete complex tasks independently only around age ten.

zh: 我要出去玩。
pinyin: Wǒ yào chūqù wán.
en: I want to go out and play.

zh: 明天天气好，我们一起出去走走。
pinyin: Míngtiān tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen yīqǐ chūqù zǒuzou.
en: The weather will be nice tomorrow, so let's go out for a walk together.

zh: 虽然下雨了，但是我还是想出去买东西。
pinyin: Suīrán xiàyǔ le, dànshi wǒ háishi xiǎng chūqù mǎi dōngxi.
en: Even though it's raining, I still want to go out and do some shopping.

zh: 因为工作太累，他决定周末出去放松一下。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài lèi, tā juéding zhōumò chūqù fàngsōng yīxià.
en: Because work has been exhausting, he decided to go out and relax over the weekend.

zh: 与其整天呆在家里玩手机，不如出去呼吸新鲜空气。
pinyin: Yǔqī zhěngtiān dāi zài jiālǐ wán shǒujī, búrú chūqù hūxī xīnxiān kōngqì.
en: Rather than sitting at home all day on your phone, you'd be better off going outside to breathe some fresh air.

zh: 我们要活着。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào huózhe.
en: We need to stay alive.

zh: 他每天都活得很开心。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu huó de hěn kāixīn.
en: He lives happily every single day.

zh: 虽然工作很累，但是我活得充实。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ huó de chōngshí.
en: Although work is tiring, I live a fulfilling life.

zh: 在大城市活了五年后，他开始想回家乡。
pinyin: Zài dà chéngshì huó le wǔ nián hòu, tā kāishǐ xiǎng huí jiāxiāng.
en: After living in the big city for five years, he began wanting to go back to his hometown.

zh: 只有真正热爱生活的人，才能活出自己的精彩。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zhēnzhèng règài shēnghuó de rén, cáinéng huó chū zìjǐ de jīngcǎi.
en: Only people who truly love life can live out their own brilliance.

zh: 我看见一只猫。
pinyin: Wǒ kànjìan yī zhī māo.
en: I see a cat.

zh: 昨天我看见了我的朋友在公园。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kànjìanle wǒ de péngyou zài gōngyuán.
en: Yesterday I saw my friend in the park.

zh: 我走出来的时候，看见他正在吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zǒuchūlái de shíhou, kànjìan tā zhèngzài chīfàn.
en: When I came out, I saw him eating dinner.

zh: 虽然天很黑，但我还是看见了远处的灯光。
pinyin: Suīrán tiān hěn hēi, dànshì wǒ háishi kànjìanle yuǎnchù de děngguāng.
en: Even though it was very dark, I still managed to see the distant lights.

zh: 他上次看见你的样子，现在还记得很清楚。
pinyin: Tā shàng cì kànjìan nǐ de yàngzi, xiànzài háishi jìde hěn qīngchu.
en: He still remembers clearly what you looked like the last time he saw you.

zh: 老师是教书的人。
pinyin: Lǎoshī shì jiāoshū de rén.
en: A teacher is someone who teaches.

zh: 吃饭的时候，我看到了一个陌生人。
pinyin: Chīfàn de shíhou, wǒ kàndàole yīge mòshēngrén.
en: While I was eating, I saw a stranger.

zh: 虽然他是新来的员工，但是他工作很认真。
pinyin: Suīrán tā shì xīnlái de yuángōng, dànshì tā gōngzuò hěn rènzhēn.
en: Although he's a new employee, he works very seriously.

zh: 那些喜欢运动的年轻人经常在公园里锻炼身体。
pinyin: Nàxiē xǐhuān yùndòng de niánqīngnián jīngcháng zài gōngyuán lǐ duànliàn shēntǐ.
en: Young people who enjoy sports often exercise in the park.

zh: 成功的创业者往往需要具备眼光、耐心和适应变化的能力。
pinyin: Chénggōng de chuàngyè zhě wǎngwǎng xūyào jùbèi yǎnguāng, nàixīn hé shìyìng biànhuà de néngglì.
en: Successful entrepreneurs typically need to have vision, patience, and the ability to adapt to change.

zh: 我打电话给妈妈。
pinyin: Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi māma.
en: I'm calling my mom.

zh: 昨天我打电话给朋友了。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi péngyou le.
en: I called my friend yesterday.

zh: 因为他没有回信息，所以我打电话给他。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā méiyǒu huíxìn xī, suǒyǐ wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi tā.
en: Because he didn't reply to my message, I called him.

zh: 会议开始前，我需要打电话确认一下参加人数。
pinyin: Huìyì kāishǐ qián, wǒ xūyào dǎ diànhuà quèrèn yīxià cānjiā rénshù.
en: Before the meeting starts, I need to call and confirm how many people are attending.

zh: 与其一直发消息互相误解，不如直接打电话沟通比较清楚。
pinyin: Yǔqī yīzhí fā xiāoxi hùxiāng wùjiěe, búrú zhíjiē dǎ diànhuà gōutōng bǐjiào qīngchu.
en: Rather than keep messaging and misunderstanding each other, it's clearer to just call and talk directly.

zh: 喂，你好！
pinyin: Wèi, nǐ hǎo!
en: Hello! (answering a call or greeting someone)

zh: 喂，早上好，你吃饭了吗？
pinyin: Wèi, zǎoshang hǎo, nǐ chīfàn le ma?
en: Hi there! Good morning—have you had breakfast yet?

zh: 我在喂狗的时候，它很开心地吃东西。
pinyin: Wǒ zài wèi gǒu de shíhou, tā hěn kāixīn de chī dōngxi.
en: When I was feeding the dog, it ate happily.

zh: 喂，你听得清楚吗？电话信号好像不太好。
pinyin: Wèi, nǐ tīng de qīngchu ma? Diànhuà xìnhào háoxiàng búhuì tài hǎo.
en: Hello? Can you hear me clearly? The phone signal seems a bit weak.

zh: 我每天喂养这些流浪猫，虽然很费时间，但看到它们健康就值得。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān wèiyǎng zhèixiē liúlàng māo, suīrán hěn fèi shíjiān, dàn kàndào tāmen jiànkāng jiù zhídé.
en: I feed these stray cats every day. It takes a lot of time, but seeing them healthy makes it worthwhile.

zh: 他好像很高兴。
pinyin: Tā hǎoxiàng hěn gāoxìng.
en: He seems really happy.

zh: 昨天他好像没有来上课。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā hǎoxiàng méiyǒu lái shàngkè.
en: Yesterday it looks like he didn't come to class.

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但他好像一点都不怕。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dàn tā hǎoxiàng yīdiǎn dōu búpà.
en: Even though the weather is really cold, he doesn't seem scared at all.

zh: 她最近好像在准备找新工作的事情。
pinyin: Tā zuìjìn hǎoxiàng zài zhǔnbèi zhǎo xīn gōngzuò de shìqing.
en: Recently she seems to be preparing to look for a new job.

zh: 这个项目好像遇到了一些困难，但团队还是在坚持推进。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù hǎoxiàng yùdàole yīxiē kùnnan, dàn tuánduì háishi zài jiānchí tuījìn.
en: This project seems to have run into some difficulties, but the team is still pushing ahead with it.

zh: 我得到了一个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ dédào le yī ge píngguǒ.
en: I got an apple.

zh: 昨天我在学校得到了一份礼物。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài xuéxiào dédào le yī fèn lǐwù.
en: Yesterday I received a gift at school.

zh: 因为他很努力,所以得到了老师的表扬。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ dédào le lǎoshī de biǎoyáng.
en: Because he worked hard, he got praise from his teacher.

zh: 虽然考试很难,但是班里有几个学生得到了满分。
pinyin: Suīrán kǎoshì hěn nán, dànshì bānlǐ yǒu jǐ ge xuésheng dédào le mǎnfēn.
en: Although the exam was difficult, a few students in the class got perfect scores.

zh: 经过多年的坚持和投资,他们终于得到了市场的认可和信任。
pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de jiānchí hé tóuzī, tāmen zhōngyú dédào le shìchǎng de rènkě hé xìnrèn.
en: After years of persistence and investment, they finally earned the market's recognition and trust.

zh: 警察在那里。
pinyin: Jǐngchá zài nàlǐ.
en: The police officer is over there.

zh: 昨天我看到了一个警察。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kàndàole yīgè jǐngchá.
en: I saw a police officer yesterday.

zh: 因为发生了事故，所以警察来了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fāshēngle shìgù, suǒyǐ jǐngchá láile.
en: Because there was an accident, the police came.

zh: 那个警察虽然很忙，但还是帮助了我们。
pinyin: Nàge jǐngchá suīrán hěn máng, dàn háishi bāngzhùle wǒmen.
en: Although the officer was very busy, he still helped us.

zh: 如果你遇到紧急情况，可以立刻拨打电话找警察。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yùdào jǐnjí qíngkuàng, kěyǐ lìkè bōdǎ diànhuà zhǎo jǐngchá.
en: If you encounter an emergency, you can immediately call the police right away.

zh: 我吃完了。
pinyin: Wǒ chīwán le.
en: I'm done eating.

zh: 他今天下午完成了作业。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān xiàwǔ wánchéngle zuòyè.
en: He finished his homework this afternoon.

zh: 虽然很累，但是我还是完成了这个项目。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ háishi wánchéngle zhège xiàngmù.
en: Even though I was exhausted, I still managed to complete the project.

zh: 因为准备不够充分，会议没有完全按计划进行。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhǔnbèi búguò chōngfèn, huìyì méiyǒu wánquán àn jìhuà jìnxíng.
en: Because the preparation wasn't thorough enough, the meeting didn't go completely as planned.

zh: 这部电影虽然情节复杂，但导演把故事讲得完整又引人入胜。
pinyin: Zhè búdiànyǐng suīrán qíngjié fùzá, dàn dǎoyǎn bǎ gùshì jiǎngde wánzhěng yòu yǐnrénrùshèng.
en: Although the film has a complex plot, the director tells the story in a complete and gripping way.

zh: 这张桌子很大。
pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi hěn dà.
en: This table is very big.

zh: 我昨天买了一张新床。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān mǎile yī zhāng xīn chuáng.
en: I bought a new bed yesterday.

zh: 因为房间太小，所以我们只能放一张沙发。
pinyin: Yīnwèi fángjiān tài xiǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen zhǐnéng fàng yī zhāng shāfā.
en: Because the room is too small, we can only fit one sofa.

zh: 那张照片虽然很旧，但是对我有很重要的意义。
pinyin: Nà zhāng zhàopiàn suīrán hěn jiù, dànshi duì wǒ yǒu hěn zhòngyào de yìyì.
en: Although that photo is quite old, it holds deep meaning for me.

zh: 他每次见到这张画就会想起大学时代的美好回忆。
pinyin: Tā měi cì jiàndào zhè zhāng huà jiù huì xiǎngqǐ dàxué shídài de měihǎo huíyì.
en: Whenever he sees this painting, he's reminded of the wonderful memories from his university days.

zh: 这是我的儿子。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de érzi.
en: This is my son.

zh: 我的儿子今年八岁了。
pinyin: Wǒ de érzi jīnnián bā suì le.
en: My son is eight years old this year.

zh: 因为儿子喜欢画画，所以我给他买了笔和纸。
pinyin: Yīnwèi érzi xǐhuān huàhuà, suǒyǐ wǒ gěi tā mǎi le bǐ hé zhǐ.
en: Because my son likes to draw, I bought him pens and paper.

zh: 我儿子虽然学习成绩不错，但是特别害羞，不喜欢在陌生人面前说话。
pinyin: Wǒ érzi suīrán xuéxí chéngjì búcuò, dànshì tèbié hàixiū, búxǐhuān zài mòshēngrén miànqián shuōhuà.
en: Although my son's grades are decent, he's quite shy and doesn't like speaking in front of strangers.

zh: 我儿子最近对编程很感兴趣，已经自学了好几个月，我们都为他的自律和坚持感到骄傲。
pinyin: Wǒ érzi zuìjìn duì biānchéng hěn gǎn xìngqù, yǐjīng zìxué le hǎo jǐ ge yuè, wǒmen dōu wèi tā de zìlǜ hé jiānchí gǎndào jiāoào.
en: My son has recently become really interested in programming and has been teaching himself for several months now—we're all proud of his self-discipline and persistence.

zh: 吃饭之后，我睡觉。
pinyin: Chīfàn zhīhòu, wǒ shuìjiào.
en: After eating, I sleep.

zh: 上完课之后，学生们都去玩了。
pinyin: Shàng wán kè zhīhòu, xuéshengmen dōu qù wán le.
en: After class finished, all the students went to play.

zh: 虽然很累，但是工作之后我还是去健身房了。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì gōngzuò zhīhòu wǒ háishi qù jiànshēnfáng le.
en: Even though I was tired, I still went to the gym after work.

zh: 他们结婚之后，就搬到了一个新的城市住。
pinyin: Tāmen jiéhūn zhīhòu, jiù bān到le yī ge xīn de chéngshì zhù.
en: After they got married, they moved to a new city to live.

zh: 经过多次沟通之后，我们终于达成了共识。
pinyin: Jīngguò duō cì gōutōng zhīhòu, wǒmen zhōngyú dáchéngle gòngshí.
en: After multiple rounds of discussion, we finally reached a consensus.

zh: 她的裙子很漂亮。
pinyin: Tā de qún zi hěn piào liang.
en: Her skirt is very pretty.

zh: 今天天气很好，花园很漂亮。
pinyin: Jīn tiān tiān qì hěn hǎo, huā yuán hěn piào liang.
en: The weather is nice today, and the garden looks beautiful.

zh: 虽然这件衣服贵，但是真的很漂亮，所以我买了。
pinyin: Suī rán zhè jiàn yī fu guì, dàn shi zhēn de hěn piào liang, suǒ yǐ wǒ mǎi le.
en: Even though this outfit is expensive, it's really pretty, so I bought it.

zh: 这次展览展出了很多漂亮的摄影作品，吸引了不少游客。
pinyin: Zhè cì zhǎn lǎn zhǎn chū le hěn duō piào liang de shè yǐng zuò pǐn, xī yǐn le bu shǎo yóu kè.
en: This exhibition featured many beautiful photographs that attracted quite a few visitors.

zh: 她不仅把房间布置得漂亮，而且每个细节都处理得非常用心。
pinyin: Tā bu jǐn bǎ fáng jiān bu zhì de piào liang, ér qiě měi ge xì jié dōu chǔ lǐ de fēi cháng yòng xīn.
en: She not only decorated the room beautifully, but also paid careful attention to every detail.

zh: 等我五分钟。
pinyin: Děng wǒ wǔ fēnzhōng.
en: Wait for me five minutes.

zh: 他每天早上跑十分钟步。
pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang pǎo shí fēnzhōng bù.
en: He runs for ten minutes every morning.

zh: 虽然只有三分钟,但我学到了很多。
pinyin: Suīrán zhǐyǒu sān fēnzhōng, dàn wǒ xuédàole hěnduō.
en: Although it was only three minutes, I learned a lot.

zh: 这个视频长二十分钟,我边看边做笔记。
pinyin: Zhège shìpín cháng èrshí fēnzhōng, wǒ biān kàn biān zuò bǐjì.
en: This video is twenty minutes long, and I take notes while watching.

zh: 只要坚持每天锻炼三十分钟,长期来看效果还是不错的。
pinyin: Zhǐyào jiānchí měitiān duànliàn sānshí fēnzhōng, chángqī láikàn xiàoguǒ háishi búcuò de.
en: As long as you stick to exercising thirty minutes daily, the long-term results are actually pretty good.

zh: 我去接你。
pinyin: Wǒ qù jiē nǐ.
en: I'll pick you up.

zh: 明天下午我要去机场接朋友。
pinyin: Míngtiān xiàwǔ wǒ yào qù jīchǎng jiē péngyou.
en: Tomorrow afternoon I need to go to the airport to pick up a friend.

zh: 虽然很累，但是我还是要接孩子放学。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ háishi yào jiē háizi fàngxué.
en: Even though I'm tired, I still have to pick up my child from school.

zh: 他接了个重要的工作任务，压力特别大。
pinyin: Tā jiēle ge zhòngyào de gōngzuò rènwu, yālì tèbié dà.
en: He took on an important work assignment, and the pressure is really intense.

zh: 公司接到了一个大订单，这为接下来的发展奠定了基础。
pinyin: Gōngsī jiēdàole le ge dà dìngdān, zhè wèi jiēxiàlái de fāzhǎn diàndìngle jīchǔ.
en: The company received a major order, which laid the groundwork for future development.

zh: 我们在公园里玩。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài gōngyuán lǐ wán.
en: We're playing in the park.

zh: 昨天我去了足球场看比赛。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ qùle zúqiúchǎng kàn bǐsài.
en: Yesterday I went to the football field to watch a match.

zh: 因为今天下雨，所以篮球场的比赛被取消了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīntiān xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ lánqiúchǎng de bǐsài bèi qǔxiāo le.
en: Because it rained today, the basketball court match got cancelled.

zh: 他虽然害怕在舞台场上表演，但还是勇敢地站了出来。
pinyin: Tā suīrán hàipà zài wǔtái chǎng shang biǎoyǎn, dàn háishi yǒngǎn de zhàn le chūlai.
en: Although he was nervous about performing on stage, he still bravely came forward.

zh: 这场商务谈判涉及多个行业，参与者需要具备丰富的市场经验。
pinyin: Zhè chǎng shāngwù tánpàn shèjí duō ge hángyè, cānyùzhě xūyào jùbèi fēngfù de shìchǎng jīngyàn.
en: This business negotiation involves multiple industries, and participants need to have extensive market experience.

zh: 再见！
pinyin: Zàijiàn!
en: Goodbye!

zh: 明天见面，现在再见。
pinyin: Míngtiān jiànmiàn, xiànzài zàijiàn.
en: See you tomorrow — goodbye for now.

zh: 因为我要去上班，所以先再见了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ yào qù shàngbān, suǒyǐ xiān zàijiàn le.
en: I have to go to work now, so I'll say goodbye.

zh: 虽然今天很开心，但我该走了，再见！
pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān hěn kāixīn, dàn wǒ gāi zǒu le, zàijiàn!
en: Even though we had a great time today, I really need to leave now — see you later!

zh: 这次聊天挺愉快的，希望下次能继续，再见！
pinyin: Zhè cì liáotiān tǐng yúkuài de, xīwàng xiàcì néng jìxù, zàijiàn!
en: This has been a really pleasant chat, and I hope we can pick it up again next time — take care!

zh: 我求你帮我。
pinyin: Wǒ qiú nǐ bāng wǒ.
en: I'm asking you to help me.

zh: 他每天都求妈妈买玩具。
pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu qiú māma mǎi wánjù.
en: He asks his mom to buy him toys every day.

zh: 虽然我求了很多次，但他还是不同意。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ qiúle hěn duō cì, dàn tā háishi búyì.
en: Even though I asked him many times, he still wouldn't agree.

zh: 他因为急需钱，所以向银行求贷款。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi jíxū qián, suǒyǐ xiàng yínháng qiú dàikuǎn.
en: Because he needed money urgently, he applied to the bank for a loan.

zh: 在竞争激烈的市场中，许多企业都在求创新以保持竞争力。
pinyin: Zài jìngzhēng jīliè de shìchǎng zhōng, xǔduō qǐyè dōu zài qiú chuàngxīn yǐ bǎochí jìngzhēnglì.
en: In a fiercely competitive market, many companies are pursuing innovation to maintain their competitive edge.

zh: 我刚吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ gāng chīfàn.
en: I just ate.

zh: 他刚从学校回来。
pinyin: Tā gāng cóng xuéxiào huílái.
en: He just got back from school.

zh: 虽然我刚到这里，但是我已经很喜欢这个城市。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ gāng dào zhèlǐ, dànshì wǒ yǐjīng hěn xǐhuān zhège chéngshì.
en: Even though I just arrived here, I already really like this city.

zh: 他刚开始学中文的时候，发音有点困难。
pinyin: Tā gāng kāishǐ xué zhōngwén de shíhou, fāyīn yǒudiǎn kùnnan.
en: When he first started learning Chinese, pronunciation was a bit challenging for him.

zh: 我们刚才的讨论对项目很有帮助，可以节省不少时间。
pinyin: Wǒmen gāngcái de tǎolùn duì xiàngmù hěn yǒu bāngzhù, kěyǐ jiéshěng búshǎo shíjiān.
en: The discussion we just had was really helpful for the project and can save us considerable time.

zh: 你如何吃饭？
pinyin: Nǐ rúhé chīfàn?
en: How do you eat your meal?

zh: 明天你如何去学校？
pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ rúhé qù xuéxiào?
en: How will you get to school tomorrow?

zh: 因为下雨，所以如何去公园比较好？
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ rúhé qù gōngyuán bǐjiào hǎo?
en: Since it's raining, what would be a better way to get to the park?

zh: 你觉得如何解决这个问题最有效？
pinyin: Nǐ juéde rúhé jiějué zhège wèntí zuì yǒuxiào?
en: What do you think is the most effective way to solve this problem?

zh: 在压力这么大的情况下，他仍然能坚持下去，真是令人佩服，你觉得他如何做到的？
pinyin: Zài yālì zhème dà de qíngkuàng xià, tā réngránéng jiānchí xiàqù, zhēnshi lìngrén pèifú, nǐ juéde tā rúhé zuòdào de?
en: Under such enormous pressure, he still manages to keep going—it's really admirable. How do you think he pulls it off?

zh: 我们明天有比赛。
pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān yǒu bǐsài.
en: We have a competition tomorrow.

zh: 他在学校的足球比赛中赢了。
pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào de zúqiú bǐsài zhōng yíngle.
en: He won in the school's soccer match.

zh: 虽然比赛很难，但是我们都尽力了。
pinyin: Suīrán bǐsài hěn nán, dànshì wǒmen dōu jìnlì le.
en: Although the competition was difficult, we all did our best.

zh: 参加这个比赛需要提前注册，因为人数有限制。
pinyin: Cānjiā zhège bǐsài xūyào tíqián zhùcè, yīnwèi rénshù yǒu xiànzhì.
en: You need to register early for this competition because there's a limit on participants.

zh: 他为了准备这场重要的比赛，每天都坚持训练了三个月。
pinyin: Tā wèile zhǔnbèi zhè chǎng zhòngyào de bǐsài, měitiān dōu jiānchí xùnliàn le sān ge yuè.
en: To prepare for this important competition, he stuck with daily training for three months straight.

zh: 这是苹果呀！
pinyin: Zhè shì píngguǒ ya!
en: This is an apple!

zh: 你昨天没来上课呀？
pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān méi lái shàngkè ya?
en: You didn't come to class yesterday, did you?

zh: 虽然天气很冷，但是我们还是去公园呀。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì wǒmen háishi qù gōngyuán ya.
en: Even though the weather is cold, we still went to the park anyway.

zh: 你要是再这样下去，肯定会后悔呀。
pinyin: Nǐ yàoshi zài zhèyàng xiàqù, kěndìng huì huǐhuǐ ya.
en: If you keep going like this, you'll definitely regret it.

zh: 现在房价这么贵，年轻人买房真的很困难呀。
pinyin: Xiànzài fángjià zhème guì, niánqīngrén mǎifáng zhēnde hěn kùnnan ya.
en: With house prices so high these days, it's really tough for young people to buy homes.

zh: 现在情况怎么样？
pinyin: Xiànzài qíngkuàng zěnyàng?
en: How are things right now?

zh: 昨天的天气情况很好。
pinyin: Zuótiān de tiānqì qíngkuàng hěn hǎo.
en: The weather situation yesterday was really nice.

zh: 因为疫情，公司的情况变得很困难。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yìqíng, gōngsī de qíngkuàng biàn de hěn kùnnan.
en: Because of the pandemic, the company's situation became quite difficult.

zh: 他了解当地的情况，所以能快速解决问题。
pinyin: Tā liǎojiě dāngdì de qíngkuàng, suǒyǐ néng kuàisù jiějué wèntí.
en: Since he understood the local situation well, he was able to solve the problem quickly.

zh: 根据最近的市场情况来看，我们需要调整销售策略。
pinyin: Gēnjù zuìjìn de shìchǎng qíngkuàng lái kàn, wǒmen xūyào tiáozhěng xiāoshòu cèlüè.
en: Based on the current market conditions, we need to adjust our sales strategy.

zh: 天气变冷了。
pinyin: Tiānqì biàn lěng le.
en: The weather has gotten cold.

zh: 他的头发变黑了，看起来很不一样。
pinyin: Tā de tóufa biàn hēi le, kàn qǐlái hěn búyīyàng.
en: His hair turned black, and he looks completely different.

zh: 虽然才过了一年，但城市变得很拥挤，因为很多人搬来了。
pinyin: Suīrán cái guòle yī nián, dàn chéngshì biàn de hěn yōngjǐ, yīnwèi hěnduō rén bānlái le.
en: Although only a year has passed, the city has become quite crowded because many people have moved here.

zh: 自从她开始锻炼以后，身体变得更强壮，精神也好多了。
pinyin: Zìcóng tā kāishǐ duànliàn yǐhòu, shēntǐ biàn de gèng qiángzhuàng, jīngshén yě hǎo duō le.
en: Ever since she started exercising, her body has become stronger and her energy has improved a lot.

zh: 随着科技发展，人们的生活方式和思想观念都在不断变化，有好有坏。
pinyin: Suízhe kējì fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó fāngshì hé sīxiǎng guānniàn dōu zài búduàn biànhuà, yǒu hǎo yǒu huài.
en: As technology develops, people's lifestyles and values are constantly changing—for better and for worse.

zh: 我和朋友的关系很好。
pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou de guānxi hěn hǎo.
en: My relationship with my friend is very good.

zh: 你和老师的关系怎么样？
pinyin: Nǐ hé lǎoshī de guānxi zěnyàng?
en: How is your relationship with your teacher?

zh: 因为经常一起学习，所以我们的关系变得很亲密。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīngcháng yìqǐ xuéxí, suǒyǐ wǒmen de guānxi biàn de hěn qīnmì.
en: Because we study together often, our relationship has become very close.

zh: 工作和生活的关系平衡对每个人都很重要。
pinyin: Gōngzuò hé shēnghuó de guānxi pínghuà衡 duì měi gè rén dōu hěn zhòngyào.
en: Balancing the relationship between work and life is important for everyone.

zh: 虽然他们在商业上有竞争，但个人关系依然保持得不错。
pinyin: Suīrán tāmen zài shāngyè shang yǒu jìngjìng, dàn gèrén guānxi yīrán bǎochí de búcuò.
en: Although they compete in business, they've managed to keep their personal relationship in good shape.

zh: 这个苹果真是好吃！
pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ zhēnshi hǎochī!
en: This apple is really delicious!

zh: 今天天气真是太冷了。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì zhēnshi tài lěng le.
en: The weather today is really so cold.

zh: 虽然很累，但是他真是坚持完成了工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshi tā zhēnshi jiānchí wánchéng le gōngzuò.
en: Although he was tired, he really did manage to finish the work.

zh: 这家餐厅的菜真是物美价廉，难怪生意那么好。
pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài zhēnshi wù měi jià lián, nánguài shēngyì nàme hǎo.
en: The dishes at this restaurant are really good quality for the price—no wonder the business is so good.

zh: 他的演讲真是深入浅出，连不懂这个领域的人都听得很投入。
pinyin: Tā de yǎnjiǎng zhēnshi shēnrù-qiǎnchū, lián búdǒng zhège lǐngyù de rén dōu tīng de hěn tóurù.
en: His presentation really did explain complex ideas simply—even people unfamiliar with the field were fully engaged.

zh: 那位女士是我妈妈。
pinyin: Nà wèi nǚshì shì wǒ māmа.
en: That woman is my mom.

zh: 这位女士今天穿了一件红色的衣服。
pinyin: Zhè wèi nǚshì jīntiān chuānle yī jiàn hóngsè de yīfu.
en: This lady wore a red dress today.

zh: 因为那位女士很忙，所以她没有来参加会议。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nà wèi nǚshì hěn máng, suǒyǐ tā méiyǒu lái cānjiā huìyì.
en: Because that woman was very busy, she didn't come to the meeting.

zh: 虽然这位女士第一次来，但她很快就适应了办公室的环境。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè wèi nǚshì dì yī cì lái, dàn tā hěn kuài jiù shìyìngle bàngōngshì de huánjìng.
en: Although this woman came for the first time, she adapted to the office environment quite quickly.

zh: 那位女士凭借自己的专业知识和耐心，成功地说服了客户签署合同。
pinyin: Nà wèi nǚshì píngjiè zìjǐ de zhuānyè zhīshi hé nàixīn, chéngōng de shuōfúle kèhù qiānshǔ hétonɡ.
en: That woman successfully persuaded the client to sign the contract by drawing on her professional expertise and patience.

zh: 这是我的本子。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de běnzi.
en: This is my notebook.

zh: 我每天都在本子上写日记。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu zài běnzi shang xiě rìjì.
en: I write in my notebook every day.

zh: 因为这本书很有意思，所以我读得很快。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè běn shū hěn yǒu yìsi, suǒyǐ wǒ dú de hěn kuài.
en: Because this book is really interesting, I read it very quickly.

zh: 虽然这本词典很贵，但是我觉得很值得买。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè běn cídiǎn hěn guì, dànshi wǒ juéde hěn zhíde mǎi.
en: Even though this dictionary is expensive, I think it's worth buying.

zh: 这本杂志的编辑很专业，每期的内容都能反映社会的最新动态。
pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì de biānjí hěn zhuānyè, měi qī de nèiróng dōu néng fǎnyìng shèhuì de zuìxīn dòngtài.
en: The editors of this magazine are really professional, and every issue covers the latest social trends.

zh: 我马上吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ mǎshàng chīfàn.
en: I'm eating right now.

zh: 妈妈说马上就回家了。
pinyin: Māma shuō mǎshàng jiù huíjiā le.
en: Mom says she'll be home in a moment.

zh: 因为很晚了，所以他马上去睡觉。
pinyin: Yīnwèi hěn wǎn le, suǒyǐ tā mǎshàng qù shuìjiào.
en: Because it's late, he's going to bed right away.

zh: 虽然现在很忙，但我马上就能帮你处理这个问题。
pinyin: Suīrán xiànzài hěn máng, dàn wǒ mǎshàng jiù néng bāng nǐ chǔlǐ zhège wèntí.
en: Even though I'm busy right now, I can handle that issue for you straightaway.

zh: 这份报告得马上交给主管，不能有任何延误。
pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào děi mǎshàng jiāo gěi zhǔguǎn, búnéng yǒu rènhé yánwù.
en: This report needs to go to the manager immediately—there's no room for delay.

zh: 我决定吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ juédìng chī mǐfàn.
en: I've decided to eat rice.

zh: 明天我决定去公园玩。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ juédìng qù gōngyuán wán.
en: Tomorrow I'm going to decide to go play in the park.

zh: 因为天气很好，我们决定在外面吃饭。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen juédìng zài wàimiàn chīfàn.
en: Because the weather is nice, we've decided to eat outside.

zh: 虽然有点贵，但是他还是决定买这件衣服。
pinyin: Suīrán yǒudiǎn guì, dànshì tā háishi juédìng mǎi zhè jiàn yīfu.
en: Although it's a bit expensive, he decided to buy the shirt anyway.

zh: 经过长时间的考虑，公司最终决定了新的发展方向。
pinyin: Jīngguò cháng shíjiān de kǎolǜ, gōngsī zuìzh終 juédìngle xīn de fāzhǎn fāngxiàng.
en: After careful consideration over a long period, the company ultimately made a decision about its new direction for growth.

zh: 我见到妈妈了。
pinyin: Wǒ jiàndào māma le.
en: I saw my mom.

zh: 昨天我在公园见到了一只大狗。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài gōngyuán jiàndàole yī zhī dà gǒu.
en: Yesterday I saw a big dog at the park.

zh: 虽然我们很久没见面，但是今天终于见到你了。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen hěnjiǔ méi jiànmiàn, dànshì jīntiān zhōngyú jiàndào nǐ le.
en: Although we haven't seen each other for a long time, I finally got to see you today.

zh: 自从他搬到新城市以后，我就没有见到过他。
pinyin: Zìcóng tā bānidào xīn chéngshì yǐhòu, wǒ jiù méiyǒu jiàndàoguò tā.
en: Since he moved to the new city, I haven't seen him once.

zh: 那次会议上见到的业务代表给我留下了很深的印象。
pinyin: Nà cì huìyì shang jiàndào de yèwù dàibiǎo gěi wǒ liúxiàle hěn shēn de yìnxiàng.
en: The business representative I met at that conference made a really strong impression on me.

zh: 我根本不喜欢吃鱼。
pinyin: Wǒ gēnběn búxǐhuān chī yú.
en: I don't like eating fish at all.

zh: 他根本没有来上课。
pinyin: Tā gēnběn méiyǒu lái shàngkè.
en: He didn't come to class at all.

zh: 因为没有钱，他根本买不起房子。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu qián, tā gēnběn mǎi búqǐ fángzi.
en: Because he has no money, he simply can't afford to buy a house.

zh: 虽然他很聪明，但根本的问题是不够努力。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, dàn gēnběn de wèntí shì búgòu nǔlì.
en: Although he's smart, the fundamental issue is that he doesn't work hard enough.

zh: 这个方案根本解决不了我们现在面临的核心矛盾。
pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn gēnběn jiějuébuliǎo wǒmen xiànzài miànlín de héxxīn máodùn.
en: This approach simply won't resolve the core contradiction we're facing right now.

zh: 关于吃饭的问题。
pinyin: Guānyú chīfàn de wèntí.
en: A question about eating.

zh: 妈妈告诉我关于学校的事情。
pinyin: Māma gàosu wǒ guānyú xuéxiào de shìqing.
en: Mom told me about school stuff.

zh: 因为下雨，关于明天旅行的计划改变了。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, guānyú míngtiān lǚxíng de jìhuà gǎibiàn le.
en: Because it rained, the plan about tomorrow's trip changed.

zh: 公司发送了关于新员工培训的重要通知。
pinyin: Gōngsī fāsòng le guānyú xīn yuángōng péixùn de zhòngyào tōngzhī.
en: The company sent an important notice regarding new employee training.

zh: 关于这个项目的预算问题，我们需要和财务部门进一步沟通。
pinyin: Guānyú zhège xiàngmù de yùsuàn wèntí, wǒmen xūyào hé càiwù bùmén jìnyībù gōutōng.
en: As for the budget issues with this project, we need to communicate further with the finance department.

zh: 我的书在那儿。
pinyin: Wǒ de shū zài nàr.
en: My book is over there.

zh: 昨天我在那儿吃了好吃的饭。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài nàr chīle hǎochī de fàn.
en: Yesterday I had a delicious meal over there.

zh: 因为那儿离我家很近，所以我经常去那儿。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nàr lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn, suǒyǐ wǒ jīngcháng qù nàr.
en: Because that place is very close to my home, I often go there.

zh: 虽然那儿的东西比较贵，但很多人还是喜欢在那儿买。
pinyin: Suīrán nàr de dōngxi bǐjiào guì, dàn hěnduō rén háishi xǐhuān zài nàr mǎi.
en: Although things are rather expensive there, plenty of people still prefer to shop at that place.

zh: 据说那儿的服务态度一直不错，我们下次有机会也想去体验一下。
pinyin: Jùshuō nàr de fúwù tàidù yīzhí búcuò, wǒmen xiàcì yǒu jīhuì yě xiǎng qù tǐyàn yīxià.
en: I heard the service there has always been pretty good, so we'd like to experience it ourselves next time we get the chance.

zh: 这道题很难。
pinyin: Zhè dào tí hěn nán.
en: This question is very difficult.

zh: 昨天的考试有点难,我没考好。
pinyin: Zuótiān de kǎoshì yǒudiǎn nán, wǒ méi kǎo hǎo.
en: Yesterday's exam was a bit hard, and I didn't do well.

zh: 虽然这个工作很难,但是我想试试看。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò hěn nán, dànshì wǒ xiǎng shìshi kàn.
en: Even though this job is difficult, I'd like to give it a try.

zh: 因为语言不同,两个国家的交流有点难。
pinyin: Yīnwèi yǔyán búdòng, liǎng ge guójiā de jiāoliú yǒudiǎn nán.
en: Because of the language difference, communication between the two countries is somewhat difficult.

zh: 他虽然基础不好,但凭着努力克服了很多难题。
pinyin: Tā suīrán jīchǔ búhǎo, dàn píngzháo nǔlì kèkèfúle hěnduō nántí.
en: Although his foundation was weak, through hard work he managed to overcome many difficult problems.

zh: 只要你吃饭，我就高兴。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ chīfàn, wǒ jiù gāoxìng.
en: As long as you eat, I'm happy.

zh: 只要天气好，我们就去公园玩。
pinyin: Zhǐyào tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen jiù qù gōngyuán wán.
en: Whenever the weather is nice, we go play in the park.

zh: 虽然这个工作很难，但只要你努力，就能成功。
pinyin: Suīrán zhège gōngzuò hěn nán, dàn zhǐyào nǐ nǔlì, jiù néng chénggōng.
en: Although this job is tough, as long as you work hard, you can succeed.

zh: 只要你坚持学习汉语，不管多久，一定会进步。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí xuéxí Hànyǔ, búguǎn duōjiǔ, yīdìng huì jìnbù.
en: As long as you keep studying Chinese, no matter how long it takes, you'll definitely improve.

zh: 只要有机会和资源，年轻人就能实现自己的梦想。
pinyin: Zhǐyào yǒu jīhuì hé zīyuán, niánqīngrén jiù néng shíxiàn zìjǐ de梦xiǎng.
en: Given the right opportunities and resources, young people can fulfill their dreams.

zh: 书包里面有书。
pinyin: shūbāo lǐmiàn yǒu shū.
en: There are books inside the backpack.

zh: 冰箱里面有很多吃的东西。
pinyin: bīngxiāng lǐmiàn yǒu hěnduō chīde dōngxi.
en: There are lots of things to eat in the fridge.

zh: 虽然房间很小，但是里面放了很多家具。
pinyin: Suīrán fángjiān hěn xiǎo, búshì lǐmiàn fàngle hěnduō jiājù.
en: Although the room is small, there's still a lot of furniture inside it.

zh: 他打开抽屉，发现里面装着一些旧照片和信件。
pinyin: Tā dǎkāi chōutì, fāxiàn lǐmiàn zhuāngzhe yīxiē jiù zhàopiàn hé xìnjiàn.
en: He opened the drawer and discovered some old photos and letters stored inside.

zh: 公司里面虽然竞争激烈，但大家还是能够相互支持。
pinyin: Gōngsī lǐmiàn suīrán jìngzhēng jīliè, búshì dàjiā háishi nénggoù xiānghu zhīchí.
en: Despite fierce competition within the company, people still manage to support each other.

zh: 我每天吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān chī mǐfàn.
en: I eat rice every day.

zh: 每个学生都有一个书包。
pinyin: Měi gè xuéshēng dōu yǒu yī gè shūbāo.
en: Every student has a schoolbag.

zh: 虽然很累，但是我每周还是去健身房。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ měi zhōu háishi qù jiànshēnfáng.
en: Even though I'm tired, I still go to the gym every week.

zh: 因为每次开会都很长，所以大家都不太专心。
pinyin: Yīnwèi měi cì kāihuì dōu hěn cháng, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu búduō zhuānxīn.
en: Because every meeting is long, nobody really pays attention.

zh: 每当我看到他的名字，就会想起那段往事。
pinyin: Měi dāng wǒ kàndào tā de míngzì, jiù huì xiǎngqǐ nà duàn wǎngshì.
en: Whenever I see his name, I remember that period in the past.

zh: 我要一份米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yào yī fèn mǐfàn.
en: I want one serving of rice.

zh: 今天我买了两份报纸。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ mǎile liǎng fèn bàozhǐ.
en: I bought two copies of the newspaper today.

zh: 因为工作很忙，我每天只吃一份午餐。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò hěn máng, wǒ měitiān zhǐ chī yī fèn wǔcān.
en: Because work is really busy, I only eat one lunch a day.

zh: 这份合同需要双方签字才能生效。
pinyin: Zhè fèn hétonɡ xūyào shuāngfāng qiānzì cáinéng shēnɡxiào.
en: This contract needs to be signed by both parties before it takes effect.

zh: 根据最新调查，每份问卷的回复率达到了百分之八十。
pinyin: Gēnjù zuìxīn diàochá, měi fèn wènjuàn de huīfùlǜ dádàole bǎifēnzhī bāshí.
en: According to the latest survey, the response rate for each questionnaire reached eighty percent.

zh: 你到底吃了吗？
pinyin: Nǐ dàodǐ chīle ma?
en: Did you eat or not?

zh: 他到底去了北京还是上海？
pinyin: Tā dàodǐ qùle Běijīng háishi Shànghǎi?
en: Did he end up going to Beijing or Shanghai?

zh: 虽然很难，但是我到底完成了这个工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn nán, dànshi wǒ dàodǐ wánchéngle zhège gōngzuò.
en: Even though it was hard, I finally managed to finish this job.

zh: 经过三年的努力，他到底明白了自己真正想要什么。
pinyin: Jīngguò sān nián de nǔlì, tā dàodǐ míngbai le zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xiǎngyào shénme.
en: After three years of effort, he finally understood what he really wanted.

zh: 与其猜测，不如直接问他到底是什么意思。
pinyin: Yǔqī cāicè, búrú zhíjiē wèn tā dàodǐ shì shénme yìsi.
en: Instead of guessing, why don't we just ask him straight up what he means?

zh: 我了解你。
pinyin: Wǒ liǎojiě nǐ.
en: I understand you.

zh: 你昨天了解了新公司吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān liǎojiěle xīn gōngsī ma?
en: Did you learn about the new company yesterday?

zh: 因为我想找工作，所以我了解了很多公司。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ xiǎng zhǎo gōngzuò, suǒyǐ wǒ liǎojiěle hěnduō gōngsī.
en: Because I want to find a job, I've learned about a lot of companies.

zh: 虽然我们只聊了十分钟，但我已经很了解他的想法了。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen zhǐ liáole shí fēnzhōng, dàn wǒ yǐjīng hěn liǎojiěle tā de xiǎngfǎ le.
en: Although we only talked for ten minutes, I already understand his ideas pretty well.

zh: 在开始这个项目前，我们需要充分了解客户的真实需求和预算限制。
pinyin: Zài kāishǐ zhège xiàngmù qián, wǒmen xūyào充分 liǎojiě kèhù de zhēnshí xūqiú hé yùsuàn xiànzhì.
en: Before we start this project, we need to fully understand the client's actual needs and budget constraints.

zh: 明天我吃米饭。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ chī mǐfàn.
en: Tomorrow I'm eating rice.

zh: 明天下午我要去公园。
pinyin: Míngtiān xiàwǔ wǒ yào qù gōngyuán.
en: Tomorrow afternoon I'm going to the park.

zh: 因为明天放假，所以我们可以睡到很晚。
pinyin: Yīnwèi míngtiān fàngjià, suǒyǐ wǒmen kěyǐ shuì dào hěn wǎn.
en: Since tomorrow is a holiday, we can sleep in really late.

zh: 虽然明天要开会，但是我决定先完成这个项目。
pinyin: Suīrán míngtiān yào kāihuì, dànshì wǒ juédinng xiān wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
en: Even though I have a meeting tomorrow, I've decided to finish this project first.

zh: 明天的截止日期对我们来说很关键，所以今晚必须把准备工作做好。
pinyin: Míngtiān de jiēzhǐ rìqī duì wǒmen láishuō hěn guānjiàn, suǒyǐ jīnwǎn bìxū bǎ zhǔnbèi gōngzuò zuò hǎo.
en: Tomorrow's deadline is critical for us, so we absolutely have to get the prep work done tonight.

zh: 我在车站等你。
pinyin: Wǒ zài chēzhàn děng nǐ.
en: I'm waiting for you at the bus station.

zh: 地铁站离我家很近。
pinyin: Dìtiě zhàn lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn.
en: The subway station is very close to my home.

zh: 虽然站了很久，但是我没有累。
pinyin: Suīrán zhàn le hěn jiǔ, dànshì wǒ méiyǒu lèi.
en: Even though I stood for a long time, I wasn't tired.

zh: 因为火车站太拥挤，我决定改坐飞机。
pinyin: Yīnwèi huǒchē zhàn tài yōngjǐ, wǒ juédinng gǎi zuò fēijī.
en: Because the train station was too crowded, I decided to fly instead.

zh: 他在公司前台接待处站了一整天，最后累得站不住了。
pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī qiántái jiēdài chù zhàn le yī zhěngtiān, zuìhòu lèi de zhàn bu zhù le.
en: He stood at the company's front desk all day, and by the end he was so exhausted he could barely stay on his feet.

zh: 课结束了。
pinyin: Kè jiéshù le.
en: Class is over.

zh: 电影明天结束放映。
pinyin: Diànyǐng míngtiān jiéshù fàngyìng.
en: The movie finishes showing tomorrow.

zh: 虽然很累，但我们还是结束了工作。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn wǒmen háishi jiéshù le gōngzuò.
en: Even though we were tired, we still finished the work.

zh: 会议比预计早结束了一个小时。
pinyin: Huìyì bǐ yùjì zǎo jiéshù le yī ge xiǎoshí.
en: The meeting ended an hour earlier than expected.

zh: 这个项目因为资金不足最后不得不结束了。
pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yīnwèi zījīn búzú zuìhòu búdébù jiéshù le.
en: The project had to be wound down in the end due to insufficient funding.

zh: 我在公司工作。
pinyin: Wǒ zài gōngsī gōngzuò.
en: I work at a company.

zh: 我爸爸的公司很大。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba de gōngsī hěn dà.
en: My dad's company is very large.

zh: 因为公司很忙，所以我没有时间休息。
pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngsī hěn máng, suǒyǐ wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān xiūxi.
en: Because the company is busy, I haven't had time to rest.

zh: 虽然这家公司成立才三年，但它已经成为行业的领导者。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè jiā gōngsī chéglì cái sān nián, dàn tā yǐjīng chéngwéi hángyè de lǐngdǎozhě.
en: Although this company was only founded three years ago, it has already become an industry leader.

zh: 为了提高员工的积极性，公司决定推行一套新的激励政策。
pinyin: Wèile tígāo yuángōng de jījījíxìng, gōngsī juédìng tuīxíng yī tào xīn de jīlì zhèngcè.
en: To boost employee motivation, the company has decided to implement a new incentive system.

zh: 他成为了医生。
pinyin: Tā chéngwéi le yīshēng.
en: He became a doctor.

zh: 去年她成为了我们学校的老师。
pinyin: Qùnián tā chéngwéi le wǒmen xuéxiào de lǎoshī.
en: Last year she became a teacher at our school.

zh: 因为他很努力，所以成为了一个成功的人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ chéngwéi le yīgè chénggōng de rén.
en: Because he worked hard, he became a successful person.

zh: 随着互联网的发展，在线教育已经成为了很多学生的选择。
pinyin: Suízhe hùliánwǎng de fāzhǎn, zàixiàn jiàoyù yǐjīng chéngwéi le hěnduō xuésheng de xuǎnzé.
en: With the development of the internet, online education has become a choice for many students.

zh: 从一个普通员工成为公司的管理层，她用了十年的时间和坚持不懈的努力。
pinyin: Cóng yīgè pǔtōng yuángōng chéngwéi gōngsī de guǎnlǐcéng, tā yòngle shí nián de shíjiān hé jiānchí búxié de nǔlì.
en: It took her ten years of time and unwavering effort to go from an ordinary employee to a manager in the company.

zh: 我永远爱你。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒngyuǎn ài nǐ.
en: I will always love you.

zh: 他永远不会忘记这个朋友。
pinyin: Tā yǒngyuǎn búhuì wàngji zhège péngyou.
en: He will never forget this friend.

zh: 虽然他离开了，但我永远记得他的话。
pinyin: Suīrán tā líkāile, dàn wǒ yǒngyuǎn jìde tāde huà.
en: Even though he left, I'll always remember what he said.

zh: 因为这段经历改变了我，所以我永远感谢那些帮助过我的人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè duàn jīnglì gǎibiànle wǒ, suǒyǐ wǒ yǒngyuǎn gǎnxiè nàxiē bāngzhùguò wǒ de rén.
en: Because that experience changed me, I'll always be grateful to the people who helped me.

zh: 与其后悔，不如永远保持好奇心去探索新的可能性。
pinyin: Yǔqī hòuhuǐ, búrú yǒngyuǎn bǎochí hàoqīxīn qù tànsuǒ xīn de kěnéngxìng.
en: Rather than regret, it's better to always keep curiosity and explore new possibilities.

zh: 妈妈帮助我。
pinyin: Māma bāngzhù wǒ.
en: Mom helps me.

zh: 老师每天帮助学生学习。
pinyin: Lǎoshī měi tiān bāngzhù xuésheng xuéxí.
en: The teacher helps students study every day.

zh: 因为他很聪明，所以他经常帮助别人。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn cōngming, suǒyǐ tā jīngcháng bāngzhù biérén.
en: Because he's smart, he often helps other people.

zh: 这个软件可以帮助你提高英语水平。
pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ bāngzhù nǐ tígāo yīngyǔ shuǐpíng.
en: This software can help you improve your English level.

zh: 与其抱怨，不如积极寻求朋友的帮助来解决问题。
pinyin: Yǔqī bàoyuàn, búrú jījí xúnqiú péngyou de bāngzhù lái jiějué wèntí.
en: Rather than complaining, it's better to actively seek your friends' help to solve the problem.

zh: 对我来说很简单。
pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō hěn jiǎndān.
en: For me, it's very easy.

zh: 这个价格对学生来说太贵了。
pinyin: Zhège jiàgé duì xuésheng lái shuō tài guì le.
en: This price is too expensive for students.

zh: 虽然工作很累，但对他来说很有意思。
pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, dàn duì tā lái shuō hěn yǒu yìsi.
en: Although the work is tiring, it's really interesting to him.

zh: 对大多数年轻人来说，学好英语变得越来越重要。
pinyin: Duì dàduōshù niánqīngrén lái shuō, xuéhǎo Yīngyǔ biàn de yuèláiyuè zhòngyào.
en: For most young people, learning English well has become increasingly important.

zh: 从长远来说，坚持健身和阅读对人生发展很有帮助。
pinyin: Cóng chángyuǎn lái shuō, jiānchíng jiànshēn hé yuèdú duì rénshēng fāzhǎn hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
en: In the long run, sticking with exercise and reading really helps with personal development.

zh: 你有多少个苹果？
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu duōshao ge píngguǒ?
en: How many apples do you have?

zh: 这件衣服多少钱？我想买。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu duōshao qián? Wǒ xiǎng mǎi.
en: How much is this shirt? I want to buy it.

zh: 虽然我不知道多少学生来了，但是教室很满。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ búzhīdào duōshao xuésheng lái le, dànshì jiàoshì hěn mǎn.
en: Although I don't know how many students came, the classroom is very full.

zh: 我们需要讨论一下这个项目要花多少时间和金钱。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào tǎolùn yīxià zhège xiàngmù yào huā duōshao shíjiān hé jīnqián.
en: We need to discuss how much time and money this project will take.

zh: 不管你投入多少努力，成功最后都取决于你的决心和执行力。
pinyin: Búguǎn nǐ tóurù duōshao nǔlì, chénggōng zuìhòu dōu qǔjuéyú nǐ de juéxīn hé zhíxíngglì.
en: No matter how much effort you put in, success ultimately depends on your determination and ability to follow through.

zh: 哇，这个蛋糕真好吃！
pinyin: wa, zhège dàngāo zhēn hǎochī!
en: Wow, this cake is really delicious!

zh: 哇，你的新房间这么大啊！
pinyin: wa, nǐ de xīn fángjiān zhème dà a!
en: Wow, your new room is so big!

zh: 哇，因为下雪了，所以外面真漂亮。
pinyin: wa, yīnwèi xiàxuě le, suǒyǐ wàimiàn zhēn piàoliàng.
en: Wow, because it snowed, the outside looks really beautiful.

zh: 哇，这部电影虽然很长，但是情节特别吸引人。
