pinyin: wa, zhè bù diànyǐng suīrán hěn cháng, dànshì qíngjiē tèbié xīyǐnrén.
en: Wow, although this movie is quite long, the plot is really compelling.

zh: 哇，她竟然一个人完成了这么复杂的项目，真是令人印象深刻。
pinyin: wa, tā jìngrán yīgè rén wánchéng le zhème fùzá de xiàngmù, zhēnshi lìngrén yìnxiàng shēnkè.
en: Wow, she actually completed such a complex project all by herself—that's really impressive.

zh: 我叫王名。
pinyin: Wǒ jiào Wáng Míng.
en: My name is Wang Ming.

zh: 他的名字很特别,我很喜欢。
pinyin: Tā de míngzi hěn tèbié, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
en: His name is really unique, and I like it a lot.

zh: 虽然她的名字很长,但是很容易记住。
pinyin: Suīrán tā de míngzi hěn cháng, dànshi hěn róngyì jìzhù.
en: Although her name is long, it's easy to remember.

zh: 这家公司的名声很好,所以很多人想在那里工作。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de míngsheng hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ hěnduō rén xiǎng zài nàlǐ gōngzuò.
en: This company has a great reputation, so many people want to work there.

zh: 他因为一次成功的项目而名声大噪,现在是行业内的知名人士。
pinyin: Tā yīnwèi yī cì chénggōng de xiàngmù érmiáng shēng dà zào, xiànzài shì hángyè nèi de zhīmíng rénshì.
en: He became well-known overnight because of one successful project, and now he's a prominent figure in the industry.

zh: 这些苹果很红，它们很好吃。
pinyin: Zhèxiē píngguǒ hěn hóng, tāmen hěn hǎochī.
en: These apples are very red, and they taste really good.

zh: 我有两只猫，它们每天都在睡觉。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī māo, tāmen měitiān dōu zài shuìjiào.
en: I have two cats, and they sleep all day long.

zh: 虽然这些书很旧，但是它们对我很重要。
pinyin: Suīrán zhèxiē shū hěn jiù, dànshì tāmen duì wǒ hěn zhòngyào.
en: Although these books are old, they're really important to me.

zh: 我买了几件新衣服，因为它们打折了，所以便宜很多。
pinyin: Wǒ mǎile jǐ jiàn xīn yīfu, yīnwèi tāmen dǎzhé le, suǒyǐ piányi hěn duō.
en: I bought several new clothes because they were on sale, so they were much cheaper.

zh: 这些公司虽然规模不同，但它们的发展目标基本一致。
pinyin: Zhèxiē gōngsī suīrán guīmó búntóng, dàn tāmen de fāzhǎn mùbiāo jīběn yīzhì.
en: Although these companies vary in size, their development goals are essentially aligned.

zh: 我总是吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ zǒngshì chī mǐfàn.
en: I always eat rice.

zh: 他每天总要喝一杯咖啡。
pinyin: Tā měitiān zǒngyào hē yībēi kāfēi.
en: He always has to drink a cup of coffee every day.

zh: 虽然很累，但他总是坚持去健身房。
pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dàn tā zǒngshì jiānchí qù jiànshēnfáng.
en: Even though he's tired, he always insists on going to the gym.

zh: 总的来说，这个计划比较可行，但还需要改进。
pinyin: Zǒngde lái shuō, zhège jìhuà bǐjiào kěxíng, dàn háishi xūyào gǎijìn.
en: Overall, this plan is fairly feasible, but it still needs improvement.

zh: 不管怎样，我们总要面对现实，不能一直逃避。
pinyin: Búguǎn zěnyàng, wǒmen zǒngyào miànduì xiànshí, búnéng yīzhí táobì.
en: No matter what, we always have to face reality—we can't keep running away from it.

zh: 我确定喜欢吃米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ quèdìng xǐhuān chī mǐfàn.
en: I'm sure I like eating rice.

zh: 明天的会议时间确定了吗？
pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì shíjiān quèdìng le ma?
en: Has the time for tomorrow's meeting been confirmed?

zh: 因为天气不好，所以我们确定下周去旅游。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì búhǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen quèdìng xiàzhōu qù lǚyóu.
en: Since the weather isn't good, we've decided to go on a trip next week instead.

zh: 在我们确定这个计划之前，需要先听听大家的意见。
pinyin: Zài wǒmen quèdìng zhège jìhuà zhīqián, xūyào xiān tīngtīng dàjiā de yìjiàn.
en: Before we finalize this plan, we need to hear what everyone thinks first.

zh: 虽然他表面上同意了，但我还是不能确定他是否真心支持这个方案。
pinyin: Suīrán tā biǎomiàn shang tóngyì le, dàn wǒ háishi búnéng quèdìng tā shìfǒu zhēnxīn zhīchí zhège fāng'àn.
en: Although he agreed on the surface, I still can't be sure whether he genuinely supports this proposal.

zh: 有人在吃饭。
pinyin: Yǒu rén zài chīfàn.
en: Someone is eating.

zh: 今天有人来我家玩。
pinyin: Jīntiān yǒu rén lái wǒ jiā wán.
en: Someone is coming to my house to play today.

zh: 虽然有人不同意，但是我们还是决定了。
pinyin: Suīrán yǒu rén búhuì tóngyì, dànshì wǒmen háishi juéding le.
en: Although some people disagree, we decided anyway.

zh: 如果有人问你这个问题，你应该怎么回答？
pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu rén wèn nǐ zhège wèntí, nǐ yīnggāi zěnme huídá?
en: If someone asks you this question, how should you respond?

zh: 有人说这个计划太冒险了，但我觉得没有尝试就没有机会。
pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō zhège jìhuà tài màoxiǎn le, dàn wǒ juéde méiyǒu chángshì jiù méiyǒu jīhuì.
en: Some people say this plan is too risky, but I think you can't get anywhere without trying.

zh: 我看得很清楚。
pinyin: Wǒ kàn de hěn qīngchu.
en: I can see it very clearly.

zh: 请你说得清楚一点，我没听懂。
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ shuō de qīngchu yīdiǎn, wǒ méi tīngdǒng.
en: Can you speak a bit more clearly? I didn't understand.

zh: 虽然天气不好，但我还是看得很清楚。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì búhǎo, dàn wǒ háishi kàn de hěn qīngchu.
en: Even though the weather was bad, I could still see it clearly.

zh: 因为没有清楚地了解情况，我们做了一个错误的决定。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu qīngchu de liǎojiě qíngkuàng, wǒmen zuòle yī ge cuòwù de juédìng.
en: Because we didn't clearly understand the situation, we made a wrong decision.

zh: 与其猜测，不如主动问清楚，这样才能避免以后的麻烦。
pinyin: Yǔqī cāicè, búrú zhǔdòng wèn qīngchu, zhèyàng cáinéng bìmiǎn yǐhòu de máfan.
en: Rather than guessing, it's better to just ask outright to get clarity—that way you can avoid trouble later.

zh: 晚上我吃饭。
pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒ chī fàn.
en: I eat dinner in the evening.

zh: 晚上我和家人看电视。
pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒ hé jiārén kàn diànshì.
en: In the evening, I watch TV with my family.

zh: 因为晚上很冷,所以我穿上厚衣服。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǎnshang hěn lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ chuānshang厚 yīfu.
en: Because it's cold in the evening, I put on thick clothes.

zh: 虽然晚上很累,但是我还是坚持去健身房锻炼。
pinyin: Suīrán wǎnshang hěn léi, dànshi wǒ háishi jiānchí qù jiànshēnfáng duànliàn.
en: Even though I'm tired in the evening, I still make the effort to go to the gym.

zh: 晚上的时候我通常会花一小时处理工作邮件和计划第二天的任务。
pinyin: Wǎnshang de shíhou wǒ tōngcháng huì huā yī xiǎoshí chǔlǐ gōngzuò yóujiàn hé jìhuà dì'èr tiān de rènwu.
en: In the evenings, I usually spend an hour dealing with work emails and planning out my tasks for the next day.

zh: 孩子要安全。
pinyin: Háizi yào ānquán.
en: Children need to be safe.

zh: 坐车的时候要系安全带。
pinyin: Zuò chē de shíhou yào xì ānquán dài.
en: You should wear a seatbelt when riding in a car.

zh: 虽然这条路很近，但是不安全，所以我们走别的路。
pinyin: Suīrán zhè tiáo lù hěn jìn, dànshì bù ānquán, suǒyǐ wǒmen zǒu biéde lù.
en: Although this road is shorter, it's not safe, so we'll take a different route.

zh: 公司制定了新的安全规则，为了保护员工的身体健康。
pinyin: Gōngsī zhìdìngle xīn de ānquán guīzé, wèile bǎohù yuángōng de shēntǐ jiànkāng.
en: The company has established new safety rules to protect employees' health.

zh: 只有做好日常安全检查，才能防患于未然，避免后期出现大问题。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zuò hǎo rìcháng ānquán jiǎnchá, cáinéng fánghuàn yú wèirán, bìmiǎn hòuqī chūxiàn dà wèntí.
en: Only by conducting regular safety inspections can we prevent problems before they arise and avoid major issues later.

zh: 你怎样吃饭？
pinyin: Nǐ zěnyàng chīfàn?
en: How do you eat?

zh: 今天天气怎样？很冷吗？
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì zěnyàng? Hěn lěng ma?
en: What's the weather like today? Is it very cold?

zh: 虽然他很忙，但是怎样都要帮助朋友。
pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì zěnyàng dōu yào bāngzhù péngyou.
en: Even though he's busy, he always wants to help his friends no matter what.

zh: 如果你想学好中文，首先怎样安排学习计划很重要。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng xuéhǎo zhōngwén, shǒuxiān zěnyàng ānpái xuéxí jìhuà hěn zhòngyào.
en: If you want to learn Chinese well, how you plan your study schedule is really important from the start.

zh: 现在网络那么发达，年轻人怎样才能找到真正有意义的东西，这成了一个问题。
pinyin: Xiànzài wǎngluò nàme fāda, niánqīng rén zěnyàng cáinéng zhǎodào zhēnzhèng yǒu yìyì de dōngxi, zhè chéngle yī ge wèntí.
en: With the internet so advanced these days, how young people can find something truly meaningful has become a real question.
